dystopian.en: Of or pertaining to a dystopia.

flash point.zh: 闪点：指易燃可燃物质在空气中遇到火焰时能够自燃的最低温度。; 爆发点：指某人或某物突然爆发或开始行动...

headwinds.en: A wind that blows directly against the course of a vehicle, like an aircraft, train, or ship.

populism.zh: n. 民粹主义，平民主义
populism.en: A political doctrine or philosophy that proposes that the rights and powers of ordinary people are exploited by a privileged elite, and supports their struggle to overcome this.

scale back.zh: 减少某物的数量、范围等：指减少某物的数量、范围等。
scale back.en: To make a reduction in the amount, extent, etc. of something.

toll.zh: n. （道路、桥梁等的）通行费；<美>长途电话费；（事故、灾难、战争等的）伤亡人数；严重的不良影响；...
toll.en: Loss or damage incurred through a disaster.

commission.zh: （通常为政府管控或调查某事的）委员会；佣金；回扣；（银行等的）手续费；（请某人作建筑设计或作一幅画等的）正式委托；军官职务；做错事；犯罪；可／不可使用；正式委托（谱写、制作、创作或完成）；任命…为军官
commission.en: an official group of people who have been given responsibility to control something, or to find out about something, usually for the government; an amount of money that is paid to somebody for selling goods and that increases with the amount of goods that are sold; an amount of money that is charged by a bank, etc. for providing a particular service; a formal request to somebody to design or make a piece of work such as a building or a painting; the fact of making such a request; the position of an officer in the armed forces, typically with the rank of lieutenant or higher; the act of doing something wrong or illegal; available/not available to be used; to officially ask somebody to write, make or create something or to do a task for you; to choose somebody as an officer in one of the armed forces

foundation.zh: 基本原理；根据；基础；基金会；（机构或组织的）创建，创办；地基；房基；基础；（化妆打底用的）粉底霜；从根本上动摇
foundation.en: a principle, an idea or a fact that something is based on and that it grows from; an organization that is established to provide money for a particular purpose, for example for scientific research or charity; the act of starting a new institution or organization; a layer of stone, concrete, etc. that forms the solid underground base of a building; a skin-coloured cream that is put on the face under other make-up; to cause people to question their basic beliefs about something

peak.zh: 顶峰；高峰；山峰；峰峦；尖形；尖端；尖头；帽舌；帽檐；达到高峰；达到最高值；最高度的；高峰时期的；巅峰状态的
peak.en: the point when somebody/something is best, most successful, strongest, etc.; the pointed top of a mountain; a mountain with a pointed top; any narrow and pointed shape, edge, etc.; the stiff front part of a cap that sticks out above your eyes; to reach the highest point or value; used to describe the highest level of something, or a time when the greatest number of people are doing something or using something

track record.en: all the past achievements, successes or failures of a person or an organization

broker.zh: 经纪人；掮客；安排，协商（协议的细节，尤指在两国间）
broker.en: a person who buys and sells things for other people; a person or an organization that buys and sells shares for other people; a person who arranges the details of an agreement between two groups or countries that disagree or oppose each other; to arrange the details of an agreement, especially between different countries

overhaul.zh: 检修；大修；改造；彻底检修；赶上，超过（赛跑对手）
overhaul.en: an examination of a machine or system, including doing repairs on it or making changes to it; to examine every part of a machine, system, etc. and make any necessary changes or repairs; to come from behind a person you are competing against in a race and go past them

fracking.zh: 水力压裂（开采石油或天然气的方法）
fracking.en: the process of forcing liquid at high pressure into rocks, deep holes in the ground, etc. in order to force open existing cracks (= narrow openings) and take out oil or gas

achievement gap.zh: 成就差距：不同种族、阶层、经济背景的学生在学业成就上的差距。

acquitted.zh: adj. 无罪；无罪开释; v. 释放（acquit 的过去分词）
acquitted.en: To declare or find innocent or not guilty.

anecdotal.en: possibly not true or accurate because it is based on personal accounts rather than facts or research

assuage.en: to make an unpleasant feeling less severe

austerity.zh: （经济的）紧缩；严格节制消费；苦行；禁欲；艰苦；朴素
austerity.en: difficult economic conditions created by government policies aimed at cutting public spending; the quality of being simple and plain in appearance; the quality of being strict and serious in appearance or manner; the fact of allowing no pleasures and little to make life comfortable; something that is part of a way of life that allows no pleasures and little to make life comfortable

beside the point.zh: adv. 离题，不中肯；无关紧要

birthright citizenship.zh: 出生地权利公民身份：指在一个国家出生的人自动获得该国公民身份的法律原则。
birthright citizenship.en: The right (unconditional or near-unconditional) of anyone born in the territory of a state to nationality or citizenship.

charged.zh: 充满（某种情绪或想法）的；紧张的
charged.en: full of or causing strong feelings or opinions; with an electric charge

circulation.zh: 血液循环；传递；流传；流通；（报刊）发行量，销售量；（气、水等的）环流，循环；（某段时间的）社交活动，交际
circulation.en: the movement of blood around the body; the passing or spreading of something from one person or place to another; the usual number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold each day, week, etc.; the movement of something (for example air, water, gas, etc.) around an area or inside a system or machine; the fact that somebody takes part in social activities at a particular time

cognitive impairment.zh: 认知障碍：一种与一些心理能力有关的问题，例如记忆力，但不严重到影响一个人的日常生活。

constituents.en: A part, or component of a whole

contend with.en: to have to deal with a problem or with a difficult situation or person

converge.zh: 汇集；聚集；集中；（向某一点）相交，会合；（思想、政策、目标等）十分相似，相同
converge.en: to move towards a place from different directions and meet; to move towards each other and meet at a point; if ideas, policies, aims, etc. converge, they become very similar or the same

dilute.zh: 稀释；冲淡；削弱；降低；使降低效果；稀释了的；冲淡了的
dilute.en: to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid to it; to make something weaker or less effective; made weaker by adding water or another substance; having only a small amount of a substance dissolved in it

domestic abuse.zh: 家庭暴力：一个人对与其同住的人进行的残忍对待，可能包括暴力或其他形式的残忍行为。

embark on.zh: 从事，着手，开始（新的或艰难的事情）
embark on.en: to start to do something new or difficult

enact.zh: 通过（法律）；扮演；担任…角色；演出；发生；进行；举行；把…付诸实践；实施
enact.en: to pass a law; to perform a play or act a part in a play; to take place; to put something into practice

erode.zh: 侵蚀；腐蚀；风化；逐渐毁坏；削弱；损害
erode.en: to gradually destroy the surface of something through the action of wind, rain, etc.; to be gradually destroyed in this way; to gradually destroy something or make it weaker over a period of time; to be destroyed or made weaker in this way

feasible.en: that is possible and likely to be achieved

gig economy.zh: 零工经济：一种可以提供许多短期工作而不是长期工作的经济系统；在零工经济中工作意味着不断受到最后时刻的调度。
gig economy.en: an economic system in which many short periods of work are available rather than permanent jobs

global south.zh: 全球南方：指位于非洲、拉丁美洲以及亚洲发展中国家的一组国家。

insulate.zh: 使隔热；使隔音；使绝缘；使免除（不愉快的经历）；使免受（不良影响）；隔离
insulate.en: to protect something with a material that prevents heat, sound, electricity, etc. from passing through; to protect somebody/something from unpleasant experiences or influences

justices.zh: n. 法官；司法；正义；公正（justice 的复数）
justices.en: The state or characteristic of being just or fair.

legitimacy.zh: 合法的；法律认可的；法定的
legitimacy.en: the quality of being based on a fair or acceptable reason; the quality of being allowed and acceptable according to the law; the fact that a child's parents are legally married when it is born

loophole.en: a mistake in the way a law, contract, etc. has been written that enables people to legally avoid doing something that the law, contract, etc. had intended them to do

media literacy.zh: 媒体素养：指对媒体信息进行理解、分析和评估的能力，包括对媒体内容、形式、制作和传播方式的理解，以及对...

momentum.zh: 推进力；动力；势头；冲力；动量
momentum.en: the ability to keep increasing or developing; a force that is gained by movement; the quantity of movement of a moving object, measured as its mass multiplied by its speed

oust.en: to force somebody out of a job or position of power, especially in order to take their place

overturn.zh: 倾倒；倾覆；翻掉；推翻，撤销（判决等）
overturn.en: if something overturns, or if somebody overturns it, it turns into a position in which the top of it is where the bottom of it normally is or on its side; to officially decide that a legal decision, etc. is not correct, and to make it no longer legally recognized; to show that a belief or an idea is not correct

panacea.en: something that will solve all the problems of a particular situation

peers.zh: n. 同辈，同龄人；（英国或爱尔兰）贵族（peer 的复数）; v. 凝视；比得上（peer 的第三...

plaintiff.en: a person who makes a formal complaint against somebody in court

pretext.en: a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason; an excuse

provisions.zh: n. 规定（provision 的复数）；食品；预备; v. 供应补给品；供应粮食（provisio...
provisions.en: An item of goods or supplies, especially food, obtained for future use.

public domain.zh: （用于不受版权保护的财产）公有领域，公有产业
public domain.en: something that is in the public domain is available for everyone to use or to discuss and is not secret

raise eyebrows.zh: 引起惊讶或轻微不满：引起他人惊讶或轻微不满的行为或言语。

regime change.zh: 政权更迭：一国被另一国取代，特别是使用军事力量的情况；入侵是试图在该国实现政权更迭的一部分。；成千上万的人走上街头，要求政权更迭。
regime change.en: the situation when one government is replaced by another, especially using military force

remedy.zh: 处理方法；改进措施；补偿；疗法；治疗；药品；（通过法律程序的）解决方法，救济；改正；纠正；改进
remedy.en: a way of dealing with or improving an unpleasant or difficult situation; a treatment or medicine to cure a disease or reduce pain that is not very serious; a way of dealing with a problem, using the processes of the law; to correct or improve something

retention.zh: 保持；维持；保留；（液体、热量等的）保持，阻滞；记忆力；记性
retention.en: the action of keeping something rather than losing it or stopping it; the action of keeping liquid, heat, etc. inside something rather than letting it escape; the ability to remember things

scrapped.zh: adj. 报废的；已经销毁的; v. 废弃（scrap 的过去式）

silver lining.zh: 黑暗中总有一线光明；silver lining；(困境中的)一线希望
silver lining.en: If you say that , you mean that every sad or unpleasant situation has a positive side to it.; If you talk about a , you are talking about something positive that comes out of a sad or unpleasant situation.

strike a chord.en: To elicit a significant reaction, especially one which is favorable or sympathetic.

strike down.zh: 摧垮；使病倒；使丧命；击倒，撞倒（某人）；取消，撤销（法规）
strike down.en: to make somebody seriously ill; to kill somebody; to hit somebody very hard, so that they fall to the ground; to decide that a law is illegal and should not apply

struck down.zh: 击杀：指以暴力或武力手段杀死某人或某物。

subsidies.zh: 补助金，补贴，津贴（subsidy 的名词复数）
subsidies.en: Financial support or assistance, such as a grant.

subtle.zh: 不易察觉的；不明显的；微妙的；机智的；机巧的；狡猾的；敏锐的；头脑灵活的
subtle.en: not very obvious or easy to notice; behaving or organized in a clever way, and using indirect methods, in order to achieve something; good at noticing and understanding things

systemic.zh: 涉及全系统的；系统的；影响全身的；全身的；（农药等）内吸的
systemic.en: affecting or connected with the whole of something, especially the human body; systemic chemicals or drugs that are used to treat diseases in plants or animals enter the body of the plant or animal and spread to all parts of it

take for granted.zh: 视为理所当然：假定某事为真、实际、不容置疑或理所当然。
take for granted.en: (of a thing) To assume something to be true without verification or proof.

temporary protected status.zh: 临时保护身份：一种由美国政府颁发的身份，允许来自特定国家的人在美国暂时居住和工作，通常是因为他们的国...

testimony.zh: 证据；证明；证词；证言；口供
testimony.en: a thing that shows that something else exists or is true; a formal written or spoken statement saying what you know to be true, usually in court

think tank.zh: （政治、社会、经济问题的）智囊团，智库，专家小组
think tank.en: a group of experts who provide advice and ideas on political, social or economic issues

unionization.zh: 组织（或成立）工会；加入工会
unionization.en: the act or process of organizing people to become members of trade union or of becoming a member of a trade union

uphold.zh: 支持，维护（正义等）；维持（原判）；受理（申诉）
uphold.en: to support something that you think is right and make sure that it continues to exist; to agree that a previous decision was correct or that a request is reasonable

verdict.zh: （陪审团的）裁定，裁决，裁断；（经过检验或认真考虑后的）决定，结论，意见
verdict.en: an official judgement made in court or at an inquest (= an official investigation into somebody's death); a decision that you make or an opinion that you give about something, after you have tested it or considered it carefully

westminster.zh: n. 威斯敏斯特（伦敦市的一个行政区）；议会

cognitive reserve.zh: 认知储备：大脑对损伤的抵抗力。

duty of care.zh: 谨慎义务：确保他人免受身体或精神伤害的道义或法律义务；雇主有责任照顾自己的雇员。；欠某人谨慎的义务；警察在庆祝活动或体育赛事中再次未能履行对人们的照顾义务。
duty of care.en: a moral or legal obligation to ensure that other people are safe from physical or mental harm

grade inflation.zh: 分数膨胀：学生平均分数的上升，尤其是在给定的成绩水平上，分数比以前分配的更高的现象。
grade inflation.en: A gradual upward trend in grades awarded to students during the decades since the mid-20th century, reported in a number of countries and at a number of levels of schooling and sometimes offered as evidence of a decline in academic standards.

great recession.zh: 大衰退：指在2000年代末全球范围内经历的财富减少、工业生产下降和就业减少的时期。

hippocampus.zh: 海马（大脑中被认为是感情和记忆中心的部分）
hippocampus.en: either of the two areas of the brain thought to be the centre of emotion and memory

peer-reviewed.zh: 同行评审：由同一领域的其他人评判
peer-reviewed.en: judged by others working in the same area

soft power.zh: 该国的软实力和不断增长的经济使其可以主导该地区。
soft power.en: a way of dealing with other countries that involves using economic and cultural influence to persuade them to do things, rather than military power

windfall.zh: 意外之财；意外获得的东西；风吹落的果子（尤指苹果）
windfall.en: an amount of money that somebody/something wins or receives unexpectedly; a fruit, especially an apple, that the wind has blown down from a tree

adversary.en: a person that somebody is opposed to and competing with in an argument or a battle

apartheid.zh: 种族隔离（前南非政府推行的政策）
apartheid.en: the former political system in South Africa in which only white people had full political rights and other people, especially black people, were forced to live away from white people, go to separate schools, etc.

bad rap.zh: 坏名声：指一个人或事物因为误解或不公平的原因而获得的负面评价。

blackout.zh: 断电；停电；新闻封锁；灯火管制（期）；不透光窗罩（或窗帘）；一时性黑蒙；眼前昏黑；短时失忆
blackout.en: a period when there is no light as a result of an electrical power failure; a situation when the government or the police will not allow any news or information on a particular subject to be given to the public; a period of time during a war when all lights must be put out or covered at night, so that they cannot be seen by an enemy attacking by air; a piece of material that covers windows to stop light being seen from outside, or light from outside from coming into a room; a temporary loss of consciousness, sight or memory

clamp down.en: to take strict action in order to prevent something, especially crime

conducive.zh: 使容易（或有可能）发生的
conducive.en: making it easy, possible or likely for something to happen

crown.zh: 王冠；皇冠；冕；王国政府；王国；王位；王权；花冠（戴在头上，有时象征胜利）；冠军宝座；桂冠；头顶；帽顶；（某物的）顶部，顶端；（受损牙齿的）人造冠；王冠状物（尤指饰物或徽章）；克朗（欧洲一些国家的货币单位）；5 先令的英国旧币（等于现在的 25 便士）；王冠上的宝石；最有吸引力（或珍贵、有价值）的东西；为…加冕；形成…顶部；给…加顶；（尤指通过增添成就、成功等）使圆满，使完美；敲（某人）的脑壳；（在牙齿上）镶人造冠；（在一系列不愉快或讨厌的事件中）最糟糕的是
crown.en: an object in the shape of a circle, usually made of gold and precious stones, that a king or queen wears on his or her head on official occasions; the government of a country, thought of as being represented by a king or queen; the position or power of a king or queen; a circle of flowers, leaves, etc. that is worn on somebody’s head, sometimes as a sign of victory; the position of winning a sports competition; the top part of the head or a hat; the highest part of something; the part of a plant just above and below the ground; the top of a tree or other plant; an artificial cover for a damaged tooth; anything in the shape of a crown, especially as a decoration or a badge; a unit of money in several European countries; an old British coin worth five shillings (= now 25p); the most attractive or valuable part of something; to put a crown on the head of a new king or queen as a sign of royal power in a ceremony at which they officially become king or queen; to form or cover the top of something; to make something complete or perfect, especially by adding an achievement, a success, etc.; to hit somebody on the head; to put an artificial cover on a tooth; used to say that something is the final and worst event in a series of unpleasant or annoying events

dei.zh: prep. 一些; n. （Dei）（美、印尼）代（人名）

ditch.zh: 沟；渠；摆脱；抛弃；丢弃；使（飞机）在海上紧急降落；（在海上）迫降；逃学；旷课
ditch.en: a long channel dug at the side of a field or road, to hold or take away water; to get rid of something/somebody because you no longer want or need it/them; if a pilot ditches an aircraft, or if it ditches, it lands in the sea in an emergency; to stay away from school without permission

eligible.zh: 有资格的；合格的；具备条件的；（指作为结婚对象）合意的，合适的，中意的
eligible.en: a person who is eligible for something or to do something, is able to have or do it because they have the right qualifications, are the right age, etc.; an eligible young man or woman is thought to be a good choice as a husband/wife, usually because they are rich or attractive

enacted.zh: v. 制定，通过，颁布（法令）；扮演，表演；使发生，付诸实际（enact 的过去式和过去分词）

entitled.zh: 有权：感觉到您有权享受生活中的美好事物，而不必为他们工作；他真有资格！；该大学吸引了有钱父母的有资格子女和大量奖学金生。
entitled.en: feeling that you have a right to the good things in life without necessarily having to work for them

exacerbated.zh: v. 加重（病情，痛苦等）；使……恶化；激怒（exacerbate 的过去式和过去分词）
exacerbated.en: To make worse (a problem, bad situation, negative feeling, etc.); aggravate; exasperate.

fallout.zh: （核爆炸后的）放射性沉降物；后果；余波
fallout.en: dangerous radioactive dust that is in the air after a nuclear explosion; the bad results of a situation or an action

far-left.zh: 极左：指政治观点或立场偏向极端左翼的人或团体，主张彻底的社会变革和平等。

figures.zh: n. 数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像（figure 的复数）; v. 是……的部分；<非...
figures.en: A drawing or diagram conveying information.

forge.zh: 艰苦干成；努力加强；伪造；假冒；锻造；制作；稳步前进；铁匠铺；锻铁炉；锻造车间；锻造工厂
forge.en: to put a lot of effort into making something successful or strong so that it will last; to make an illegal copy of something in order to cheat people; to shape metal by heating it in a fire and hitting it with a hammer; to make an object in this way; to move forward in a steady but powerful way; a place where objects are made by heating and shaping pieces of metal, especially one where a blacksmith works; a large piece of equipment used for heating metals in; a building or part of a factory where this is found

gauge.zh: 测量仪器（或仪表）；计量器；宽度；厚度；（枪管的）口径；（铁道的）轨距；（火车的）轮距；（用于估计或判断的）事实，依据，尺度，标准；判定，判断（尤指人的感情或态度）；（用仪器）测量；估计；估算
gauge.en: an instrument for measuring the amount or level of something; a measurement of how wide or thick something is; a measurement of how wide the barrel of a gun is; the distance between the rails of a railway track or the wheels of a train; a fact or an event that can be used to estimate or judge something; to make a judgement about something, especially people’s feelings or attitudes; to measure something accurately using a special instrument; to calculate something approximately

grip.zh: 紧握；紧抓；（对…的）控制，影响力；理解；了解；不打滑；走得稳；把手；手柄；握杆；发夹；（拍摄电影时）摄影机和灯光设备管理人员；旅行袋；手提包；开始理解并着手处理难题；使（自己）镇定下来；控制住（自己的）情绪；处于不快却无法制止的境遇；受制于某事；失去（对…的）理解（或控制）；驾驭不住；使感兴趣；使激动；吸引住（某人）的注意；对…产生强有力的影响；抓牢
grip.en: an act of holding somebody/something tightly; a particular way of doing this; control or power over somebody/something; an understanding of something; the ability of something to move over a surface without slipping; a part of something that has a special surface so that it can be held without the hands slipping; a small thin piece of metal or plastic folded in the middle, used by women for holding their hair in place; a person who prepares and moves the cameras, and sometimes the lighting equipment, when a film is being made; a large soft bag, used when travelling; to begin to understand and deal with something difficult; to improve your behaviour or control your emotions after being afraid, upset or angry; experiencing something unpleasant that cannot be stopped; to become unable to understand or control a situation; to hold something tightly; to interest or have a strong effect on somebody; to hold somebody’s attention; to have a powerful effect on somebody/something; to hold onto or to move over a surface without slipping

grounds.zh: n. 根据，理由（ground 的复数形式）；基础；地面；运动场地; v. 把……放在地上；把……建...
grounds.en: The surface of the Earth, as opposed to the sky or water or underground.

hamper.zh: 妨碍；阻止；阻碍；（尤指用于盛食物的）带盖大篮子；（作为礼品的）盒装食物，袋装食物；盛脏衣服的大篮子
hamper.en: to prevent somebody from easily doing or achieving something; a large basket with a lid (= cover), especially one used to carry food in; a box or package containing food, sent as a gift; a large basket that you keep your dirty clothes in until they are washed

hedge.zh: 树篱；防止损失（尤指金钱）的手段；避免正面回答；不直接许诺；拐弯抹角；在（田地等）周围植树篱；用树篱围住；包围；限制；（为防止损失或出错）几面下注，有几项选择可选取
hedge.en: a row of bushes or small trees planted close together, usually along the edge of a field, garden or road; a way of protecting yourself against the loss of something, especially money; to avoid giving a direct answer to a question or promising to support a particular idea, etc.; to put a hedge around a field, etc.; to surround or limit somebody/something; to reduce the risk of losing or making a mistake by supporting more than one side in a competition, an argument, etc., or by having several choices available to you

hollowed out.zh: 挖空（某物）; 挖出（孔、洞）

in vain.zh: 徒劳无功：没有成功或结果。

keep tabs on.zh: 密切关注：指为了了解某人或某事的动态而仔细观察。; 追踪：指通过监视来了解某人或某事的情况。
keep tabs on.en: To monitor; to keep track of; to watch.

lip service.en: if somebody pays lip service to something, they say that they approve of it or support it, without proving their support by what they actually do

malpractice.en: careless, wrong or illegal behaviour while in a professional job

mounting.zh: 上升的；增长的；托架；支撑架
mounting.en: increasing, often in a manner that causes or expresses worry; something that an object stands on or is attached to for support

oligarchs.zh: 寡头政治的执政者（oligarchs 是 oligarch 的复数）
oligarchs.en: A member of an oligarchy; someone who is part of a small group that runs a country.

on a par with.zh: 与……处于同一水平或标准上：指与某物在质量、水平或标准上相当或相等。

outweigh.en: to be greater or more important than something

palpable.zh: 易于察觉的；可意识到的；明显的
palpable.en: that is easily noticed by the mind or the senses

pending.zh: 在等待…时期；直到…为止；待定的；待决的；即将发生的
pending.en: while waiting for something to happen; until something happens; waiting to be decided or settled; going to happen soon

periphery.zh: 边缘；周围；外围；次要部分；次要活动；边缘
periphery.en: the outer edge of a particular area; the less important part of something, for example of a particular activity or of a social or political group

peruse.en: to read something, especially in a careful way

purport.zh: 自称；标榜；主要意思；大意；主旨
purport.en: to claim to be something or to have done something, when this may not be true; the general meaning of something

refute.en: to prove that something is wrong; to say that something is not true or fair

skewed.zh: 歪曲的；有偏颇的；不准确的；偏向（或偏重）…的；偏的；斜的；歪的
skewed.en: not accurate or correct; directed towards a particular group, place, etc. in a way that may not be accurate or fair; not straight or level

solvent.zh: 溶剂；溶媒；有偿付能力；无债务；有溶解力的；可溶解的
solvent.en: a substance, especially a liquid, that can dissolve (= remove or destroy by a chemical process) another substance; having enough money to pay your debts; not in debt; able to dissolve another substance, or be dissolved in another substance

sophisticated.zh: 复杂巧妙的；先进的；精密的；见多识广的；老练的；见过世面的；水平高的；在行的
sophisticated.en: clever and complicated in the way that it works or is presented; having a lot of experience of the world and knowing about fashion, culture and other things that people think are socially important; able to understand difficult or complicated ideas

spell out.zh: 解释明白；讲清楚；用字母拼；拼写
spell out.en: to explain something in a simple, clear way; to say or write the letters of a word in the right order

spike.zh: 尖状物；尖头；尖刺；（防滑）鞋钉；（赛跑用的）钉鞋；穗；穗状花序；猛增；急升；用尖物刺入（或扎破）；在…中偷偷掺入（烈酒、毒药或毒品）；拒绝发表；阻止…传播；阻挠；迅速升值；急剧增值；打乱对手的计划
spike.en: a thin object with a sharp point, especially a pointed piece of metal, wood, etc.; a metal point attached to the sole of a sports shoe to prevent you from slipping while running; shoes fitted with these metal spikes, used for running; a long pointed group of flowers that grow together on a single stem; a sudden large increase in something; to push a sharp piece of metal, wood, etc. into somebody/something; to injure something on a sharp point; to add alcohol, poison or a drug to somebody’s drink or food without them knowing; to reject something that a person has written or said; to prevent something from happening or being made public; to rise quickly and reach a high value; to cause the plans of an opponent to fail

straddle.zh: 骑；跨坐；分腿站立；跨过，横跨（河流、道路或一片土地）；横跨，同属（不同时期、活动或群体）；两栖于（不同活动）
straddle.en: to sit or stand with one of your legs on either side of somebody/something; to cross, or exist on both sides of, a river, a road or an area of land; to exist within, or include, different periods of time, activities or groups of people

stronghold.zh: 有广泛支持的地方；势力强大的地方；堡垒；要塞；据点；（某种动物的）主要栖息地
stronghold.en: an area in which there is a lot of support for a particular belief or group of people, especially a political party; a castle or a place that is strongly built and difficult to attack; an area where there are a large number of a particular type of animal

tenor.zh: 男高音；男高音歌手；男高音声部；大意；要旨；要领；次中音的
tenor.en: a man’s singing voice with a range just below the lowest woman’s voice; a man with a tenor voice; a musical part written for a tenor voice; the general character or meaning of something; with a range of notes similar to that of a tenor voice

topple.zh: （使）失去平衡而坠落，倒塌，倒下；打倒；推翻；颠覆
topple.en: to become unsteady and fall down; to make something do this; to make somebody lose their position of power or authority

traction.zh: 牵引；拖拉；牵引力；拉力；牵引（使体内断骨复位的疗法）；（车轮等对地面的）附着摩擦力
traction.en: the action of pulling something along a surface; the power that is used for doing this; a way of treating a broken bone in your body that involves using special equipment to pull the bone gradually back into its correct place; the force that stops something, for example the wheels of a vehicle, from sliding on the ground; the extent to which an idea, a product, etc. becomes popular or gains support

veto.zh: 否决权；拒绝认可；禁止；行使否决权；拒绝认可；禁止；拒不接受；反对；否定
veto.en: the right to refuse to allow something to be done, especially the right to stop a law from being passed or a decision from being taken; an occasion when somebody refuses to allow something to be done; to stop something from happening or being done by using your official authority (= by using your veto); to refuse to accept or do what somebody has suggested

virtual.zh: （通过计算机软件，如在互联网上）模拟的，虚拟的；很接近的；几乎…的；事实上的；实际上的；实质上的
virtual.en: made to appear to exist by the use of computer software, for example on the internet; almost or very nearly the thing described, so that any slight difference is not important

insidious.en: spreading gradually or without being noticed, but causing serious harm

cascade.zh: 小瀑布（尤指一连串瀑布中的一支）；倾泻；流注；大簇的下垂物；倾泻（或涌出）的东西；大量落下；大量垂悬
cascade.en: a small waterfall, especially one of several falling down a steep slope with rocks; a large amount of water falling or pouring down; a large amount of something hanging down; a large number of things falling or coming quickly at the same time; a number of things happening, in which each one leads to another; to flow downwards in large amounts; to fall or hang in large amounts; to pass information, knowledge, etc. to a person or group so that they can pass it on to others; to be passed on in this way; to arrange a number of devices or objects in a series

vet.zh: 兽医；兽医诊所；审查（某人过去的生活和职业）；仔细检查，审查（内容、质量等）
vet.en: a person who has been trained in the science of animal medicine, whose job is to treat animals who are sick or injured; the place where a vet works; a person who has been a soldier, sailor, etc. in a war; to find out about a person’s past life and career in order to decide if they are suitable for something; to check the contents, quality, etc. of something carefully

blunt instrument.zh: 钝器：一种没有锋利的边缘或尖端的重物，用作武器；他被钝器击中头部而死亡。；钝器：一种做不到效率或对人的感觉不敏感的事情的方式；低利率已成为促进金融增长的钝器。
blunt instrument.en: a heavy object without a sharp edge or point, used as a weapon; a way of doing something that is not efficient or not sensitive to people's feelings

causality.en: the relationship between something that happens and the reason for it happening; the principle that nothing can happen without a cause

caveat.en: a warning that particular things need to be considered before something can be done

constitute.zh: （被认为或看作）是；被算作；组成；构成；（合法或正式地）成立，设立
constitute.en: to be considered to be something; to be the parts that together form something; to form a group legally or officially

illuminate.zh: 照明；照亮；照射；阐明；解释；用彩灯装饰；使容光焕发
illuminate.en: to shine light on something; to make something clearer or easier to understand; to decorate a street, building, etc. with bright lights for a special occasion; to make a person’s face, etc. seem bright and excited

invalidate.zh: 证明…错误；使站不住脚；使无效；使作废
invalidate.en: to prove that an idea, a story, an argument, etc. is wrong; if you invalidate a document, a contract, an election, etc., you make it no longer legally or officially acceptable

overrule.en: to change a decision or reject an idea from a position of greater power

perpetuate.zh: 使永久化；使持久化；使持续
perpetuate.en: to make something such as a bad situation, a belief, etc. continue for a long time

refuge.zh: 庇护；避难；避难所；庇护者；慰藉；收容所；避难所；安全岛（供行人避让车辆）
refuge.en: shelter or protection from danger, trouble, etc.; a place, person or thing that provides shelter or protection for somebody/something; a building that provides a temporary home for people in need of shelter or protection from somebody/something; an area in the middle of a road where you can stand and wait for cars to go past until it is safe for you to cross

sympathetic.zh: 同情的；有同情心的；表示同情的；赞同的；支持的；让人喜欢的；招人喜爱的
sympathetic.en: kind to somebody who is hurt or sad; showing that you understand and care about their problems; showing that you approve of somebody/something or that you share their views and are willing to support them; easy to like

tenure.zh: （尤指重要政治职务的）任期，任职；（尤指大学教师的）终身职位，长期聘用；（房地产的）保有权，保有期
tenure.en: the period of time when somebody holds an important job, especially a political one; the act of holding an important job; the right to stay permanently in your job, especially as a teacher at a university; the legal right to live in a house or use a piece of land

vetting.zh: 审查（某人过去的生活和职业）
vetting.en: the process of checking something with great care; the process of finding out everything about a person's past life and career in order to decide if they are suitable for something

watershed.zh: 转折点，分界线，分水岭（标志着重大变化的事件或时期）；分水线；分水岭；分水界；（英国）儿童不宜节目可在电视上播放的起始时间
watershed.en: an event or a period of time that marks an important change; a line of high land where streams on one side flow into one river, and streams on the other side flow into a different river; (in the UK) the time before which programmes that are not considered suitable for children may not be shown on television

draconian.zh: 德拉古式的；严酷的；残忍的

dwarf.zh: （神话中会魔法的）小矮人；矮子；侏儒；矮小的；使显得矮小；使相形见绌
dwarf.en: (in stories) a creature like a small man, who has magic powers and who is usually described as living and working under the ground, especially working with metal; an extremely small person who will never grow to a normal size because of a physical problem; a person suffering from dwarfism; much smaller than the normal size; to make something seem small or unimportant compared with something else

per se.en: used meaning ‘by itself’ to show that you are referring to something on its own, rather than in connection with other things

plethora.en: an amount that is greater than is needed or can be used

antithetical.zh: 对立的：与某事物相对或完全不同；暴力文化与教会的传统教义相反。
antithetical.en: opposite to or completely different from something

antitrust.en: preventing companies or groups of companies from controlling prices unfairly

calling.zh: 使命感；（尤指想帮助他人的）强烈愿望，责任感；职业；事业
calling.en: a strong desire or feeling of duty to do a particular job, especially one in which you help other people; a profession or career

charter school.zh: 美国；她的两个孩子都上了表演艺术特许学校。；中国浸入式特许学校
charter school.en: a school that has been established by teachers, parents or community groups, but receives public funds, and places special emphasis on a particular subject or teaching method

code of conduct.en: The for a group or organization is an agreement on rules of behaviour for the members of that group or organization.

due diligence.zh: 法律；尽职调查：个人或组织为避免实施侵权或犯罪而采取的合理步骤；该公司已采取一切合理的预防措施，并进行了尽职调查，以避免犯罪。；商业；尽职调查：正在考虑购买或投资该业务的个人或组织对业务状态的仔细调查；鼓励投资者在投资前对公司进行尽职调查。
due diligence.en: reasonable steps taken by a person or an organization to avoid committing a tort or an offence; a careful investigation of the state of a business by a person or organization that is thinking of buying it or investing in it

hardline.zh: 政策或态度强硬的，不妥协的，坚定的；hardline
hardline.en: If you describe someone's policy or attitude as , you mean that it is strict or extreme, and they refuse to change it.

hitherto.en: until now; until the particular time you are talking about

industrial action.zh: 劳工行动；（尤指）罢工，怠工
industrial action.en: action that workers take, especially stopping work, to protest to their employers about something

left-of-centre.zh: 政治；中间偏左：在政治中间和中间偏左的观点
left-of-centre.en: having views that are between the centre and the left in politics

meta-analysis.zh: 荟萃分析：结合了许多相关研究结果的研究；荟萃分析包括来自9个队列研究的数据，涉及1 280名儿童。
meta-analysis.en: research that combines the results of a number of related studies

oligarch.zh: 寡头政治家；寡头统治集团成员；大亨（尤指苏联解体后发迹的俄罗斯人）
oligarch.en: a member of an oligarchy; an extremely rich and powerful person, especially a Russian who became rich in business after the end of the former Soviet Union

patrol.zh: 巡逻；巡查；巡逻队；巡逻车队；童子军小队
patrol.en: the act of going to different parts of a building, an area, etc. to make sure that there is no trouble or crime; a group of soldiers, vehicles, etc. that patrol an area; a group of about six Boy Scouts or Girl Guides / Girl Scouts that forms part of a larger group; to go around an area or a building at regular times to check that it is safe and that there is no trouble

plurality.zh: 众多；大量；（未超过半数的）相对较多；复数
plurality.en: a large number; the number of votes given to one person, political party, etc. when this number is less than 50% but more than any other single person, etc. receives; the state of being plural

postmodern.zh: 后现代主义的；受后现代主义影响的
postmodern.en: connected with or influenced by postmodernism

repertoire.zh: （总称某人的）可表演项目；（某人的）全部才能，全部本领
repertoire.en: all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer knows and can perform; all the things that a person is able to do

tax avoidance.en: ways of paying only the smallest amount of tax that you legally have to

titular.zh: 名义上的；有名无实的；徒有虚名的；标题的；被用作标题的
titular.en: having a particular title or status but no real power or authority; the titular character of a book, play, film, etc. is the one mentioned in the title

abide.zh: （十分厌恶而）不能容忍，无法容忍；逗留；停留；居留；居住
abide.en: to dislike somebody/something so much that you hate having to be with or deal with them; to stay or live in a place

abide by.zh: 遵守，遵循（法律、协议、协定等）
abide by.en: to accept and act according to a law, an agreement, etc.

absenteeism.en: the fact of being frequently away from work or school, especially without good reasons

accede.zh: 同意（请求、建议等）；就任；就职；（尤指君主）即位
accede.en: to agree to a request, proposal, etc.; to achieve a high position, especially to become king or queen; to become a member of an organization

accommodate.zh: 提供住宿（或膳宿、座位等）；容纳；提供空间；考虑到；顾及；帮忙；给…提供方便；顺应，适应（新情况）
accommodate.en: to provide somebody with a room or place to sleep, live or sit; to provide enough space for somebody/something; to consider something such as somebody’s opinion or a fact and be influenced by it when you are deciding what to do or explaining something; to help somebody by doing what they want; to change your behaviour so that you can deal with a new situation better

accountable.zh: （对自己的决定、行为）负有责任，有说明义务
accountable.en: responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked

accrue.zh: （逐渐）增长，增加；积累（钱款或债务）
accrue.en: to increase over a period of time; to allow a sum of money or debts to grow over a period of time

act out.zh: 履行（仪式）；将…表演出来；充当（真实情况中的角色）
act out.en: to perform a ceremony or show how something happened, as if performing a play; to act a part in a real situation

acute.zh: 十分严重的；（疾病）急性的；灵敏的；敏锐的；有洞察力的；锐角的
acute.en: very serious or severe; an acute illness is one that has quickly become severe and dangerous; describing or designed for patients suffering from an acute illness; very sensitive and well developed; intelligent and quick to notice and understand things; less than 90°

adhere to.zh: 坚持，遵守，遵循（法律、规章、指示、信念等）
adhere to.en: to behave according to a particular law, rule, set of instructions, etc.; to follow a particular set of beliefs or a fixed way of doing something

affirmative action.zh: 积极区别对待政策（对因种族、性别等原因遭歧视的群体在就业等方面给予特别照顾）
affirmative action.en: the practice or policy of making sure that a particular number of jobs, etc. are given to people from groups that are often treated unfairly because of their race, sex, etc.

aggregation.en: the act of putting together different items, amounts, etc. into a single group or total; the group that is formed

altruistic.zh: 利他主义：关心他人的需求和幸福，愿意做些事情来帮助他们，即使这对自己没有好处
altruistic.en: caring about the needs and happiness of other people and being willing to do things to help them, even if it brings no advantage to yourself

ambivalent.zh: （喜忧参半、好坏参半等）矛盾情绪的
ambivalent.en: having or showing both positive and negative feelings about somebody/something

animus.en: a strong feeling of opposition, anger or hate

anomaly.en: a thing, situation, etc. that is different from what is normal or expected

arcane.en: secret and mysterious and therefore difficult to understand

articulate.zh: 明确表达；清楚说明；口齿清楚；清晰吐（词）；清晰发（音）；与…合成整体；用关节连接；链合；铰接；善于表达的；口齿清楚的；发音清晰的
articulate.en: to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words; to speak, pronounce or play something in a clear way; to be related to something so that together the two parts form a whole; to be joined to something else by a joint, so that movement is possible; to join something in this way; good at expressing ideas or feelings clearly in words; clearly expressed or pronounced

assimilate.zh: 透彻理解；消化；吸收；（使）同化，融入；使吸收，使接受（想法、态度等）
assimilate.en: to fully understand an idea or some information so that you are able to use it yourself; to become, or allow somebody to become, a part of a country or community rather than remaining in a separate group; to make an idea, a person’s attitude, etc. fit into something or be acceptable

asymmetric.en: having two sides or parts that are not the same in size or shape; not equal, for example in the way each side or part behaves

attribution.zh: 把…归因于；认为…是由于；认为是…所为（或说、写、作）
attribution.en: the act of saying or believing that something is the result of a particular thing; the act of saying or believing that somebody is responsible for doing something, especially for saying, writing or painting something; the act of regarding a quality or feature as belonging to somebody/something

audit.zh: 审计；稽核；（质量或标准的）审查，检查；旁听（大学课程）
audit.en: an official examination of business and financial records to see that they are true and correct; an official examination of the quality or standard of something; to officially examine the financial accounts of a company; to attend a course at college or university but without taking any exams or receiving credit

authoritarian.en: believing that people should obey authority and rules, even when these are unfair, and even if it means that they lose their personal freedom; a person who believes that people should obey authority and rules, even when these are unfair or even when this means the loss of personal freedom

authoritarianism.en: the belief that people should obey authority and rules, even when these are unfair or even when this means the loss of personal freedom

autopsy.en: an official examination of a dead body by a specially trained doctor in order to discover the cause of death

balance sheet.zh: 资产负债表；决算表；资金平衡表
balance sheet.en: a written statement showing the amount of money and property that a company has and listing what has been received and paid out

binding.zh: 必须遵守的；有法律约束力的；（书籍的）封皮；镶边；绲边；（滑雪板的）滑雪鞋固定装置
binding.en: that must be obeyed because it is accepted in law; the cover that holds the pages of a book together; cloth that is fastened to the edge of something to protect or decorate it; a device on a ski that holds the heel and toe of your boot in place and releases the boot if you fall

book value.zh: 公司资产的账面价值；book value
book value.en: In business, the of an asset is the value it is given in the account books of the company that owns it.

breach.zh: （对法规等的）违背，违犯；破坏；辜负；（关系）中断，终止；突破口；缺口；窟窿；临时顶替某人工作；临时顶缺；违反；违背；在…上打开缺口
breach.en: a failure to do something that must be done by law; an action that breaks an agreement to behave in a particular way; a break in a relationship between people or countries; an opening that is created during a military attack or by strong winds or seas; to do somebody’s job or work when they are suddenly or unexpectedly unable to do it; to not keep to an agreement or not keep a promise; to make a hole in a wall, fence, etc. so that somebody/something can go through it

bribery.en: the giving or taking of bribes

bring down.zh: 打垮；击败；使跌倒；减少；降低；使（飞机）着陆；击落；打倒（动物）；打落（鸟）
bring down.en: to make somebody lose power or be defeated; to make somebody fall over; to reduce something; to land an aircraft; to make an aircraft fall out of the sky; to make an animal or a bird fall down or fall out of the sky by killing or wounding it

brunt.zh: 承受某事的主要压力；首当其冲
brunt.en: to receive the main force of something unpleasant

buff.zh: 爱好者；行家里手；浅黄褐色；一丝不挂；赤裸；浅黄褐色的；健美（或健壮）而肌肉发达的；用软布擦亮
buff.en: a person who is very interested in a particular subject or activity and knows a lot about it; a pale yellow-brown colour; wearing no clothes; pale yellow-brown in colour; physically fit and attractive, with big muscles; to polish something with a soft cloth

buy into.zh: 购买公司股份（尤指为取得部分控制权）；信从（尤指随大溜）
buy into.en: to buy shares in a company, especially in order to gain some control over it; to believe something, especially an idea that many other people believe in

candid.zh: 坦率的；坦诚的；直言不讳的；（照片）偷拍的
candid.en: saying what you think openly and honestly; not hiding your thoughts; a candid photograph is one that is taken without the person in it knowing that they are being photographed

canopy.zh: （床、座位等上面的）罩篷，遮篷，罩盖；顶篷；天篷；（尤指森林里的）林冠，林冠层；（有时与建筑的一侧相连的）天篷，遮篷；（飞机的）座舱盖
canopy.en: a cover that is fixed or hangs above a bed, seat, etc. as a shelter or decoration; a layer of something that spreads over an area like a roof, especially branches of trees in a forest; a roof that is supported on posts and is sometimes also attached at one side to a building; a cover for the cockpit of an aircraft

carbon neutral.zh: 碳中和的，碳平衡的指不会增加空气中的二氧化碳总量；carbon neutral
carbon neutral.en: A lifestyle, company, or activity does not cause an increase in the overall amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.

carte blanche.en: the complete freedom or authority to do whatever you like

catch up.zh: 赶上，追上（某人）；赶上，达到（某水平）
catch up.en: to reach somebody who is ahead by going faster; to reach the same level or standard as somebody who was better or more advanced

cease.zh: （使）停止，终止，结束；（表示惊喜）真是无奇不有，怪事何其多
cease.en: to stop happening or existing; to stop something from happening or existing; a phrase used to express surprise and pleasure at something

ceasefire.en: a time when enemies agree to stop fighting, usually while a way is found to end the fighting permanently

churn.zh: 剧烈搅动；（使）猛烈翻腾；反胃，恶心（忧虑、厌恶或恐惧的强烈感觉）；（使）感到不安，心烦意乱；用搅乳器搅（乳，以制作黄油）；（制作黄油的）搅乳器；（旧时）盛奶大罐，奶桶；客户流失率；员工流失率
churn.en: if water, mud, etc. churns, or if something churns it (up), it moves or is moved around violently; if your stomach churns or if something churns your stomach, you feel a strong, unpleasant feeling of worry or fear; to make somebody feel upset or emotionally confused; to turn and mix milk in a special container in order to make butter; a machine in which milk or cream is shaken to make butter; a large metal container in which milk was carried from a farm in the past; the number of people who stop using a product and change to another or who leave the company they work for and go to another

climactic.zh: 非常激动人心的；高潮的；最重要的

climate crisis.zh: 在世界各地，各国政府采取紧急行动应对气候危机的势头越来越大。
climate crisis.en: a situation in which immediate action is needed to reduce or stop climate change and prevent serious and permanent damage to the environment

clinical trial.en: When a new type of drug or medical treatment undergoes , it is tested directly on patients to see if it is effective.

cloak.zh: （尤指旧时的）披风，斗篷；遮盖物；遮盖；掩盖
cloak.en: a type of coat that has no arms, fastens at the neck and hangs loosely from the shoulders, worn especially in the past; a thing that hides or covers somebody/something; to cover or hide something

collateral.zh: 抵押物；担保品；附属的；附加的；附带的
collateral.en: property or something valuable that you promise to give to somebody if you cannot pay back money that you borrow; connected with something else, but in addition to it and less important

color-blind.zh: 色盲的；（对待不同肤色的人）一视同仁的，无种族歧视的
color-blind.en: unable to see the difference between some colors, especially red and green; unable to see colors at all (although this is rare in humans); treating people with different colored skin in exactly the same way

commencement.zh: 开始；开端；学位授予典礼；毕业典礼
commencement.en: beginning; a ceremony at which students receive their academic degrees or diplomas

compel.zh: 强迫；迫使；使必须；引起反应
compel.en: to force somebody to do something; to make something necessary; to cause a particular reaction

compelling.zh: 引人入胜的；扣人心弦的；非常强烈的；不可抗拒的；令人信服的
compelling.en: that makes you pay attention to it because it is so interesting and exciting; so strong that you cannot resist it; that makes you think it is true

compress.zh: （被）压紧，压缩；精简；浓缩；压缩；压缩（文件等）；（止血、减痛等的）敷布，压布
compress.en: to press things together or press something into a smaller space; to be pressed in this way; to reduce something and fit it into a smaller space or amount of time; to make computer files, etc. smaller so that they use less space on a disk, etc.; a cloth that is pressed onto a part of the body to stop the loss of blood, reduce pain, etc.

concede.zh: 承认（某事属实、合乎逻辑等）；承认（比赛、选举等失败）；（尤指勉强地）让与，让步；允许
concede.en: to admit that something is true, logical, etc. after first denying it or resisting it; to admit that you have lost a game, an election, etc.; to give something away, especially unwillingly; to allow somebody to have something

concession.zh: 让步；妥协；承认；给予；许可；让步；减价；（对某类人的）减价票；（尤指由政府或雇主给予的）特许权，优惠；（在某地的）特许经营权；（有时为大型建筑物或商场中的）销售场地，摊位
concession.en: something that you allow or do, or allow somebody to have, in order to end an argument or to make a situation less difficult; the act of giving something or allowing something; the act of conceding; a reduction in an amount of money that has to be paid; a ticket that is sold at a reduced price to a particular group of people; a right or an advantage that is given to a group of people, an organization, etc., especially by a government or an employer; the right to sell something in a particular place; the place where you sell it, sometimes an area that is part of a larger building or store

conflagration.en: a very large fire that destroys a lot of land or buildings

consciousness.zh: 清醒状态；知觉；觉察；感觉；意识；观念；看法
consciousness.en: the state of being able to use your senses and mental powers to understand what is happening; the state of being aware of something; the ideas and opinions of a person or group

constituency.zh: （选举议会议员的）选区；选区的选民；（统称）支持者
constituency.en: a district that elects its own representative to parliament; the people who live in and vote in a particular district; a particular group of people in society who are likely to support a person, an idea or a product

constitutionality.en: the fact that something is acceptable according to a constitution

consumed.en: If you are a feeling or idea, it affects you very strongly indeed.

consumer price index.zh: 居民消费价格指数；消费价格指数
consumer price index.en: a list of the prices of some ordinary goods and services, which shows how much these prices change each month

contempt of court.en: the crime of refusing to obey an order made by a court; not showing respect for a court or judge

contentious.zh: 可能引起争论的；爱争论的；充满争吵的
contentious.en: likely to cause people to disagree; liking to argue; involving a lot of arguing

conviction.zh: 判罪；定罪；证明有罪；坚定的看法（或信念）；深信；坚信；坚定；肯定；有／没有勇气做自己认为正确的事
conviction.en: the act of finding somebody guilty of a crime in court; the fact of having been found guilty; a strong opinion or belief; the quality of showing that you believe strongly in what you are saying; to be/not be brave enough to do what you feel to be right

court martial.zh: 军事法庭；军事法庭的审判；军法审判
court martial.en: a military court that deals with members of the armed forces who break military law; a trial at such a court

critical mass.zh: （核链式反应的）临界质量；（启动或支持项目或活动所需的）最小资源量，最低人数；（项目或活动成功所需的）最小规模
critical mass.en: the smallest amount of a substance that is needed for a nuclear chain reaction to take place; the minimum amount of resources, number of customers, etc. needed to start or support a project or an activity, or the minimum size that a project or activity needs to be in order to be successful

cross section.zh: 横截面（图）；剖面（图）；断面（图）；典型的一群人（或事物）
cross section.en: what you see when you cut through the middle of something so that you can see the different layers it is made of; a drawing of this view; a group of people or things that are typical of a larger group

defamatory.en: intended to harm somebody by saying or writing bad or false things about them

defection.en: the act of leaving a political party, country, etc. to join another that is considered to be an enemy

deficiency.zh: 缺乏；缺少；不足；缺点；缺陷
deficiency.en: the state of not having, or not having enough of, something that is essential; a fault or a weakness in something/somebody that makes it or them less successful

delegate.zh: 代表；会议代表；参会人员；会议出席者；授（权）；把（工作、权力等）委托（给下级）；选派（某人做某事）
delegate.en: a person who is chosen or elected to represent the views of a group of people and vote and make decisions for them; a person who attends a conference; to give part of your work, power or authority to somebody in a lower position than you; to choose somebody to do something

deliberation.zh: 细想；考虑；商议；审议；（说话或办事）从容，审慎
deliberation.en: the process of carefully considering or discussing something; the quality of being slow and careful in what you say or do

delicacy.zh: 脆弱；娇嫩；仔细；温柔；周到；体贴；棘手；微妙；精美的食物；佳肴
delicacy.en: the fact of being, or appearing to be, easy to damage or break; the quality of being done carefully and gently; very careful behaviour in a difficult situation so that nobody is offended; the fact that a situation is difficult and somebody may be easily offended; a type of food considered to be very special in a particular place

democratization.zh: 民主化：使一个国家或一个机构更加民主的过程
democratization.en: the process of making a country or an institution more democratic

denial.zh: 否认；否定；拒绝给予，剥夺（应有的权利）；拒绝接受，拒不承认（令人不快、痛苦的事）
denial.en: a statement that something is not true or does not exist; the action of denying something; an act of refusing to allow somebody to have something they have a right to expect; the act of refusing to accept that something unpleasant or painful is true

deregulation.zh: 撤销对（贸易、商业活动等）的管制；解除控制
deregulation.en: the process of making a trade, business activity, etc. free from rules and controls

devaluation.zh: 使（货币）贬值；降低…的价值；贬低
devaluation.en: a reduction in the value of the money of one country when it is exchanged for the money of another country; the act of giving a lower value to something or making it seem less important than it really is

devolution.zh: （中央政府向地方政府的）权力下放，权力转移，分权
devolution.en: the act of giving power from a central authority or government to an authority or a government in a local region

diplomatic immunity.en: special rights given to diplomats working in a foreign country that mean they cannot be arrested, taxed, etc. in that country

discernment.en: the ability to show good judgement about the quality of somebody/something

discredit.zh: 败坏…的名声；使丧失信誉；使丢脸；使不相信；使怀疑；使不可置信；名誉丧失；信誉丧失；丢脸
discredit.en: to make people stop respecting somebody/something; to make people stop believing that something is true; to make something appear unlikely to be true; damage to somebody’s/something's reputation; loss of respect; a person or thing that causes damage to somebody's/something's reputation or loss of respect

discretion.zh: 自行决定的自由；自行决定权；谨慎；慎重；审慎；由某人斟酌决定；按照某人的意愿；谨慎即大勇；慎重为勇敢之本
discretion.en: the freedom or power to decide what should be done in a particular situation; care in what you say or do, in order to keep something secret or to avoid causing difficulty for somebody or making them feel embarrassed; the quality of being discreet; according to what somebody decides or wishes to do; you should avoid danger and not take unnecessary risks

disengagement.zh: 脱离接触：不再参与某人/某物或对他们/感兴趣的事实；年轻人脱离政治；社会上已经出现了一定程度的公众脱节现象。；脱离接触：停止战斗并离开的行为；部队脱离该地区
disengagement.en: the fact of no longer being involved with somebody/something or interested in them/it; the act of stopping fighting and moving away

disinformation.zh: （尤指政府机构故意发布的）虚假信息，假消息
disinformation.en: false information that is given deliberately

dispatch.zh: 派遣；调遣；派出；发出，发送（邮件、包裹、信息）；迅速处理；迅速办妥；迅速完成；杀死；处决；派遣；调遣；发送；（军事人员或政府官员之间的）急件，快信；（驻外国记者发给报刊的）新闻报道，电讯；迅速而有效
dispatch.en: to send somebody/something somewhere, especially for a special purpose; to send a letter, package or message somewhere; to deal or finish with somebody/something quickly and completely; to kill a person or an animal; the act of sending somebody/something somewhere; a message or report sent quickly from one military officer to another or between government officials; a report sent to a newspaper by a journalist who is working in a foreign country; quickly and efficiently

disproportionate.zh: 不成比例的；不相称的；太大（或太小）的
disproportionate.en: too large or too small when compared with something else

disproportionately.zh: 不成比例的；不相称的；太大（或太小）的
disproportionately.en: in a way that is too large or too small when compared with something else

disruption.en: a situation in which it is difficult for something to continue in the normal way; the act of stopping something from continuing in the normal way

distort.zh: 使变形；扭曲；使失真；歪曲；曲解
distort.en: to change the shape, appearance or sound of something so that it is strange or not clear; to change facts, ideas, etc. so that they are no longer correct or true

double standard.zh: 双重标准；双重道德标准
double standard.en: a rule or moral principle that is unfair because it is used in one situation, but not in another, or because it treats one group of people in a way that is different from the treatment of another

draw up.zh: （车辆）到达某处停下，停止；拟订；制订；起草
draw up.en: if a vehicle draws up, it arrives and stops; to make or write something that needs careful thought or planning

dubious.zh: 怀疑；无把握；拿不准；可疑的；不可信的；靠不住的；不诚实的；不确定的；不一定好的
dubious.en: not certain about something and suspecting that something may be wrong; not knowing whether something is good or bad; probably not honest; that you cannot be sure about; that is probably not good

economies of scale.en: are the financial advantages that a company gains when it produces large quantities of products.

editorial.zh: 编辑的；编者的；主编的；（报章的）社论；（美国电台或电视台的）评论
editorial.en: connected with the task of preparing something such as a newspaper, a book or a television or radio programme, to be published or broadcast; an important article in a newspaper that expresses the editor's opinion about an item of news or an issue; in the US also a comment on radio or television that expresses the opinion of the station or network

egalitarian.zh: 主张人人平等的；平等主义的
egalitarian.en: a person who believes that everyone is equal and should have the same rights and opportunities; based on, or holding, the belief that everyone is equal and should have the same rights and opportunities

eminent domain.en: the right to force somebody to sell land or a building if it is needed by the government

empathy.en: the ability to understand another person’s feelings, experience, etc.

emulate.zh: 努力赶上；向…看齐；仿真；模仿
emulate.en: to try to do something as well as somebody else because you admire them; to work in the same way as another computer, etc. and perform the same tasks

endorse.zh: （公开）赞同，支持，认可；（在广告中）宣传，代言（某一产品）；（在驾驶执照上）记录违章事项；（在支票背面）签名，背书
endorse.en: to say publicly that you support a person, statement or course of action; to say in an advertisement that you use and like a particular product so that other people will want to buy it; to put details of a driving offence on somebody’s driving record; to write your name on the back of a cheque so that it can be paid into a bank account

enormity.zh: 巨大；深远影响；严重性；滔天罪行；罪大恶极
enormity.en: the very great size, effect, etc. of something; the fact of something being very serious; a very serious crime

entanglement.zh: 瓜葛；牵连；纠缠；缠住；铁丝网（用以阻止敌人靠近）
entanglement.en: a difficult or complicated relationship with another person or country; the act of becoming caught or twisted in something; the state of being caught or twisted in something; barriers made of barbed wire, used to stop an enemy from getting close

epidemiology.en: the scientific study of the spread and control of diseases

equation.zh: 方程；方程式；等式；相等；等同看待；（多种因素的）平衡，综合体
equation.en: a statement showing that two amounts or values are equal, for example 2x + y = 54; the act of making something equal or considering something as equal (= of equating them); a problem or situation in which several things must be considered and dealt with

equity.zh: （公司的）股本；资产净值；（公司的）普通股；公平；公正；衡平法
equity.en: the value of a company’s shares; the value of a property after all charges and debts have been paid; shares in a company that do not pay a fixed amount of interest; a situation in which everyone is treated equally; a system of natural justice allowing a fair judgement in a situation which is not covered by the existing laws; the trade union for actors in the UK, the US and some other countries

equivalent.zh: 相等的东西；等量；对应词；（价值、数量、意义、重要性等）相等的，相同的
equivalent.en: a thing, amount, word, etc. that is equal in value, meaning or purpose to something else; equal in value, amount, meaning, importance, etc.

escalate.en: to become greater, worse, more serious, etc.; to make something greater, worse, more serious, etc.

execution.zh: 处决；实行；执行；实施；表演；（乐曲的）演奏；（艺术品的）制作；（尤指遗嘱的）执行；缓期执行
execution.en: the act of killing somebody, especially as a legal punishment; the act of doing a piece of work, performing a duty, or putting a plan into action; skill in performing or making something, such as a piece of music or work of art; the act of following the instructions in a legal document, especially those in somebody’s will; a delay in following the order of a court

existential.zh: 关于人类存在的；与人类存在有关的；（关于）存在主义的
existential.en: connected with human existence; connected with the theory of existentialism

expedient.zh: 权宜之计；应急办法；得当；可取；合宜；权宜之计
expedient.en: an action that is useful or necessary for a particular purpose, but not always fair or right; useful or necessary for a particular purpose, but not always fair or right

exponent.zh: （观点、理论等的）拥护者，鼓吹者，倡导者；（某种活动的）能手，大师；指数
exponent.en: a person who supports an idea, theory, etc. and persuades others that it is good; a person who is able to perform a particular activity with skill; a raised figure or symbol that shows how many times a quantity must be multiplied by itself, for example the figure 4 in a4

expropriation.en: the act of officially taking away private property from its owner for use by the government; the act of taking something that belongs to somebody and using it without permission

fabrication.en: false information that is invented in order to trick people; the act of inventing such information; the process of making or producing goods, equipment, etc. from various different materials

fathom.zh: 理解；彻底了解；弄清真相；英寻（计量水深的单位，合 6 英尺或 1.8 米）
fathom.en: to understand or find an explanation for something; a unit for measuring the depth of water, equal to 6 feet or 1.8 metres

felony.en: the act of committing a serious crime such as murder or rape; a crime of this type

fielding.en: the activity of catching and returning the ball

figure out.zh: 弄懂；弄清楚；弄明白；计算（数量或成本）
figure out.en: to think about somebody/something until you understand them/it; to calculate an amount or the cost of something

filibuster.zh: （议会中为拖延表决的）冗长演说
filibuster.en: a long speech made in a parliament in order to delay or prevent a vote; to make a long speech in parliament in order to delay or prevent a vote

foremost.zh: 最重要的；最著名的；最前的；首要的是；首先
foremost.en: the most important or famous; in a position at the front; more than anything else

formidable.zh: 可怕的；令人敬畏的；难对付的
formidable.en: if people, things or situations are formidable, you feel fear and/or respect for them, because they are impressive or powerful, or because they seem very difficult

friendly fire.zh: 误杀，误伤（战争中由己方或友军造成的死伤）
friendly fire.en: in a war, if people are killed or injured by friendly fire, they are hit by a bomb or weapon that is fired by their own side

furlough.zh: （尤指在国外服役士兵的）休假（许可）；（犯人的）准假；（通常因发不出工资而给的）准假
furlough.en: to give somebody permission to leave their duties for a period of time, especially soldiers working in a foreign country; to give a prisoner permission to leave a prison for a period of time; to tell workers not to come to work for a period of time, usually because there is not enough money to pay them; permission to leave your duties for a period of time, especially for soldiers working in a foreign country; permission for a prisoner to leave prison for a period of time; a period of time during which workers are told not to come to work, usually because there is not enough money to pay them

galvanized.zh: 尤指钢铁电镀的，镀锌的；galvanized
galvanized.en: metal, especially iron and steel, has been covered with zinc in order to protect it from rust and other damage.

gamut.zh: 整个范围；全部；gamut；涉及…的全部范围
gamut.en: something is the complete range of things of that kind, or a wide variety of things of that kind.; To something means to include, express, or experience all the different things of that kind, or a wide variety of them.

gap year.zh: 空缺年（常指中学毕业后上大学前所休的一年假期，用于实习或旅游）
gap year.en: a year that a young person spends working and/or travelling, often between leaving school and starting university

genius.zh: 天才；天资；天赋；天才人物；（某领域的）天才；（特别的）才能，本领；给人以好（或坏）影响的人；保护（或毁灭）人的神魔
genius.en: unusually great intelligence, skill or artistic ability; a person who is unusually intelligent or artistic, or who has a very high level of skill, especially in one area; a special skill or ability; a person or spirit who is thought to have a good/bad influence over you; showing unusually great intelligence, skill or artistic ability

genocide.en: the murder of a large group of people, especially those of a particular nation or race

gentrification.zh: 高档化：改善城镇或城市面积，以吸引比以前更高社会阶层的人的过程；曼哈顿郊外某些社区的迅速绅士化；足球经历了高级化。
gentrification.en: the process of improving an area of a town or city so that it attracts people of a higher social class than before; the process of improving somebody's manners, a way of life or an activity so they become acceptable to people of a higher social class than before

geospatial.zh: 地理空间：与特定位置相关的信息有关；地理空间数据/信息
geospatial.en: relating to information that is associated with a particular location

glass ceiling.zh: 玻璃天花板（女性或某些群体的人在职场升迁上遇到的无形限制或障碍）
glass ceiling.en: the way in which unfair attitudes can stop women, or other groups, from getting the best jobs in a company, etc. although there are no official rules to prevent them from getting these jobs

globalization.zh: 全球化，全世界化（世界各地的文化和经济体系日益关联）
globalization.en: the fact that different cultures and economic systems around the world are becoming connected and similar to each other because of the influence of large multinational companies and of improved communication

go along.en: to continue with an activity; to make progress; to develop

gold standard.zh: 金本位制；黄金标准；典范
gold standard.en: an economic system in which the value of money is based on the value of gold; a high level of quality that others try to copy

green light.en: permission for a project, etc. to start or continue

greenhouse gas.zh: 温室气体（尤指二氧化碳）
greenhouse gas.en: any of the gases that are thought to cause the greenhouse effect, especially carbon dioxide

gross domestic product.zh: 国内生产总值：一个国家一年内生产的所有商品和服务的总价值
gross domestic product.en: the total value of all the goods and services produced by a country in one year

hard-wired.zh: 计算机系统硬接线的，硬连线的；能力、方法、活动类型基本的，固有的，无法改变的；hard-wired
hard-wired.en: A part of a computer forms part of its hardware.; If an ability, approach, or type of activity is the brain, it is a basic one and cannot be changed.

heavy metal.en: a type of rock music with a very strong beat played very loud on electric guitars, often using violent or strange language or ideas; a metal that has a very high density (= the relation of its weight to its volume), such as gold or lead

hindsight.en: the understanding that you have of a situation only after it has happened and that means you would have done things in a different way

hoard.zh: （钱、食物、贵重物品等的）贮存，聚藏；（尤指）秘藏；贮藏；囤积；（尤指）秘藏
hoard.en: a collection of money, food, valuable objects, etc., especially one that somebody keeps in a secret place so that other people will not find or steal it; to collect and keep large amounts of food, money, etc., often secretly

house of cards.zh: 不可靠的计划；摇摇欲坠的组织；用纸牌搭成的房子
house of cards.en: a plan, an organization, etc. that is so badly arranged that it could easily fail; a structure built out of playing cards

impeccably.zh: 无错误的；无瑕疵的；完美的
impeccably.en: in a way that has no mistakes or faults

imperative.zh: 重要紧急的；迫切的；急需处理的；表示权威的；表示命令的；祈使的；重要紧急的事；必要的事；祈使语气；祈使语气动词
imperative.en: very important and needing immediate attention or action; expressing authority; expressing an order; a thing that is very important and needs immediate attention or action; a factor that makes something necessary; the form of a verb that expresses an order; a verb in this form

impunity.zh: 免于惩罚；不受惩处；逃过惩罚
impunity.en: the fact of not getting punished for something

incidence.zh: 发生范围；影响程度；发生率；入射（角）
incidence.en: the extent to which something happens or has an effect; the way in which light meets a surface

inexorable.zh: 不可阻挡的；无法改变的
inexorable.en: that cannot be stopped or changed

influence peddling.en: the illegal activity of a politician doing something for somebody in return for payment

inherently.zh: 固有地：根据或由于某人/某物的基本性质而固有地
inherently.en: according to or because of the basic nature of somebody/something

insider trading.zh: 内线交易，内幕交易（根据内线消息买卖股票的违法行为）
insider trading.en: the crime of buying or selling shares in a company with the help of information known only by those connected with the business, before this information is available to everybody

insular.zh: 只关心本国利益的；思想褊狭的；保守的；海岛的；岛屿的
insular.en: only interested in your own country, ideas, etc. and not in those from outside; having little contact with other people; connected with an island or islands

integrated.zh: 各部分密切协调的；综合的；完整统一的
integrated.en: in which many different parts are closely connected and work successfully together; including people from all groups, races, religions, etc.

intervene.zh: 出面；介入；插嘴；打断（别人的话）；阻碍；阻挠；干扰；介于…之间
intervene.en: to become involved in a situation in order to improve or help it; to interrupt somebody when they are speaking in order to say something; to happen in a way that delays something or prevents it from happening; to exist between two events or places

intricate.en: having a lot of different parts and small details that fit together

invoke.zh: 援引，援用（法律、规则等作为行动理由）；提及，援引（某人、某理论、实例等作为支持）；提出（某人的名字，以激发某种感觉或行动）；向（某人）请求帮助；（尤指）祈求神助；使产生，唤起，引起（感情或想象）；调用；激活；用法术召唤（魔鬼）
invoke.en: to mention or use a law, rule, etc. as a reason for doing something; to mention a person, a theory, an example, etc. to support your opinions or ideas, or as a reason for something; to mention somebody’s name to make people feel a particular thing or act in a particular way; to make a request (for help) to somebody, especially a god; to make somebody have a particular feeling or imagine a particular scene; to begin to run a program, etc.; to make evil appear by using magic

ironically.zh: 反语的；讽刺的；（因出乎意料而）奇怪的，好笑的
ironically.en: in a way that shows that you really mean the opposite of what you are saying; in a way that expresses irony; in a way that is strange or funny because it is very different from what you expect

irrationality.zh: 不合逻辑的；没有道理的
irrationality.en: the fact of not being based on, or not using, clear logical thought

jeopardize.zh: 冒…的危险；危及；危害；损害
jeopardize.en: to risk harming or destroying something/somebody

lash out.zh: （突然）狠打，痛打；怒斥；严厉斥责
lash out.en: to suddenly try to hit somebody/something; to criticize somebody in an angry way

latitude.zh: 纬度；纬度地区；选择（做什么事或做事方式）的自由
latitude.en: the distance of a place north or south of the equator (= the line around the world dividing north and south), measured in degrees; a region of the world that is a particular distance from the equator; freedom to choose what you do or the way that you do it

lay off.zh: （让人停止做某事）停止，别再打扰；停止使用；（因工作不多而）解雇
lay off.en: used to tell somebody to stop doing something; to stop using something; to stop employing somebody because there is not enough work for them to do

league table.zh: （运动队的）积分排名表；（学校、医院等的）排名表
league table.en: a table that shows the position of sports teams and how successfully they are performing in a competition; a table that shows how well institutions such as schools or hospitals are performing in comparison with each other

legacy.zh: 遗产；遗赠财物；遗留问题；后遗症；（计算机系统或产品）已停产的，老化的，老式的
legacy.en: money or property that is given to you by somebody when they die; a situation that exists now because of events, actions, etc. that took place in the past; something that somebody has done successfully and that has positive effects even after they retire or die; the idea that something created for an event in the past can be used in a different way in the future; used to describe a computer system or product that is no longer available to buy but is still used because it would be too difficult or expensive to replace it; created to be remembered and to have an effect that continues into the future

legislate.en: to make a law affecting something

lens.zh: 透镜；镜片；（眼球的）晶状体
lens.en: a curved piece of glass or plastic that makes things look larger, smaller or clearer when you look through it; a piece of equipment that is part of a camera, containing one or more lenses; a contact lens (= a small round piece of thin plastic that you put on your eye to help you see better); the clear part of the eye, behind the pupil, that focuses light so that you can see clearly

litany.zh: 连祷文，总祷文（连祷启应的祷文）；（对一系列事件、原因等）枯燥冗长的陈述
litany.en: a series of prayers to God for use in church services, spoken by a priest, etc., with set responses by the people; a long boring account of a series of events, reasons, etc.

livelihood.en: a means of earning money in order to live

lock in.zh: 把…锁在屋里；把…关押起来
lock in.en: to prevent somebody from leaving a place by locking the door

makeup.zh: 化妆品；makeup；天性；性格；组成成分；构成方式
makeup.en: consists of things such as lipstick, eye shadow, and powder which some women put on their faces to make themselves look more attractive or which actors use to change or improve their appearance.; Some-one's is their nature and the various qualities in their character.; The of something consists of its different parts and the way these parts are arranged.

manifesto.en: a written statement in which a group of people explain their beliefs and aims, especially one published by a political party to say what they will do if they win an election

manipulate.zh: （暗中）控制，操纵，影响；（熟练地）操作，使用；正骨；治疗脱臼
manipulate.en: to control or influence somebody/something, often in a dishonest way so that they do not realize it; to control, use or change something with skill; to move a person’s bones or joints into the correct position

market capitalization.zh: 市值：公司在股票市场上买卖的价值，计算方法是将股份总数乘以当前股价；该公司股价上周五收于18便士，市值为915万英镑。
market capitalization.en: the value of a company that is bought and sold on the stock market, calculated by multiplying the total number of shares by the present share price

matriculation.zh: （正式）被大学录取；注册入大学；（从学校）毕业
matriculation.en: the act of officially becoming a student at a university; the successful completion of the final year of school

mechanical.zh: 机动的；机械驱动的；机械的；机器的；机械的；发动机的；机械般的；呆头呆脑的；无思想的；机械的；机械学的；擅长于机械原理的
mechanical.en: operated by power from an engine; relating to machines and engines; done without thinking, like a machine; connected with the physical laws of movement and cause and effect (= with mechanics); good at understanding how machines work

meritocracy.zh: 精英领导体制；英才管理制度；精英管理班子
meritocracy.en: a country or social system where people get power or money on the basis of their ability; the group of people with power in this kind of social system

migration.zh: 迁移；移居；迁徙；（程序或硬件的）迁移，转移；（计算机系统的）改变
migration.en: the movement every year of large numbers of birds or animals from one place to another; the movement of people to a new country or area in order to find work or better living conditions; the act of moving programs, etc. from one computer system to another; the fact of changing from one computer system to another

milestone.zh: 重要事件；重要阶段；转折点；里程碑；里程碑
milestone.en: a very important stage or event in the development of something; a stone by the side of a road that shows how far it is to the next town and to other places

mimic.zh: 模仿（某人的言行举止）；（尤指）做滑稽模仿；（外表或行为举止）像，似；会模仿的人（或动物）
mimic.en: to copy the way somebody speaks, moves, behaves, etc., especially in order to make other people laugh; to look or behave like something else; a person or an animal that can copy the voice, movements, etc. of others

misdirection.zh: 误导：故意发布错误的信息，以阻止人们了解有关情况的真相；没有理由认为白宫有误导之嫌。；误导：法官向陪审团提供错误的法律信息的行为；法官没有告知他们该责任，被认为是误导。；线索和误导一个接一个地迅速出现。；《哭泣的游戏》是一部迷恋误导的电影。
misdirection.en: the deliberate release of wrong information in order to stop people from knowing the truth about a situation; the act of giving wrong information about the law by a judge to a jury (= the group of people who decide if somebody is guilty of a crime); the act of giving wrong information in a film, story, magic act, etc. to make people expect something that does not happen, so that they will be surprised at what actually happens

mobilize.zh: 组织；鼓动；动员；调动；调用；（战时）动员
mobilize.en: to work together in order to achieve a particular aim; to organize a group of people to do this; to find and start to use something that is needed for a particular purpose; if a country mobilizes its army, or if a country or army mobilizes, it makes itself ready to fight in a war

modelling.zh: （时装）模特儿工作，模特儿表演；（实物）模型制造；系统模型化；系统模型的建立
modelling.en: the work of a fashion model; the activity of making models of objects; the work of making a simple description of a system or a process that can be used to explain it, etc.

monetize.zh: 获利：从某物，尤其是企业或资产中赚钱；报纸尝试通过几种方式通过在线内容获利。
monetize.en: to earn money from something, especially a business or an asset (= something that a business owns)

mortality.zh: 生命的有限；死亡数量；死亡率；死亡
mortality.en: the state of being human and not living forever; the number of deaths in a particular situation or period of time; a death

mortgage.zh: 按揭（由银行等提供房产等的抵押借款）；按揭贷款；（向银行等）抵押（房地产）
mortgage.en: a legal agreement by which a bank or similar organization lends you money to buy a house, etc., and you pay the money back over a particular number of years; the sum of money that you borrow; to give a bank, etc. the legal right to own your house, land, etc. if you do not pay the money back that you have borrowed from the bank to buy the house or land

nadir.en: the worst moment of a particular situation

nationalist.zh: 国家主义者；民族主义者；怀有本民族优越感者
nationalist.en: wanting your country to become independent; loving your country very much and being very proud of it; feeling that your country is better than any other; a person who wants their country to become independent; a person who loves their country very much and is very proud of it; a person who feels that their country is better than any other

naturalist.en: a person who studies animals, plants, birds and other living things

neoliberal.zh: 新自由主义的（主张不受政府调控的全球自由市场，工商企业由私有者经营以获利）
neoliberal.en: relating to a type of liberalism that believes in a global free market, without government regulation, with businesses and industry controlled and run for profit by private owners

neoliberalism.zh: 政治；近几十年来，新自由主义改变了经济。
neoliberalism.en: a type of liberalism that favours a global free market, without government regulation, with businesses and industry controlled and run for profit by private owners

net neutrality.zh: 从根本上说，网络中立大约等于对互联网的访问。
net neutrality.en: the principle that internet service providers should allow access to all websites and programs without trying to block or promote particular sites or products

non-binding.zh: 不具约束力：不一定非要依法遵守；全民投票的结果没有约束力。；他提出了无约束力的合同。
non-binding.en: that not does not have to be obeyed according to the law

nostalgia.en: a sad feeling mixed with pleasure when you think of happy times in the past

notorious.zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

nuance.zh: （意义、声音、颜色、感情等方面的）细微差别
nuance.en: a very slight difference in meaning, sound, colour or somebody’s feelings that is not usually very obvious

oblique.zh: 间接的；不直截了当的；拐弯抹角的；斜的；倾斜的；斜角；斜杠；斜线号
oblique.en: not expressed or done in a direct way; sloping at an angle; greater or less than 90°; the symbol (/) used to show alternatives, as in lunch and/or dinner and 4/5 people and to write fractions, as in ¾

obsolete.en: no longer used because something new has been invented

offensive.zh: 冒犯的；得罪人的；无礼的；极其讨厌的；令人不适的；攻击性的；进攻性的；攻方的；进攻型的；攻击型的；进攻；攻击；侵犯；（引人注意的）系列行动；运动；攻势；发动攻势；主动出击；先发制人
offensive.en: rude in a way that causes somebody to feel upset or annoyed because it shows a lack of respect; extremely unpleasant; connected with the act of attacking somebody/something; connected with the team that has control of the ball; connected with the act of scoring points; a military operation in which large numbers of soldiers, etc. attack another country; a series of actions aimed at achieving something in a way that attracts a lot of attention; to be attacking somebody/something rather than waiting for them to attack you; to start attacking somebody/something before they start attacking you

offset.en: to use one cost, payment or situation in order to cancel or reduce the effect of another; used to describe a method of printing in which ink (= coloured liquid) is put onto a metal plate, then onto a rubber surface and only then onto the paper

one-size-fits-all.en: designed to be suitable for a wide range of situations or needs

opt out.zh: 决定退出；选择不参与；选择不受地方当局管理
opt out.en: to choose not to take part in something; to choose not to be under the control of the local authority

organized crime.en: refers to criminal activities which involve large numbers of people and are organized and controlled by a small group.
