ostentatious.zh: 摆阔的；铺张的；浮华的；夸张的；招摇的
ostentatious.en: showing your wealth or status in a way that is intended to impress people; done in a very obvious way so that people will notice it

outcry.en: a reaction of anger or strong protest shown by people in public

palatable.zh: 可口的；味美的；宜人的；可意的；可接受的
palatable.en: having a pleasant or acceptable taste; pleasant or acceptable to somebody

paradigm.zh: 范式；范例；典范；样式；词形变化表
paradigm.en: a typical example or pattern of something; a set of all the different forms of a word

paradoxical.zh: 矛盾的人（或事物、情况）；似非而是的隽语；悖论；悖论修辞
paradoxical.en: having two opposite features and therefore seeming strange; containing two opposite ideas that make it seem impossible or unlikely, although it is probably true

paradoxically.en: in a way that seems strange, impossible or unlikely because it has two opposite features or contains two opposite ideas

paralysis.zh: 麻痹；瘫痪；（活动、工作等）能力的完全丧失，瘫痪
paralysis.en: a loss of control of, and sometimes feeling in, part or most of the body, caused by disease or an injury to the nerves; the condition of being unable to move, act, function, etc.

parameter.en: something that decides or limits the way in which something can be done

partisanship.zh: （对个别人、团体或思想）过分支持的，偏护的，盲目拥护的
partisanship.en: the fact of showing too much support for one person, group or idea, especially without considering it carefully

patriarchy.zh: 男性统治的社会（或制度、国家）；男权政治；父权制
patriarchy.en: a society, system or country that is ruled or controlled by men

pedagogical.en: means concerning the methods and theory of teaching.

perjury.en: the crime of telling a lie in court after you have sworn to tell the truth

phase out.en: to stop using something gradually in stages over a period of time

phonics.en: a method of teaching people to read based on the sounds that letters represent

pivotal.en: of great importance because other things depend on it

plummet.en: to fall suddenly and quickly from a high level or position

poach.zh: 水煮，炖，煨（尤指鱼）；水煮（荷包蛋）；（在他人地界）偷猎，偷捕；盗用；挖走（人员等）
poach.en: to cook food, especially fish, gently in a small amount of liquid; to cook an egg gently in nearly boiling water after removing its shell; to illegally hunt birds, animals or fish on somebody else’s property or without permission; to take and use somebody/something that belongs to somebody/something else, especially in a secret, dishonest or unfair way

poignant.zh: 令人沉痛的；悲惨的；酸楚的
poignant.en: having a strong effect on your feelings, especially in a way that makes you feel sad

polarization.zh: （使）两极化，截然对立；使（光波等）偏振；使（物体）极化
polarization.en: the act of separating or making people separate into two groups with completely opposite opinions; the fact of waves of light, etc. vibrating in a single direction; the fact of giving polarity to something

polemic.zh: 激烈争论；辩论文章；论战；辩论术；辩论法
polemic.en: a speech or a piece of writing that argues very strongly for or against something/somebody; the practice or skill of arguing strongly for or against something/somebody

polymer.en: a substance consisting of large molecules (= groups of atoms) that are made from combinations of small simple molecules

pose.zh: 造成（威胁、问题等）；引起；产生；提问；质询；（为画像、摄影）摆好姿势；佯装；冒充；假扮；招摇；炫耀；拿姿作态；（为画像、拍照等摆的）姿势；装腔作势；故作姿态；摆出某种姿态
pose.en: to create a threat, problem, etc. that has to be dealt with; to ask a question, especially one that needs serious thought; to sit or stand in a particular position in order to be painted, drawn or photographed; to pretend to be somebody in order to trick other people; to dress or behave in a way that is intended to impress other people; a particular position in which somebody stands, sits, etc., especially in order to be painted, drawn or photographed; a way of behaving that is not sincere and is intended to impress or trick people; to hold your body in a particular way to create a particular impression

positively.zh: 绝对地；肯定地；乐观地；肯定地；积极地；赞成地；积极地；明确地；明白无误地；带（或产生）正电地
positively.en: used to emphasize the truth of a statement, especially when this is surprising or when it contrasts with a previous statement; in a way that shows you are thinking of the good things about a situation, not the bad; in a way that shows you approve of or agree with something/somebody; in a way that leaves no possibility of doubt; in a way that contains or produces the type of electricity that is opposite to that carried by an electron

pragmatism.zh: 实用主义；务实思想；实用观点
pragmatism.en: thinking about solving problems in a practical and sensible way rather than by having fixed ideas and theories

precede.zh: 在…之前发生（或出现）；先于；走在…前面；以…开始（或引导）
precede.en: to happen before something or come before something/somebody in order; to go in front of somebody; to do or say something to introduce something else

preclude.zh: 使行不通；阻止；妨碍；排除
preclude.en: to prevent something from happening or somebody from doing something; to make something impossible

prerequisite.zh: 先决条件；前提；必备条件
prerequisite.en: that must exist or happen before something else can happen or be done; something that must exist or happen before something else can happen or be done

prestige.zh: 威信；声望；威望；令人敬仰的；受尊重的；重要的；名贵的；贵重的；讲究派头的
prestige.en: the respect and value that somebody/something has because of their social position, or what they have done; that brings respect and importance; admired and respected because it looks important and expensive

primary care.phonetic: /ˌpraɪməri ˈkeə(r)/ | /ˌpraɪmeri ˈker/ | /ˌpraɪməri ˈhelθ keə(r)/ | /ˌpraɪmeri ˈhelθ ker/
primary care.zh: 初级护理；基础医疗；初始的治疗
primary care.en: the medical treatment that you receive first when you are ill, for example from your family doctor

principal.zh: 最重要的；主要的；大学校长；学院院长；（中小学）校长；本金；资本；主要演员；主角；（尤指商务或法律事务的）当事人，委托人
principal.en: most important; main; the person who is in charge of a college or (in Scotland and Canada) a university; a teacher who is in charge of a school; an amount of money that you lend to somebody or invest to earn interest; the person who has the most important part in a play, an opera, etc.; a person that you are representing, especially in business or law

prioritize.zh: 按重要性排列；划分优先顺序；优先处理
prioritize.en: to put tasks, problems, etc. in order of importance, so that you can deal with the most important first; to treat something as being more important than other things

propagate.en: to spread an idea, a belief or a piece of information among many people; to produce new plants from a parent plant

prospectus.zh: （学校的）简章，简介；（企业的）招股说明书，募股章程
prospectus.en: a book, document or web page that gives information about a school, college, etc. in order to advertise it; a document that gives information about a company’s shares before they are offered for sale

provocative.zh: 挑衅的；煽动性的；激起争端的；引诱的；激起性欲的
provocative.en: intended to make people angry or upset; intended to make people argue about something; intended to make somebody sexually excited

pruning.zh: 修剪树枝；打杈；裁减；削减；精简
pruning.en: the activity of cutting off some of the branches from a tree, bush, etc. so that it will grow better and stronger; the act of making something smaller by removing parts; the act of cutting out parts of something

purview.zh: 在（个人或组织等的）权限之内／之外；在（文件、法律等的）范围内／外
purview.en: within/outside the limits of what a person, an organization, etc. is responsible for; dealt/ not dealt with by a document, law, etc.

put-down.zh: 令人难堪的话；噎人的话
put-down.en: a remark or criticism that is intended to make somebody look or feel stupid

quantitative easing.zh: 量化宽松（由中央银行引入新资金，增加国家货币供应量的货币政策）
quantitative easing.en: the introduction of new money into a country’s money supply by a central bank

queer.zh: 奇怪的；反常的；娘儿们似的；妖里妖气的；古怪的人；有些荒唐的人；同性恋者；假娘儿们；破坏…的计划（或机会）
queer.en: strange or unusual; an offensive way of describing a gay person, especially a man, which is, however, also used by some gay people about themselves; a person who is slightly strange or crazy; an offensive word for a gay person, especially a man, which is, however, also used by some gay people about themselves; to cause somebody’s plans to fail or to destroy their chances of getting something

rank and file.zh: 团体、公司等的普通成员，普通职员；rank and file
rank and file.en: are the ordinary members of an organization or the ordinary workers in a company, as opposed to its leaders or managers.

rapprochement.en: a situation in which the relationship between two countries or groups of people becomes more friendly after a period during which they were enemies

reciprocal.en: involving two people or groups who agree to help each other or behave in the same way to each other

reconcile.zh: 使和谐一致；调和；使配合；使和解；使和好如初；将就；妥协
reconcile.en: to find an acceptable way of dealing with two or more ideas, needs, etc. that seem to be opposed to each other; to make people become friends again after an argument or a disagreement; to make somebody/yourself accept an unpleasant situation because it is not possible to change it

recoup.en: to get back an amount of money that you have spent or lost

rectify.en: to put right something that is wrong

redundant.zh: 被裁减的；多余的；不需要的
redundant.en: without a job because there is no more work available for you in a company; not needed or useful

refrain.zh: 克制；节制；避免；经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；副歌；迭歌；迭句
refrain.en: to stop yourself from doing something, especially something that you want to do; a comment or complaint that is often repeated; the part of a song or a poem that is repeated after each verse

rekindle.en: to make a feeling or relationship become active again

remand.zh: 将（嫌疑人）还押候审；还押；押候
remand.en: to send somebody away from a court to wait for their trial which will take place at a later date; the process of keeping somebody in prison while they are waiting for their trial

reprisal.en: a violent or aggressive act towards somebody because of something bad that they have done towards you

resonate.zh: 产生共鸣；发出回响；回荡；（使）回响，起回声；使产生联想；引起共鸣；和…的想法（或观念）类似；充满
resonate.en: to make a deep, clear sound that continues for a long time; to be filled with sound; to make a sound continue longer; to remind somebody of something; to be similar to what somebody thinks or believes; to be full of a particular quality or feeling

respectively.zh: 分别；各自；顺序为；依次为
respectively.en: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned

revoke.en: to officially cancel something so that it is no longer legally acceptable

rift.zh: 分裂；分歧；严重不和；断裂；裂缝；裂口
rift.en: a serious break in the relationship between people or organizations; a large break or opening in the ground, rocks or clouds

rigour.zh: 谨慎；缜密；严谨；严格；严厉；艰苦；严酷
rigour.en: the fact of being careful and paying great attention to detail; the fact of being strict or severe; the difficulties and unpleasant conditions of something

robotics.en: the science of designing and operating robots

roll back.zh: 降低，削减（价格等）；击退；使后退
roll back.en: to to reduce the power or importance of something; to reverse the progress made with something; to push something further away; to reduce prices, etc.

roll out.zh: 将…轧平；正式推出（新产品）；开展（新的政治运动）
roll out.en: to make something flat by pushing something over it; to officially make a new product available or start a new political campaign

rollback.zh: （价格或工资等的）下跌，回落；（情形、法律等的）回复，恢复
rollback.en: a reduction in a price or in pay, to a past level; the act of changing a situation, law, etc. back to what it was before

rule of law.en: refers to a situation in which the people in a society obey its laws and enable it to function properly.

salient.zh: 最重要的；显著的；突出的
salient.en: most important or easy to notice

scale up.en: to increase the size or number of something

scrutinize.zh: 仔细查看；认真检查；细致审查
scrutinize.en: to look at or examine somebody/something carefully

seasoned.zh: 富有经验的；老于此道的；调好味的；加了作料的；风干的，晾干的（可加工使用）
seasoned.en: having a lot of experience of a particular activity; with salt, pepper, etc. added to it; made suitable for use by being left outside

sedition.zh: 煽动叛乱的言论（或行动）
sedition.en: the use of words or actions that are intended to encourage people to oppose a government

sheer.zh: （用来强调事物的大小、程度或数量）；完全的；纯粹的；十足的；陡峭的；又薄又轻几乎透明的；垂直地；陡峭地
sheer.en: used to emphasize the size, degree or amount of something; complete and not mixed with anything else; very steep; thin, light and almost transparent; straight up or down

shirk.en: to avoid doing something you should do, especially because you are too lazy

singular.zh: 单数；单数形式；单数的；单数形式的；非凡的；突出的；显著的；奇特的；奇怪的；异常的
singular.en: a form of a noun or verb that refers to one person or thing; connected with or having the singular form; very great or obvious; unusual; strange

solicitor general.zh: （英国）副检察长；（美国）司法部副部长
solicitor general.en: a senior legal officer in England and Wales or the US, next in rank below the attorney general

stagnation.zh: 停滞；不发展；不进步；（水或空气）不流动而污浊的
stagnation.en: the fact of no longer developing or making progress; the fact of not moving and therefore smelling unpleasant

stance.zh: （公开表明的）观点，态度，立场；（尤指体育运动中的）站立姿势
stance.en: the opinions that somebody has about something and expresses publicly; the way in which somebody stands, especially when playing a sport

stand-off.en: a situation in which no agreement can be reached

standing.zh: 站着进行的；长期存在的；永久性的；常设的；地位；级别；身份；名声；持续时间；（运动员或运动队比赛成绩的）排名，名次
standing.en: done from a position in which you are standing rather than sitting or running; existing or arranged permanently, not formed or made for a particular situation; from an initial position in which none of the necessary elements are in place; the position or reputation of somebody/something within a group of people or in an organization; the period of time that something has existed; a list of people, teams, etc. showing their positions in a sports competition

stash.zh: 存放；贮藏；隐藏；一批贮藏物
stash.en: to store something in a safe or secret place; an amount of something that is kept secretly

stave off.zh: 暂时挡住（坏事）；延缓，推迟（某事物）
stave off.en: to prevent something bad from affecting you for a period of time; to delay something

step up.zh: 走上前去；增加，提高（数量、速度等）
step up.en: to come forward; to increase the amount, speed, etc. of something

stereotypical.zh: 模式化观念（或形象）；老一套；刻板印象
stereotypical.en: based on a fixed idea or image that many people have of a particular type of person or thing, but which is often not true in reality

stick shift.zh: 变速杆；换挡杆；手动变速车
stick shift.en: a handle used to change the gears of a vehicle; a vehicle that has a stick shift

stratification.en: the division of something into different layers or groups

structural.en: connected with the way in which something is built or organized

subscribe to.en: to agree with or support an opinion, a theory, etc.

substantive.zh: 实质性的；本质上的；重大的；严肃认真的；名词
substantive.en: dealing with real, important or serious matters; a noun

summit.zh: 最高点；顶点；山顶；（政府间的）首脑会议；峰会
summit.en: the highest point of something, especially the top of a mountain; an official meeting or series of meetings between the leaders of two or more governments at which they discuss important matters

sunset provision.zh: 落日条款（法律、规定或协议中说明自某日期起即行废止的条款）
sunset provision.en: part of a law, a rule or an agreement that states that it will no longer apply from a particular date

surge.zh: （强烈感情的）突发；（数量的）急剧上升，激增；大量；一大批；奔涌向前；突然的向上运动；（电流）浪涌；涌；汹涌；涌动；使强烈地感到；急剧上升；飞涨；激增；浪涌
surge.en: a sudden increase of a strong feeling; a sudden increase in the amount or number of something; a sudden, strong movement forward or upwards; a sudden increase in the flow of electrical power through a system; to move quickly and with force in a particular direction; to fill somebody with a strong feeling; to suddenly increase in value; to increase suddenly

sweep away.zh: 使某人醉心；驱使某人专注；消灭；彻底消除；完全打消
sweep away.en: to make somebody very interested or involved in something, especially in a way that makes them forget everything else; to get rid of something completely

sweeping.zh: 影响广泛的；大范围的；根本性的；（过分）笼统的；一概而论的；（在投票等中的）大胜，全胜；弧线的；弯曲的
sweeping.en: having an important effect on a large part of something; too general and failing to think about or understand particular examples; a victory by a large number of votes, etc.; forming a curved shape

tame.zh: 养驯的；驯服的；平淡无奇的；枯燥乏味的；听使唤的；温顺的；驯化；驯服；使易于控制
tame.en: not afraid of people, and used to living with them; not interesting or exciting; willing to do what other people ask; to make an animal, bird, etc. not afraid of people and used to living with them; to make an emotion, an organization, a situation, etc., less powerful or easier to control

temper.zh: 脾气；易怒的性情；怒气；火气；阵怒；心情；情绪；性情；心境；有…脾气的；心情…的；性子急；容易发脾气；发脾气；忍住怒火；使缓和；使温和；使（金属）回火
temper.en: if somebody has a temper, they become angry very easily; a short period of feeling very angry; the way that you are feeling at a particular time; having a particular type of temper; to become angry easily; to fail/manage to control your anger; to make something less severe by adding something that has the opposite effect; to make metal as hard as it needs to be by heating and then cooling it

test case.zh: （判决同类案件可援用的）判例
test case.en: a legal case or other situation whose result will be used as an example when decisions are being made on similar cases in the future

thesis.zh: 论文；毕业论文；学位论文；命题；论题
thesis.en: a long piece of writing completed by a student as part of a university degree, based on their own research; a statement or an opinion that is discussed in a logical way and presented with evidence in order to prove that it is true

threatened.zh: 受到威胁的；感到危险的；threatened
threatened.en: ; If you feel , you feel as if someone is trying to harm you.

time bomb.zh: 定时炸弹；潜在危险；隐患
time bomb.en: a bomb that can be set to explode at a particular time; a situation that is likely to cause serious problems in the future

tolerance.zh: 忍受；容忍；宽容；宽恕；忍耐力；忍受性；耐力；耐量；公差；容限
tolerance.en: the quality of being willing to accept or tolerate somebody/something, especially opinions or behaviour that you may not agree with, or people who are not like you; the ability to suffer something, especially pain, difficult conditions, etc. without being harmed; the amount by which the measurement of a value can vary without causing problems

torch.zh: 手电筒；喷灯；火炬；火把；爱上（尤指单相思）；痴恋；将…付之一炬；放火烧，纵火烧（建筑物或汽车）
torch.en: a small electric lamp that you can hold in your hand and carry with you; a tool for directing a very hot flame onto part of a surface, for example to remove paint; a long stick that has material at one end that is set on fire and that people carry to give light; to be in love with somebody, especially somebody who does not love you in return; to set fire to something deliberately; to set fire to a building or vehicle deliberately in order to destroy it

transcend.en: to be or go beyond the usual limits of something

trump card.zh: （某些纸牌游戏的一张）王牌，主牌，将牌；王牌；绝招；杀手锏
trump card.en: (in some card games) a card that belongs to the suit (= one of the four sets in a pack of cards) that has been chosen for a particular game to have a higher value than the other three suits; something that gives you an advantage over other people, especially when they do not know what it is and you are able to use it to surprise them

turn on.zh: 突然攻击；依靠；依…而定；取决于；以…为主题；使性兴奋；使感兴趣；使对…感兴趣；使首次使用；接通（电流、煤气、水等）；打开
turn on.en: to attack somebody suddenly and unexpectedly; to depend on something; to have something as its main topic; to make somebody excited or interested, especially sexually; to make somebody become interested in something or to use something for the first time; to start the flow of electricity, gas, water, etc. by moving a switch, button, etc.

turning point.en: the time when an important change takes place, usually with the result that a situation improves

turnout.zh: 出席人数；到场人数；投票人数
turnout.en: the number of people who attend a particular event; the number of people who vote in a particular election

ubiquity.zh: 似乎无所不在的；十分普遍的
ubiquity.en: the fact that something seems to be everywhere or in several places at the same time; the fact that something is very common

ultimatum.en: a final warning to a person or country that if they do not do what you ask, you will use force or take action against them

unassailable.zh: 无法摧毁的；不可战胜的；不容置疑的
unassailable.en: that cannot be destroyed, defeated or questioned

underlying.zh: 根本的；潜在的；隐含的；表面下的；下层的
underlying.en: important in a situation but not always easily noticed or stated clearly; existing under the surface of something else

underscore.zh: 在（词语等下）画线；画底线标出；强调；突出；下划线，底线（用于字母下划线或计算机命令和互联网地址中）
underscore.en: to draw a line under a word, sentence, etc.; to emphasize or show that something is important or true; the symbol (_ ) that is used to draw a line between letters or words, especially in computer commands and internet addresses

unfettered.zh: 无限制的；不受约束的；自由的

unionist.zh: （美国内战时期的）合众国拥护者，合众派成员；统一主义者，统一派（主张北爱尔兰继续为英国的一部分）
unionist.en: a member of a trade union; a person who believes that Northern Ireland should stay part of the United Kingdom; a supporter of the Union during the Civil War in the US

unregulated.zh: 不受法规约束的；不受管制的
unregulated.en: not controlled by laws or regulations

untenable.zh: 难以捍卫的；站不住脚的；不堪一击的
untenable.en: that cannot be defended against attack or criticism

upheld.en: is the past tense and past participle of .

uptake.zh: （对现有东西的）使用，利用，应用；吸收；吸收速度；领悟得快／慢
uptake.en: the use that is made of something that has become available; the process by which something is taken into a body or system; the rate at which this happens; to be quick/slow to understand something

vanguard.zh: （政治、艺术、工业等社会活动的）领导者，先锋，先驱者；先头部队；前卫；尖兵
vanguard.en: the leaders of a movement in society, for example in politics, art, industry, etc.; the part of an army, etc. that is at the front when moving forward to attack the enemy

vicious circle.en: a situation in which one problem causes another problem which then makes the first problem worse

viral.zh: 病毒的；病毒性的；病毒引起的；（信息、视频、图像等）在网上快速传播的
viral.en: like or caused by a virus; used to describe a piece of information, a video, an image, etc. that is sent rapidly over the internet and seen by large numbers of people within a short time

vocal.zh: 嗓音的；发声的；大声表达的；直言不讳的；（乐曲中的）歌唱部分，声乐部分
vocal.en: connected with the voice; telling people your opinions or protesting about something loudly and with confidence; the part of a piece of music that is sung, rather than played on a musical instrument

void.zh: 空间；空白；真空；空虚；缺乏；没有；无效的；空的；空空如也的；无法律效力的；无效的；使无效；宣布…作废；取消；排泄，排放（大小便）
void.en: a large empty space; a feeling of being empty, caused by the loss of somebody/something; completely without something; not correct or legally valid; empty; having no legal force; not valid; to state officially that something is no longer correct or legally valid; to empty waste matter from the bladder or bowels

volition.zh: 意志力；自愿选择；自行决断
volition.en: the power to choose something freely or to make your own decisions

voracious.zh: 饭量大的；贪吃的；狼吞虎咽的；（对信息、知识）渴求的；求知欲强的
voracious.en: eating or wanting large amounts of food; wanting a lot of new information and knowledge

waive.en: to choose not to demand something in a particular case, even though you have a legal or official right to do so

wake-up call.zh: 催醒电话；叫早电话；让人警醒的事
wake-up call.en: a phone call that you arrange to be made to you at a particular time, for example in a hotel, in order to wake you up; an event that makes people realize that there is a problem that they need to do something about

warp.zh: （使）扭曲，弯曲，变形；使（行为等）不合情理；使乖戾；（织布机上的）经线，经纱
warp.en: to become, or make something become twisted, or bent out of its natural shape, for example because it has become too hot, too wet, etc.; to influence somebody so that they begin to behave in an unacceptable way; the threads on a loom (= a machine used for making cloth) that other threads are passed over and under in order to make cloth

weigh up.zh: （通过观察或谈话）形成对…的看法，品评
weigh up.en: to form an opinion of somebody by watching or talking to them

wholesale.zh: 批发的；趸售的；大规模的
wholesale.en: in large quantities, especially so they can be sold again to make a profit; in very large numbers; connected with goods that are bought and sold in large quantities, especially so they can be sold again to make a profit; happening or done to a very large number of people or things

wired.zh: （与计算机系统）联网的，连线的；（为使坚挺或坚固）内含金属丝的，夹丝的；兴奋的；紧张不安的；（受酒精或毒品影响而）迷醉的
wired.en: connected to a device or computer network by wires; containing wires that make it strong or stiff; excited or nervous; not relaxed; under the influence of alcohol or an illegal drug; a US magazine published every month in print and digital form containing news and opinions on computer technology. It reports on how technology and the internet affect culture, the economy and politics. It is published in San Francisco and was started in 1993. There is also a British edition, Wired UK and a website, which publishes blogs on a wide variety of technology-related topics.

witch-hunt.zh: （对被认为持不为社会所接受或危及社会政见者的）搜捕，政治迫害
witch-hunt.en: an attempt to find and punish people who hold opinions that are thought to be unacceptable or dangerous to society

workers' compensation.zh: 工人赔偿：一种保险，向因工作直接受伤或患病的雇员提供赔偿；他要求工人赔偿。
workers' compensation.en: a type of insurance that provides payments to employees who get injured or sick as a direct result of their job

xenophobia.zh: 仇外，惧外（对外国人的厌恶或惧怕）
xenophobia.en: a strong feeling of dislike or fear of people from other countries

xenophobic.zh: 仇外，惧外（对外国人的厌恶或惧怕）
xenophobic.en: feeling or showing dislike or fear of people from other countries

zealous.zh: 热情的；热烈的；充满激情的
zealous.en: showing great energy and enthusiasm for something, especially because you feel strongly about it

cohort.zh: （有共同特点或举止类同的）一群人，一批人；同伙；支持者
cohort.en: a group of people who share a common feature or aspect of behaviour; a member of a group of people who support another person

thorny.zh: 棘手的；麻烦的；引起争议的；有刺的；多刺的
thorny.en: causing difficulty or disagreement; having thorns

outlier.zh: 离群值：与组中其他人不同或处于不同位置的人或物；他们是企业离群值，就是那些不适合公司文化的人。；统计；离群值：图形或结果集中的一个数据点，该数据点比下一个最近的数据点大得多或小得多；如果将异常值从数据中删除，则总体结果会发生显着变化。
outlier.en: a person or thing that is different from or in a position away from others in the group; a data point on a graph or in a set of results that is very much bigger or smaller than the next nearest data point

undercut.zh: 削价竞争；以低于（竞争对手）的价格出售；削弱；使降低效力；大盖儿头发型；帽盔式发型；华盖式发型
undercut.en: to sell goods or services at a lower price than your competitors; to make somebody/something weaker or less likely to be effective; a way of cutting somebody’s hair in which the hair is left quite long on top but the hair on the lower part of the head is cut much shorter

cursory.en: done quickly and without giving enough attention to details

spur.zh: 马刺；靴刺；鞭策；激励；刺激；鼓舞；山嘴；尖坡；支脉；（公路或铁路的）支线，岔线；一时冲动之下；心血来潮；获得名望；取得成功；促进，加速，刺激（某事发生）；策（马）前进；（尤指用马刺）策（马）加速
spur.en: a sharp pointed object that riders sometimes wear on the heels of their boots and use to encourage their horse to go faster; a fact or an event that makes you want to do something better or more quickly; an area of high ground that sticks out from a mountain or hill; a road or a railway track that leads from the main road or line; suddenly, without planning in advance; to become famous or successful; to encourage somebody to do something or to encourage them to try harder to achieve something; to make something happen faster or sooner; to encourage a horse to go faster, especially by pushing the spurs on your boots into its side

standoff.en: ; A is a situation in which neither of two opposing groups or forces will make a move until the other one does something, so nothing can happen until one of them gives way.

supersede.zh: 取代，替代（已过时或已非最佳选择的人或物）
supersede.en: to take the place of something/somebody that is considered to be old-fashioned or no longer the best available

tout.zh: 标榜；吹捧；吹嘘；兜售；推销；（尤指在剧院、体育场等外以高价）倒卖门票，卖黑市票；（音乐会、体育比赛等的）倒卖门票的人，票贩子
tout.en: to try to persuade people that somebody/something is important or valuable by praising them/it; to try to persuade people to buy your goods or services, especially by going to them and asking them directly; to sell tickets for a popular event illegally, at a price that is higher than the official price, especially outside a theatre, stadium, etc.; a person who buys tickets for concerts, sports events, etc. and then sells them to other people at a higher price

bespoke.en: made specially, according to the needs of an individual customer; making products specially, according to the needs of an individual customer

lucrative.en: producing a large amount of money; making a large profit

quash.zh: 宣布（法庭的裁决）无效；撤销（判决）；制止；阻止；平息
quash.en: to officially say that a decision made by a court is no longer legally acceptable or correct; to take action to stop something from continuing

rationale.en: the principles or reasons which explain a particular decision, course of action, belief, etc.

transactional.zh: 交易性的：与买卖过程有关；团队处理交易数据，例如购买记录。；事务性的：与人与人之间的交流有关；他们之间的关系比情感上的更重要。
transactional.en: relating to the process of buying or selling; relating to communication between people

whistleblower.en: A is someone who finds out that the organization they are working for is doing something immoral or illegal and tells the authorities or the public about it.

limbo.zh: 林波舞（西印度群岛舞蹈，舞者向后弯腰钻过一次比一次降低的横杆）；（尤指因等待他人作决定）处于不定状态
limbo.en: a West Indian dance in which you lean backwards and go under a bar that is made lower each time you go under it; a situation in which you are not certain what to do next, cannot take action, etc., especially because you are waiting for somebody else to make a decision

arms race.en: a situation in which countries compete to get the most and best weapons

bloc.en: a group of countries that work closely together because they have similar political interests

blueprint.zh: （建筑、机器等的）蓝图；行动方案；计划蓝图；（生物细胞的）模型，型板
blueprint.en: a photographic print of a plan for a building or a machine, with white lines on a blue background; a plan which shows what can be achieved and how it can be achieved; the pattern in every living cell, which decides how the plant, animal or person will develop and what it will look like

bolster.en: to improve something or make it stronger; a long thick pillow that is placed across the top of a bed under the other pillows

boon.en: something that is very helpful and makes life easier for you

calamity.en: an event that causes great damage to people’s lives, property, etc.

cliché.zh: 陈词滥调；陈腐的套语；使用陈词滥调
cliché.en: a phrase or an idea that has been used so often that it no longer has much meaning and is not interesting; the use of clichés in writing or speaking

dire.zh: 极其严重的；危急的；极糟的；极差的

fixture.zh: （定期定点举行的）体育活动，体育节；固定设施（如房屋内安装的浴缸或抽水马桶）
fixture.en: a sports event that has been arranged to take place on a particular date and at a particular place; a thing such as a bath or toilet that is fixed in a house and that you do not take with you when you move house

flashpoint.zh: （暴力或愤怒的）一触即发，危机即将爆发的地点
flashpoint.en: a situation or place in which violence or anger starts and cannot be controlled

flip.zh: （使）快速翻转，迅速翻动；按（开关）；按（按钮）；开（或关）（机器等）；（用手指）轻抛，轻掷；十分气愤；异常激动；神志不清；发火；气得丧失自制力；气得发疯；轻抛；捻掷；空翻；浏览；草草翻阅；轻率的
flip.en: to turn over into a different position with a sudden quick movement; to make something do this; to press a button or switch in order to turn a machine, etc. on or off; to throw something somewhere with a sudden quick movement, especially using your thumb and/or fingers; to become very angry, excited or unable to think clearly; to work as a chef in a fast-food restaurant, especially when this is considered to be a low-status job for people who lack the ambition or ability to do anything better; to become very angry and lose control of what you are saying or doing; a small quick hit with a part of the body that causes something to turn over; a movement in which the body turns over in the air; a quick look through a book, magazine, website, etc.; flippant (= showing that you do not take something as seriously as other people think you should)

fringe.zh: 额前短垂发；刘海儿；（某物的）穗，缘饰，流苏；（沿…边缘的）一排（树木、房屋等）；（地区或群体的）边缘；（指群体、事情或活动）次要部分，外围；极端分子；极端（或狂热）分子集团；形成…的边缘
fringe.en: the front part of somebody’s hair that is cut so that it hangs over their forehead; a narrow border of hanging threads attached to the edge of something to decorate it; a narrow area of trees, buildings, etc. along the edge of something; the outer edge of an area or a group; groups of people, events and activities that are not part of the main group or activity; those members of a political or other group whose views are considered to be very extreme and crazy; to form a border around something

gutted.zh: 十分伤心；极度失望；非常沮丧

indelible.zh: 无法忘记的；不可磨灭的；（笔迹）无法消除的，擦不掉的
indelible.en: impossible to forget or remove; leaving a mark that cannot be removed

inventory.zh: （建筑物里的物品、家具等的）清单；财产清单；（商店的）存货，库存；开列清单
inventory.en: a written list of all the objects, furniture, etc. in a particular building; all the goods in a store; all of the stock of a business, including materials, components, work in progress and finished products; to make a complete list of something; to include something in a list

lenient.zh: （惩罚或执法时）宽大的，宽容的，仁慈的
lenient.en: not as strict as expected when punishing somebody or when making sure that rules are obeyed

navigate.zh: 导航；确定（船、飞机、汽车等）的位置和方向；航行；航海；横渡；正确处理，有效应对（困难或复杂的情况）；（在互联网或网站上）导航
navigate.en: to plan and direct the course of ship, plane, car etc., for example by using a map; to sail along, over or through a sea, river etc.; to find the right way to deal with a difficult or complicated situation; to find your way around on the internet or on a particular website

nudge.zh: （用肘）轻推，轻触；（朝某方向）轻推，渐渐推动；用胳膊肘挤开往前走；（使）达到，接近；（肘部的）轻推，碰；（暗指与性行为有关的事）你懂的
nudge.en: to push somebody gently, especially with your elbow, in order to get their attention; to push somebody/something gently or gradually in a particular direction; to move forward by pushing with your elbow; to reach or make something reach a particular level; a slight push, usually with the elbow; used to suggest something to do with sex without actually saying it

overblown.zh: 过分的；夸张的；虚饰过度的；残败的；盛期已过的
overblown.en: that is made to seem larger, more impressive or more important than it really is; past the best, most beautiful stage

pipeline.zh: 输油管道，输气管道，输送管线（通常指地下的）；在讨论（或规划、准备）中；在酝酿中
pipeline.en: a series of pipes that are usually underground and are used for carrying oil, gas, etc. over long distances; something that is in the pipeline is being discussed, planned or prepared and will happen or exist soon

pivot.zh: 支点；枢轴；中心点；最重要的人（或事物）；中心；核心；（使）在枢轴上旋转（或转动）
pivot.en: the central point, pin or column on which something turns or balances; the central or most important person or thing; to turn or balance on a central point (= a pivot); to make something do this; to change direction; to change the way in which something is done

reprieve.zh: 撤销…的死刑；缓期执行…的死刑；取消关闭；暂缓终止；刑罚终止令；（尤指）死刑缓刑令；延缓；缓解
reprieve.en: to officially cancel or delay a punishment for a prisoner who is condemned to death; to officially cancel or delay plans to close something or end something; an official order stopping a punishment, especially for a prisoner who is condemned to death; a delay before something bad happens

retribution.en: severe punishment for something seriously wrong that somebody has done

retrofit.zh: 给机器设备装配（新部件）；翻新；改型
retrofit.en: to put a new piece of equipment into a machine that did not have it when it was built; to provide a machine with a new part, etc.; an act of putting a new piece of equipment into a machine that did not have it when it was built

scuttle.zh: 碎步疾跑；（故意）破坏，阻止，阻挠；凿沉（船）
scuttle.en: to run with quick short steps; to deliberately cause something to fail; to sink a ship deliberately by making holes in the side or bottom of it; a container with a handle, used for carrying coal and usually kept next to the fireplace

seductive.zh: 诱人的；迷人的；有魅力的；性感的；有吸引力的；令人神往的
seductive.en: sexually attractive; attractive in a way that makes you want to have or do something

self-styled.en: using a name or title that you have given yourself, especially when you do not have the right to do it

shortsighted.zh: 近视的；目光短浅的；无远见的
shortsighted.en: If you are , you cannot see things properly when they are far away, because there is something wrong with your eyes.; If someone is about something, or if their ideas are , they do not make proper or careful judgments about the future.

sign off on.en: to express your approval of something formally and definitely

slew.en: to turn or slide suddenly in another direction; to make a vehicle do this; a large number or amount of something

slush fund.zh: （尤指用于政治目的的）非法基金
slush fund.en: a sum of money kept for illegal purposes, especially in politics

stake out.zh: 清楚地界定自认为属于自己的东西；明确阐述自己的看法（或立场等）；监视
stake out.en: to clearly mark the limits of something that you claim is yours; to state your opinion, position, etc. on something very clearly; to watch a place secretly, especially for signs of illegal activity

travesty.en: something that does not have the qualities or values that it should have, and as a result is often considered wrong or offensive

unravel.zh: （把缠或织在一起的线）解开，拆散，松开；解体；崩溃；瓦解；阐释；说明；澄清；变得清楚易懂
unravel.en: if you unravel threads that are twisted, woven or knitted, or if they unravel, they become separated; to start to fail or no longer stay together as a whole; to explain something that is difficult to understand or is mysterious; to become clearer or easier to understand

upheaval.en: a big change that causes a lot of worry and problems

upshot.zh: 通常指意外的结果，结局；upshot
upshot.en: of a series of events or discussions is the final result of them, usually a surprising result.

upside.zh: （糟糕局面的）好的一面，光明的一面，正面
upside.en: the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad

vitriol.en: very cruel and bitter comments or criticism

cordon off.zh: （由警察、士兵等）包围，警戒，封锁
cordon off.en: to stop people from getting into an area by surrounding it with police, soldiers, etc.

overreach.en: to fail by trying to achieve more than is possible

advocacy group.zh: 倡议团体；吁请团；请愿团体
advocacy group.en: a group of people who work together to achieve something, especially by putting pressure on the government, etc., usually representing people who are unable to speak for themselves

arbiter.zh: 仲裁人；公断人；裁决人；权威人士
arbiter.en: a person with the power or influence to make judgements and decide what will be done or accepted

buy-in.en: the fact of accepting a policy or change because you agree with it

cadre.en: a small group of people who are specially chosen and trained for a particular purpose; a member of this kind of group

convene.zh: 召集，召开（正式会议）；（为正式会议而）聚集，集合
convene.en: to arrange for people to come together for a formal meeting; to come together for a formal meeting

culprit.zh: 犯错的人；罪犯；肇事者；引起问题的事物
culprit.en: a person who has done something wrong or against the law; a person or thing responsible for causing a problem

flagship.zh: 旗舰；（某组织机构的）最重要产品，最佳服务项目，主建筑物，王牌
flagship.en: the main ship in a fleet of ships in the navy; the most important product, service, building, etc. that an organization owns or produces

implausible.zh: 似乎不合情理的；不像真实的
implausible.en: not seeming reasonable or likely to be true

laissez-faire.zh: （政府对私有企业的）自由放任政策
laissez-faire.en: the policy of allowing private businesses to develop without government control; following a policy of allowing private businesses to develop without government control; not trying to control somebody and allowing them to do what they want

lifeblood.zh: （事物的）命脉；生命线；命根子；（人的）命脉；生命必需的血液
lifeblood.en: the thing that keeps something strong and healthy and is necessary for successful development; a person’s blood, when it is thought of as the thing that is necessary for life

mercury.en: a chemical element. Mercury is a poisonous silver liquid metal, used in thermometers.; the smallest planet in the solar system, nearest to the sun

obscure.zh: 无名的；鲜为人知的；费解的；难以理解的；使模糊；使隐晦；使费解
obscure.en: not well known; difficult to understand; to make it difficult to see, hear or understand something

roadblock.en: a barrier put across the road by the police or army so that they can stop and search vehicles; something that stops a plan from going ahead

set aside.zh: 省出，留出（钱或时间）；暂时不考虑（或放一放）；撤销（法院的判决）；宣布无效
set aside.en: to save or keep money, time, land, etc. for a particular purpose; to not consider something, because other things are more important; to officially state that a decision made by a court is not legally acceptable

shrug off.zh: 不把…当回事；对…满不在乎；对…不予理睬；甩开；摆脱；抖落
shrug off.en: to treat something as if it is not important; to push somebody/something back or away with your shoulders

spearhead.zh: 先锋；前锋；先头部队；做…的先锋；带头做；领先突击
spearhead.en: a person or group that begins an activity or leads an attack against somebody/something; to begin an activity or lead an attack against somebody/something

stand by.zh: 袖手旁观；无动于衷；做好随时行动的准备；做好准备；支持；帮助；忠于；仍然遵守诺言（或协议等）
stand by.en: to be present while something bad is happening but not do anything to stop it; to be ready for action; to help somebody or be friends with them, even in difficult situations; to still believe or agree with something you said, decided or agreed earlier

stranglehold.zh: 掐脖子；卡脖子；压制；束缚
stranglehold.en: a strong hold around somebody’s neck that makes it difficult for them to breathe; complete control over something that makes it impossible for it to grow or develop well

torpedo.zh: 鱼雷；用鱼雷袭击（或击沉）；彻底破坏，完全摧毁（某事成功的可能性）
torpedo.en: a long, narrow bomb that is fired under the water from a ship or submarine and that explodes when it hits a ship, etc.; to attack a ship or make it sink using a torpedo; to completely destroy the possibility that something could succeed

trajectory.zh: （射体在空中的）轨道，弹道，轨迹
trajectory.en: the curved path of something that has been fired, hit or thrown into the air

backtrack.zh: 原路返回；折回；折返；（屈于压力而）改变声明（或主张），出尔反尔；退缩
backtrack.en: to go back along the same route that you have just come along; to change an earlier statement, opinion or promise because of pressure from somebody/something

blunder.zh: 愚蠢（或粗心）的错误；犯愚蠢的（或粗心的）错误
blunder.en: a stupid or careless mistake; to make a stupid or careless mistake

buzzword.zh: （报刊等的）时髦术语，流行行话
buzzword.en: a word or phrase, especially one connected with a particular subject, that has become fashionable and popular and is used a lot in newspapers, etc.

cure-all.en: something that people believe can cure any problem or any disease

demise.zh: 终止；失败；倒闭；死亡；逝世；一命呜呼
demise.en: the end or failure of an institution, an idea, a company, etc.; death

drain.zh: 排空；（使）流光；放干；（使）流走，流出；喝光；喝干；使（精力、金钱等）耗尽；下水道；排水管；下水道孔盖；（浴缸、水池等的）排水孔，渗水孔，漏眼；消耗；耗竭；耗费；（被）浪费掉；（变得）非常糟糕；哈哈大笑；放声大笑
drain.en: to make something empty or dry by removing the liquid from it; to become empty or dry in this way; to make liquid flow away from something; to flow away; to empty a cup or glass by drinking everything in it; to make somebody/something weaker, poorer, etc. by using up their/its strength, money, etc.; a pipe that carries away dirty water or other liquid waste; a frame of metal bars over the opening to a drain in the ground; a hole in a bath, sink, etc. where the water flows away and into which a plug fits; a thing that uses a lot of the time, money, etc. that could be used for something else; the fact of resources, people, etc. being lost or wasted; (to be) wasted; (to get) very much worse; to laugh very loudly

dub.zh: 把…戏称为；给…起绰号；为（影片或电视节目）配音；译制；混声录制，混录（音乐）；（西印度群岛的）强节奏音乐，强节拍诗歌
dub.en: to give somebody/something a particular name, often in a humorous or critical way; to replace the original speech in a film or television programme with words in another language; to make a piece of music by mixing sounds from different recordings; a type of West Indian music or poetry with a strong beat

embrace.zh: 抱；拥抱；欣然接受，乐意采纳（思想、建议等）；信奉（宗教、信仰等）；包括；包含
embrace.en: an act of putting your arms around somebody as a sign of love or friendship; the act of accepting an idea, a proposal, a set of beliefs, etc, especially when it is done with enthusiasm; to put your arms around somebody as a sign of love or friendship; to accept an idea, a proposal, a set of beliefs, etc., especially when it is done with enthusiasm; to include something

eugenics.en: the study of methods to improve the mental and physical characteristics of the human race by choosing who may become parents

firebrand.zh: 挑动政治争端者；煽动动乱者
firebrand.en: a person who is always encouraging other people to take strong political action, often causing trouble

glitch.zh: 小故障；小毛病；小差错；（机器或系统）出故障，出毛病
glitch.en: a small problem or fault that stops something working successfully; a type of electronic music that uses sound recordings and electronic instruments that have been made to work incorrectly so there are deliberate glitches in the sound; (of a machine or system) to suffer a sudden fault and fail to work correctly

hail from.en: to come from or have been born in a particular place

impromptu.zh: 无准备的；即兴的；即席的
impromptu.en: without preparation or planning; done without preparation or planning

iteration.en: the process of repeating a mathematical or computing process or set of instructions again and again, each time applying it to the result of the previous stage; a new version of a piece of computer software

playbook.zh: 体育；剧本：一本书或一组笔记，其中包含团队可以使用的动作或动作的描述和图示；学习剧本和观看游戏电影有帮助。；剧本：一套规则或做某事的方式；竞争使他们的销售方法从我们的剧本中脱颖而出。
playbook.en: a book or set of notes with descriptions and diagrams of the actions or moves that a team can use; a set of rules or way of doing something

rallying cry.en: a phrase or an idea that is used to encourage people to support somebody/something

self-report.phonetic: /ˌself rɪˈpɔːt/ | /ˌself rɪˈpɔːrt/ | /ˌself rɪˈpɔːts/ | /ˌself rɪˈpɔːrts/ | /ˌself rɪˈpɔːtɪd/ | /ˌself rɪˈpɔːrtɪd/ | /ˌself rɪˈpɔːtɪŋ/ | /ˌself rɪˈpɔːrtɪŋ/
self-report.zh: 自我报告；调查参与者必须自我报告其健康状况。；在这项研究中，患者自我报告是否进行了定期运动。；61％的受访者自我报告说，他们很可能在即将举行的选举中投票。；常用于另一名词前；自我报告：您提供的有关生活方面的详细信息，通常与您的身体或精神状况有关；参与者完成了自我报告调查表，用于测量焦虑和抑郁。
self-report.en: to give details about an aspect of your life, typically relating to your physical or mental condition; details that you provide about an aspect of your life, typically relating to your physical or mental condition

spook.zh: 鬼；间谍；特工；吓；惊吓；受惊
spook.en: a ghost; a spy; to frighten a person or an animal; to become frightened

stark.zh: 严酷的；赤裸裸的；真实而无法回避的；（指区别）明显的，鲜明的；毫无修饰的；荒凉的；粗陋的；完全的；十足的；一丝不挂；赤裸；十分疯狂；彻底疯狂
stark.en: unpleasant; real, and impossible to avoid; very different from something in a way that is easy to see; looking severe and without any colour or decoration; complete and total; wearing no clothes; completely crazy

addled.zh: 糊涂的；昏庸的；变质的；腐坏的
addled.en: confused; unable to think clearly; not fresh; bad to eat

alphabet soup.zh: （因含有许多符号或缩略语等而极难懂的）代号语言；字母汤（汤里含有字母形面食）
alphabet soup.en: a confusing mixture of things, especially language that contains many symbols or abbreviations; soup that contains pasta in the shape of letters

anesthetic.en: a drug that makes a person or an animal unable to feel anything, especially pain, either in the whole body or in a part of the body; containing a substance that makes a person or an animal unable to feel pain in all or part of the body

avant-garde.zh: 前卫的：喜欢或引入新的和非常现代的思想和方法；这座剧院上演了许多前卫派作品。
avant-garde.en: preferring or introducing new and very modern ideas and methods

bottle up.zh: 长时间掩饰，遏制，隐瞒（不快等）
bottle up.en: to not allow other people to see that you are unhappy, angry, etc., especially when this happens over a long period of time

celluloid.zh: （旧时摄影用的）胶片，赛璐珞片；电影
celluloid.en: a thin clear plastic material made in sheets, used in the past for cinema film; used as a way of referring to films

chalk up.zh: 获得，取得（成功）；记下，记录（成就、比赛得分等）
chalk up.en: to achieve or record a success, points in a game, etc.

chopping block.zh: 砧板：在；旧时；砧板：砍掉一个人的头作为惩罚的一块木头；砧板：可能被正式停止或突然取消；可能突然失去工作或职位；社会痛苦将是巨大的。砧板将是学校和教师，图书馆，公园和健康计划。；六个参议员在砧板上。；我不会把头放在砧板上！
chopping block.en: a thick wooden board or block for cutting food or wood on; a block of wood on which a person's head was cut off as a punishment; likely to be officially stopped or cancelled suddenly; likely to lose your job or position suddenly

claw back.zh: 设法捞回；费力地挽回；（常通过税收手段）收回（已支付给民众的钱款）
claw back.en: to get something back that you have lost, usually by using a lot of effort; to get back money that has been paid to people, usually by taxing them

deep-pocketed.zh: 财力雄厚：有很多钱可以花；财力雄厚的公司；业界赞赏这些财力雄厚且忠实的消费者。
deep-pocketed.en: having a large amount of money to spend

face down.zh: （威风凛凛地）把某人压制下去
face down.en: to oppose or beat somebody by dealing with them directly and confidently

grammar school.en: (in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, especially in the past) a school for young people between the ages of 11 and 18 who are good at academic subjects; elementary school (= in the US, a school for children between the ages of about 6 and 12)

hostage.zh: 人质；可能招惹麻烦（或担忧）的东西（或许诺）；造成后患的事物
hostage.en: a person who is captured and held prisoner by a person or group, and who may be injured or killed if people do not do what the person or group is asking; something that you have, or have promised to do, that could cause trouble or worry in the future

journalistic.zh: 新闻业的；新闻工作（者）的
journalistic.en: connected with the work of a journalist

mind-boggling.zh: 难以想象的；难以理解的；令人惊愕的
mind-boggling.en: very difficult to imagine or to understand; extremely surprising

mobilization.en: preparations that bring together the people and weapons that will be needed in order for a country to fight a war; the act of bringing together the things that are needed for a particular purpose

newsprint.en: the cheap paper that newspapers are printed on

paragon.en: a person who is perfect or who is a perfect example of a particular good quality

pent-up.zh: 压抑的；积压的；感情抑郁的；难以抒怀的
pent-up.en: that cannot be expressed or released; having feelings that you cannot express

permafrost.zh: （寒带）永久冻土，永冻土，多年冻土
permafrost.en: a layer of soil that is permanently frozen, in very cold regions of the world

poverty trap.zh: 贫困的牢笼（即使找到工作也依旧贫困，因为政府补贴相应减少）
poverty trap.en: a situation in which a person stays poor even when they get a job because the money they receive from the government is reduced

primal.zh: 原始的；最初的；根源的；根本的
primal.en: connected with the earliest origins of life; very basic

rake in.en: to earn a lot of money, especially when it is done easily

scraping.en: a small amount of something produced by scratching a surface (= rubbing it with something hard or sharp)

stick it out.en: to continue doing something to the end, even when it is difficult or boring

storm surge.zh: 风暴潮：由于强烈风暴引起的风浪，海岸附近海平面异常升高；该地区遭受每小时160英里的狂风和35英尺的风暴潮。；我们预测会有 14 到 16 英尺高的风暴潮。
storm surge.en: an unusual rise in the level of the sea near the coast, caused by wind from a severe storm

stylist.zh: 发型师；时装设计师；语言风格优美（或独特）的人；文体家；（产品、人、广告等的）造型设计师，形象设计师；表现得有格调的人
stylist.en: a person whose job is cutting and shaping people’s hair; a person who designs fashionable clothes or advises people on fashion; a writer who takes great care to write or say something in a beautiful or unusual way; a person whose job is to create or design a particular style or image for a product, a person, an advertisement, etc.; a person who performs with style

taxonomic.en: connected with the scientific process of classifying things (= arranging them into groups)

telltale.zh: 暴露实情的；能说明问题的；向大人告另一个孩子状的小孩儿；小告密者
telltale.en: showing that something exists or has happened; a child who tells an adult what another child has done wrong

vicarious.en: felt or experienced by watching or reading about somebody else doing something, rather than by doing it yourself

wage slave.zh: 在一家大公司当奴隶几年后，她决定辞职并创立自己的公司。；数以百万计的人去了城市，在那里他们成了乞丐、乞丐和有薪奴隶。
wage slave.en: a person who depends entirely on the money they receive for the job that they do. This term is usually used about people whose jobs are not seen as skilled or important.

watering hole.en: a place in a hot country, where animals go to drink; a bar or place where people go to drink

zero-sum game.zh: 零和对策，零和博弈（一方得益一方受损、两者得失相抵的情形）
zero-sum game.en: a situation in which what is gained by one person or group is lost by another person or group

aberration.zh: 脱离常规；反常现象；异常行为
aberration.en: a fact, an action or a way of behaving that is not usual, and that may be unacceptable

about-face.zh: 态度或观点的彻底改变，大转变；about-face
about-face.en: An is a complete change of attitude or opinion.

abrasion.zh: （皮肤、表皮）擦伤处；（表层）磨损处；磨损；磨蚀
abrasion.en: a damaged area of the skin where it has been rubbed against something hard and rough; damage to a surface caused by rubbing something very hard against it

absolve.zh: 宣告…无罪；判定…无责；赦免…的罪
absolve.en: to state formally that somebody is not guilty or responsible for something; to give absolution to somebody

abysmal.en: extremely bad or of a very low standard

acting.zh: （戏剧、电影等中的）表演；演艺业；临时代理的
acting.en: the activity or profession of performing in plays, films, etc.; doing the work of another person for a short time

acutely.zh: 深深感觉到；强烈意识到；（描述不快的感觉）极其，强烈地；严重地；危险地
acutely.en: noticing or feeling something very strongly; (describing unpleasant feelings) very; very strongly; to a severe and dangerous degree

aesthetics.en: is a branch of philosophy concerned with the study of the idea of beauty.

affluent.en: having a lot of money and a good standard of living

aftermath.zh: （战争、事故、不快事情的）后果，创伤
aftermath.en: the situation that exists as a result of an important (and usually unpleasant) event, especially a war, an accident, etc.

airtight.en: not allowing air to get in or out

alignment.zh: 排成直线；（国家、团体间的）结盟
alignment.en: arrangement in a straight line; political support given to one country or group by another

allegiance.zh: （对政党、宗教、统治者的）忠诚，效忠，拥戴
allegiance.en: a person’s continued support for a political party, religion, leader, etc.

amenable.zh: 顺从的；顺服的；可用某种方式处理的
amenable.en: easy to control; willing to be influenced by somebody/something; that you can treat in a particular way

amend.zh: 修正，修订（法律、文件、声明等）
amend.en: to change a law, document, statement, etc. slightly in order to correct a mistake or to improve it

antagonistic.zh: 对立情绪的；对抗的；敌对的；敌意的

appease.zh: 安抚；抚慰；绥靖（满足另一国的要求以避免战争）
appease.en: to make somebody calmer or less angry by giving them what they want; to give a country what it wants in order to avoid war

appreciable.zh: （大得）可以觉察到的，足以认为重要的；可观的
appreciable.en: large enough to be noticed or thought important

apprehension.zh: 忧虑；担心；疑惧；恐惧；逮捕；拘押
apprehension.en: worry or fear that something unpleasant may happen; the act of capturing or arresting somebody, usually by the police

arable.en: connected with growing crops such as wheat

archipelago.en: a group of islands and the sea surrounding them

arguably.zh: （常用于形容词比较级或最高级前）可论证地，按理
arguably.en: used (often before a comparative or superlative adjective) when you are stating an opinion that you believe you could give reasons to support

aspirational.zh: 渴望成功的；一心想提高社会地位和生活水平的
aspirational.en: wanting very much to achieve success in your career or to improve your social status and standard of living; an aspirational goal or target is very ambitious and may be more than you can achieve, but is set in order to encourage you to try harder and achieve more

atrium.zh: （现代建筑物中央通常带有玻璃屋顶的）中庭，中厅；（古罗马大宅的）天井；心房
atrium.en: a large high space, usually with a glass roof, in the centre of a modern building; an open space in the centre of an ancient Roman villa (= a large house); either of the two upper spaces in the heart that are used in the first stage of sending the blood around the body

automatic pilot.zh: （飞机的）自动驾驶仪；（船的）自动操舵装置；习惯性地做；机械性地做
automatic pilot.en: a device in an aircraft or a ship that keeps it on a fixed course without the need for a person to control it; to do something without thinking because you have done the same thing many times before

avalanche.en: a mass of snow, ice and rock that falls down the side of a mountain

backbone.zh: 脊梁骨；脊柱；支柱；骨干；基础；毅力；骨气
backbone.en: the row of small bones that are connected together down the middle of the back; the most important part of a system, an organization, etc. that gives it support and strength; the strength of character that you need to do something difficult

backdrop.zh: （事件发生时）周围陪衬景物；（事态或活动的）背景；（舞台的）背景幕布
backdrop.en: everything that can be seen around an event or scene; the general conditions in which an event takes place, which sometimes help to explain that event; a painted piece of cloth that is hung behind the stage in a theatre as part of the scenery

backfire.zh: 产生事与愿违的不良（或危险）后果；逆火；回火
backfire.en: to have the opposite effect to the one intended, with bad or dangerous results; to make a sudden noise like an explosion

backlog.en: a quantity of work that should have been done already, but has not yet been done

backstop.zh: 体育；挡块：用于阻止球进入比赛区域的围栏或屏幕；他的一些投球命中率很高。；后挡板：站在击球者后面并在没有击中球的情况下将球接住的球员（1）；支撑：为了防止出现错误而导致的更严重的问题，预先完成或准备的事情；该国需要财政支持来应对银行倒闭。
backstop.en: a fence or screen used to stop balls from going outside the playing area; the player who stands behind the person who is batting and catches the ball if he or she does not hit it; something that is done or prepared in advance in order to prevent worse problems if something goes wrong

balancing act.en: a process in which somebody tries to please two or more people or groups who want different things

bandwidth.zh: 带宽；频宽；带宽值，频宽值（计算机网络或互联网接口一定时间内传送信息量的量度，按每秒传送的字节数计）
bandwidth.en: a band of frequencies used for sending electronic signals; a measurement of the amount of information that a particular computer network or internet connection can send in a particular time. It is often measured in bits per second.; the energy or capacity that you need to do something

banner year.en: a year in which something is especially successful

barb.zh: （箭、钩的）倒钩，倒刺；挖苦（或伤人、带刺）的话
barb.en: the point of an arrow or a hook that is curved backwards to make it difficult to pull out; a remark that is meant to hurt somebody’s feelings

bargaining chip.zh: 讨价还价的筹码；谈判中的有利条件
bargaining chip.en: a fact or a thing that a person or a group of people can use to get an advantage for themselves when they are trying to reach an agreement with another group

bargaining power.zh: （谈判中一方的）讨价还价的能力
bargaining power.en: the amount of control a person or group has when trying to reach an agreement with another group in a business or political situation

barrage.zh: 火力网；弹幕射击；（尤指）掩护炮火；接二连三的一大堆（质问或指责等）；堰；水坝；拦河坝
barrage.en: the continuous firing of a large number of guns in a particular direction, especially to protect soldiers while they are attacking or moving towards the enemy; a large number of something, such as questions or comments, that are directed at somebody very quickly, one after the other, often in an aggressive way; a wall or barrier built across a river to store water, prevent a flood, etc.

beacon.zh: （指引车船等的）灯标，灯塔，立标；（导航）无线电信标台；（旧时）烽火
beacon.en: a light that is placed somewhere to guide vehicles and warn them of danger; a radio station whose signal helps ships and aircraft to find their position; (in the past) a fire lit on top of a hill as a signal

bear out.en: to show that somebody is right or that something is true

becoming.zh: 相配的；合身的；合适的；与…相称的
becoming.en: making the person wearing them look more attractive; suitable or appropriate for somebody or their situation

beef up.zh: 使更大（或更好、更有意思等）
beef up.en: to make something bigger, better, more interesting, etc.

benign.zh: 善良的；和善的；慈祥的；无害的；良性的
benign.en: kind and gentle; not hurting anybody; not causing damage or harm; not dangerous or likely to cause death

bereft.zh: 完全没有，丧失，失去（某物）；感到失落
bereft.en: completely without something; having lost something; sad and lonely because you have lost something

best practice.zh: （公司或机构的）最佳实践，最佳做法
best practice.en: a way of doing something that is seen as a very good example of how it should be done and can be copied by other companies or organizations

bilateral.zh: 双方的；双边的；（身体部位）双侧的，对称的；（大脑）两半球的
bilateral.en: involving two groups of people or two countries; involving both of two parts or sides of the body or brain

bile.en: the green-brown liquid with a bitter unpleasant taste that is produced by the liver to help the body to deal with the fats we eat, and that can come into your mouth when you vomit with an empty stomach; a strong feeling of anger or hating somebody/something

biodegradable.en: a substance or chemical that is biodegradable can be changed by the action of bacteria to a natural state that will not harm the environment

blind spot.zh: 视线盲区（尤指车辆驾驶员看不见的路段）；无视；没有认识；（视网膜的）盲点；（无线电）盲区，静区
blind spot.en: an area that somebody cannot see, especially an area of the road when they are driving a car; if somebody has a blind spot about something, they ignore it or they are unwilling or unable to understand it; the part of the retina in the eye that is not sensitive to light; an area where a radio signal cannot be received

blockbuster.zh: 一鸣惊人的事物；（尤指）非常成功的书（或电影）
blockbuster.en: something very successful, especially a very successful book or film

blowback.zh: 反吹；回吹；逆吹；违背初衷的结果
blowback.en: a process in which gases expand or travel in a direction that is opposite to the usual one; the results of a political action or situation that are not what was intended or wanted

blue-chip.en: a blue-chip investment is thought to be safe and likely to make a profit

body mass index.zh: 体重指数；身体质量指数
body mass index.en: a measure of whether somebody weighs too much or too little, calculated by dividing their weight in kilograms by their height in metres squared

bohemian.zh: 行为举止不拘泥成规者；放荡不羁的艺术家
bohemian.en: a person, often somebody who is involved with the arts, who lives in a very informal way without following accepted rules of behaviour; living in a very informal way without following accepted rules of behaviour, and often involved in the arts

bombshell.zh: 出乎意料的事情，意外消息（常指不幸）；金发美女
bombshell.en: an event or a piece of news which is unexpected and usually unpleasant; a very attractive woman with blonde hair

brace.zh: 箍子；夹子；支架；（儿童）牙箍；吊裤带；背带；双脚规形夹（支撑无力或受伤的腿的金属支架）；大括弧；大括号；猎获的一对鸟（或兽）；双管齐下；多重保障；（为困难或坏事）使做准备；使防备；使（身体或身体部位）顶住，抵住（以免跌倒等）；（做费劲的事之前）绷紧肌肉；加强；加固
brace.en: a device that holds things together or holds and supports them in position; a metal device that people, especially children, wear inside the mouth to help their teeth grow straight; long narrow pieces of cloth, leather, etc. for holding trousers up. They are fastened to the top of the trousers at the front and back and passed over the shoulders.; a metal support for weak or injured legs; either of the two marks, { }, used to show that the words, etc. between them are connected; a pair of birds or animals that have been killed in hunting; taking more actions than are really necessary to make sure that something succeeds or works as it should; to prepare somebody/yourself for something difficult or unpleasant that is going to happen; to press your body or part of your body strongly against something in order to stop yourself from falling; to contract the muscles in your body or part of your body before doing something that is physically difficult; to make something stronger or more solid by supporting it with something

brain drain.en: the movement of highly skilled and qualified people to a country where they can work in better conditions and earn more money

breathing room.en: a short rest in the middle of a period of mental or physical effort; enough space to breathe comfortably

buckle.zh: （使）搭扣扣住；（被）压垮，压弯；双腿发软；（皮带等的）搭扣，锁扣
buckle.en: to fasten something or be fastened with a buckle; to become bent, damaged or broken under a weight or force; to bend, damage or break something in this way; when your knees or legs buckle or when you buckle at the knees, your knees become weak and you start to fall; a piece of metal or plastic used for joining the ends of a belt or for fastening a part of a bag, shoe, etc.

budge.zh: （使）轻微移动，挪动；（使）改变主意，改变观点
budge.en: to move slightly; to make something/somebody move slightly; to change your opinion about something; to make somebody change their opinion

buoy.zh: 浮标；航标；鼓舞；鼓励；使漂浮；使浮起；使（价格）上浮；使（价格）维持于较高水平
buoy.en: an object which floats on the sea or a river to mark the places where it is dangerous and where it is safe for boats to go; to make somebody feel cheerful or confident; to keep somebody/something floating on water; to keep prices at a high or acceptable level

bureaucracy.zh: 官僚主义；官僚作风；官僚体制；实行官僚体制的国家
bureaucracy.en: the system of official rules and ways of doing things that a government or an organization has, especially when these seem to be too complicated; a system of government in which there are a large number of state officials who are not elected; a country with such a system

burgeoning.en: beginning to grow or develop rapidly

buzz.zh: 发出嗡嗡声；发出蜂鸣声；充满兴奋（或活动等）；用蜂鸣器（发信号）；飞近（尤指作为警告或威胁）；嗡嗡声；蜂鸣声；唧唧喳喳的谈话声；（愉快、兴奋或成就的）强烈情感；传闻；谣传；给某人打电话
buzz.en: to make a continuous low sound; to make a sound like a bee buzzing; to be full of excitement, activity, etc.; to call somebody to come by pressing a buzzer; to fly very close to somebody/something, especially as a warning or threat; a continuous sound like the one that a bee, a buzzer or other electronic device makes; the sound of people talking, especially in an excited way; a strong feeling of pleasure, excitement or achievement; news that people tell each other that may or may not be true; to phone somebody

camaraderie.en: a feeling of friendship and trust among people who work or spend a lot of time together

carbon footprint.zh: 碳足迹（日常活动所产生的碳排放量的量度方式）
carbon footprint.en: a measure of the amount of carbon dioxide that is produced by the activities of a person or company

carcinogen.en: a substance that can cause cancer

caste.zh: （印度教的四大）种姓；（尤指禁止其他等级成员进入的）社会阶层，社会等级；社会等级制度
caste.en: any of the four main divisions of Hindu society, originally those made according to functions in society; a social class, especially one whose members do not allow others to join it; the system of dividing society into classes based on differences in family origin, rank or wealth

casualty.zh: （战争或事故的）伤员，亡者，遇难者；受害者；毁坏物；损坏物；急诊室
casualty.en: a person who is killed or injured in war or in an accident; a person who suffers or a thing that is destroyed when something else takes place; the part of a hospital where people who need immediate treatment are taken; a popular British television soap opera, set in a hospital. It has been broadcast regularly by the BBC since 1986.

catalyst.zh: 催化剂；促使变化的人；引发变化的因素
catalyst.en: a substance that makes a chemical reaction happen faster without being changed itself; a person or thing that causes a change

catch-all.zh: 装杂物的容器；放杂物的东西；笼统的一类（或描述）
catch-all.en: a thing for holding many small objects; a group or description that includes different things and that does not state clearly what is included or not; including several different things without stating clearly what is included or not

cater to.en: to provide the things that a particular type of person wants, especially things that you do not approve of

cave in.zh: 塌落；塌陷；坍塌；让步；屈服；屈从
cave in.en: to fall down and towards the centre; to finally do what somebody wants after you have been strongly opposing them

cement.zh: 水泥；（干燥后硬化的）水泥；胶合剂；胶接剂；黏固剂；（共同利益联合起来的）纽带，凝聚力；（用水泥、胶等）黏结，胶合；加强，巩固（关系、协定等）
cement.en: a grey powder made by burning clay and lime that sets hard when it is mixed with water. Cement is used in building to stick stones and bricks together and to make very hard surfaces.; the hard substance that is formed when cement becomes dry and hard; a soft substance that becomes hard when dry and is used for sticking things together or filling in holes; something that joins people together in a common interest; to join two things together using cement, glue (= a sticky substance), etc.; to make a relationship, an agreement, etc. stronger

centrepiece.zh: 最重要的项目（或物品）；桌子中央的装饰品
centrepiece.en: the most important item; a decoration for the centre of a table

cessation.en: the stopping of something; a break in something

chalk up to.en: to consider that something is caused by something

charter.zh: （说明某部分民众应有权利的）宪章；（表明某一组织之宗旨和原则的）宪章，章程；（统治者或政府准许成立新的组织、城镇、大学等并授予某些权利的）特许状，许可证，凭照；（法律或政策的）不完善，漏洞，缺陷；（飞机、船等的）租赁；包租（飞机、船等）；特许设立；给予…特权；发给许可证（或凭照）
charter.en: a written statement describing the rights that a particular group of people should have; a written statement of the principles and aims of an organization; an official document stating that a government or political leader allows a new organization, town or university to be established and gives it particular rights; a law or policy that seems likely to help people do something bad; the hiring of a plane, boat, etc.; to hire a plane, boat, etc. for your own use; to state officially that a new organization, town or university has been established and has special rights

cheerleader.zh: 拉拉队队员（尤见于美国，通常为女性）；（某一政治家、某种观点或做法等的）支持者，摇旗呐喊者
cheerleader.en: (especially in the US) one of the members of a group of young people (usually women) wearing special uniforms, who encourage the crowd to cheer for their team at a sports event; a person who supports a particular politician, idea, or way of doing something

chilling.zh: （常与残暴有关）令人恐惧的，令人害怕的
chilling.en: frightening, usually because it is connected with something violent or cruel

chime in.en: to join or interrupt a conversation

civil servant.en: a person who works in the civil service

classified.zh: 机密的；保密的；分类的；归类的
classified.en: officially secret and available only to particular people; with information arranged in groups according to subjects; classified advertisements (= small advertisements in a newspaper or on a website, placed in sections according to their subjects)

clear-cut.zh: 明确的；明显的；易辨认的
clear-cut.en: definite and easy to see or identify

clubbing.en: the activity of going to nightclubs regularly

clutch.zh: 紧握；抱紧；抓紧；（因害怕或痛苦）突然抓住；（在危难中）抓救命稻草，不放过任何微小的机会；（汽车等换挡用的）离合器踏板；（尤指发动机和排挡的）离合器；一群（人或动物）；一批（物品）；势力范围；控制；掌管；攫住；紧紧抓住；（一次下的）一窝蛋；（同时孵出的）一窝小鸟；（尤指出席正式场合时用的）女式小手提包
clutch.en: to hold somebody/something tightly; to take hold of something suddenly, because you are afraid or in pain; to try all possible means to find a solution or some hope in a difficult or unpleasant situation, even though this seems very unlikely; the pedal in a car or other vehicle that you press with your foot so that you can change gear; a device in a machine that connects and disconnects working parts, especially the engine and the gears; a group of people, animals or things; power or control; a tight hold on somebody/something; a group of eggs that a bird lays at one time; the young birds that come out of a group of eggs at the same time; a small, flat bag that women carry in their hands, especially on formal occasions; at a critical moment; referring to or performing at an important moment that will decide the result of a game or competition

coax.en: to persuade somebody to do something by talking to them in a kind and gentle way

coercion.en: the action of making somebody do something that they do not want to do, using force or threatening to use force

combative.zh: 好战的；好斗的；好争论的
combative.en: ready and willing to fight or argue

commonwealth.zh: 英联邦（由英国和其他大多数曾经隶属于大英帝国的国家组成）；（用于美国肯塔基、马萨诸塞、宾夕法尼亚和弗吉尼亚四州的正式名称中）州；（与美国联系紧密的）自治政区；（用于某些政治上相互有联系的国家集团的名称）联合体
commonwealth.en: an organization consisting of the United Kingdom and other countries, including most of the countries that used to be part of the British Empire; used in the official names of, and to refer to, some states of the US (Kentucky, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania and Virginia); an independent country that is strongly connected to the US; used in the names of some groups of countries or states that have chosen to be politically linked with each other; a period (1649–60) in English history when the country was governed without a king or queen. For the first four years after the death of King Charles I, the country was governed by the House of Commons. Then in 1653 the army gave power to Oliver Cromwell with the title of Lord Protector. The years 1653–9 are therefore known as the Protectorate . The Commonwealth ended with the Restoration of King Charles II.

communal.zh: （尤指居住在一起的人）共享的，共有的，共用的；（集体中）不同群体的，各团体的
communal.en: shared by, or for the use of, a number of people, especially people who live together; involving different groups of people in a community

composure.en: the state of being calm and in control of your feelings or behaviour

conifer.en: any tree that produces hard dry fruit called cones. Most conifers are evergreen (= have leaves that stay on the tree all year).

conjure.zh: 变魔术；变戏法；使…变戏法般地出现（或消失）；大名鼎鼎的人；重量级人物；影响巨大的事物；难记的名字；拗口的名字
conjure.en: to do clever tricks such as making things seem to appear or disappear as if by magic; a person or thing that is well known and respected in a particular field; used when you mention a name that you think is difficult to remember or pronounce

conjure up.zh: 使…呈现于脑际；使想起；用咒语使…出现
conjure up.en: to make something appear as a picture in your mind; to make somebody/something appear by using special magic words

conservationist.en: a person who takes an active part in the protection of the environment

conspiracy.en: a secret plan by a group of people to do something harmful or illegal

constabulary.zh: （英国某地区或城镇的）警察部队
constabulary.en: the police force of a particular area or town

convergence.zh: 趋同：从不同方向一起开会和开会的过程；这发生的点；该市是河流交通的天然汇合点。；该图显示了两个大洋板块的收敛。；收敛：A和B变得非常相似或相同的过程；移动技术和互联网的融合将继续改变企业与消费者互动的方式。；鸟鸣声与人类合成音乐之间的融合
convergence.en: the process of moving together from different directions and meeting; the point where this happens; the process of becoming very similar or the same

cooperative.zh: 合作的；协作的；同心协力的；协助的；配合的；共同拥有共同经营利益共享的；合作的；合作企业；合作社组织
cooperative.en: involving doing something together or working together with others towards a shared aim; helpful by doing what you are asked to do; owned and run by the people involved, with the profits shared by them; a cooperative business or other organization

cornerstone.zh: 基石；奠基石；最重要部分；基础；柱石
cornerstone.en: a stone at the corner of the base of a building, often laid in a special ceremony; the most important part of something that the rest depends on

correlate.zh: 相互关联影响；相互依赖；显示（两个或多个事实或数字等）的紧密联系
correlate.en: if two or more facts, figures, etc. correlate or if a fact, figure, etc. correlates with another, the facts are closely connected and affect or depend on each other; to show that there is a close connection between two or more facts, figures, etc.; one of two or more facts, figures, etc. that are closely connected and affect or depend on each other

correlation.en: a connection between two things in which one thing changes as the other does

cough up.en: to give something, especially money, unwillingly

counterweight.zh: 平衡抵消物；平衡重（或块、锤）
counterweight.en: a thing that has an equal but opposite effect to something else and can be used to limit the bad effects of something

coupled with.en: to be linked to another thing, situation, etc.

cover letter.zh: 求职信：您发送的带有解释文档内容等内容的信件；发送简历和求职信给…
cover letter.en: a letter that you send with something explaining the contents of the document, etc. that you are sending

coverage.zh: 新闻报道；（书、课程学习、电视等的）信息范围，信息质量；提供的数量；覆盖范围；（保险公司的）保险
coverage.en: the reporting of news and sport in the media; the range or quality of information that is included in a book or course of study, on television, etc.; the amount of something that something provides; the extent to which something covers an area or a group of people; protection that an insurance company provides by promising to pay you money if a particular event happens

covert.zh: 秘密的；隐蔽的；暗中的；（动物可藏身的）矮树丛，灌木林
covert.en: secret or hidden, making it difficult to notice; an area of thick low bushes and trees where animals can hide

crafty.zh: 巧妙的；（尤指）狡诈的，诡计多端的
crafty.en: clever at getting what you want, especially by indirect or dishonest methods

crash out.en: to lose a game with the result that you have to stop playing in a competition

creed.zh: 信念；原则；纲领；宗教信仰；（基督教）信经
creed.en: a set of principles or religious beliefs; a statement of Christian belief that is spoken as part of some church services

criminal damage.zh: 刑事损害：人身伤害他人财产的犯罪；造成的损害；他对刑事损害认罪。
criminal damage.en: the crime of physically harming somebody else's property; the damage caused

crippling.zh: 使残废；使跛；使成瘸子；严重毁坏（或损害）
crippling.en: damaging somebody's body so that they are no longer able to walk or move normally; seriously damaging or harming somebody/something

crony.en: a person that somebody spends a lot of time with

crude.zh: 天然的；自然的；冒犯的，粗俗的，粗鲁的（尤其有关性的）；粗略的；简略的；大概的；粗糙的；粗制的；原油；石油
crude.en: in its natural state, before it has been processed or refined; not changed or corrected; offensive or rude, especially about sex; simple and not very accurate but giving a general idea of something; simply made, not showing much skill or attention to detail; oil in its natural state, before it has been processed or refined

curate.zh: （某教区的）助理牧师；好坏兼有之物；瑕瑜互见之物；管理（博物馆或美术馆的藏品）；策展；（尤在互联网上）精选并分享，策展（信息、图片、视频、音乐等）
curate.en: an assistant to a vicar (= a priest, who is in charge of the church or churches in a particular area); something that has some good parts and some bad ones; to select, organize and look after the objects or works of art in a museum or an art gallery, etc.; to collect, select and present information or items such as pictures, video, music, etc. for people to use or enjoy, using your professional or expert knowledge

curse.zh: 咒骂语；骂人话；咒；咒语；祸根；祸端；祸水；诅咒；咒骂；诅咒；在心里诅咒；念咒语诅咒
curse.en: a rude or offensive word or phrase that some people use when they are very angry; a word or phrase that has a magic power to make something bad happen; something that causes harm or evil; menstruation (= the process or time of menstruating); to swear; to say rude things to somebody or think rude things about somebody/something; to use a magic word or phrase against somebody in order to harm them

cynic.zh: 认为人皆自私的人；愤世嫉俗者；悲观者；怀疑者
cynic.en: a person who believes that people only do things to help themselves, rather than for good or sincere reasons; a person who does not believe that something good will happen or that something is important

cynicism.zh: 认为人皆自私的人；愤世嫉俗者；悲观的；怀疑的
cynicism.en: the belief that people only do things to help themselves, rather than for good or sincere reasons; the belief that something good will not happen or that something is not important; the fact of being willing to do something that might hurt other people, if you can gain some advantage

czar.zh: （在某领域向政府提供有关政策的建议的）政府顾问，政府高级官员
czar.en: the emperor of Russia in the past; an official whose job is to advise the government on policy in a particular area

damning.zh: 谴责的；诅咒的；可以定罪的
damning.en: critical of somebody/something; suggesting that somebody is guilty

dampen.zh: 弄湿；使潮湿；抑制，控制，减弱（感情、反应等）
dampen.en: to make something slightly wet; to make something such as a feeling or a reaction less strong

death spiral.zh: 死亡螺旋：失控的飞机所走的路径，在掉落到地面时迅速转弯；飞机坠入海中之前陷入死亡螺旋。；死亡螺旋：一种情况正在迅速恶化，通常以灾难告终；该公司正陷入成本上升和销售下降的绝境。
death spiral.en: the path taken by an aircraft that is out of control and is turning round and round quickly while falling towards earth; a situation that is quickly getting worse, often one that ends in disaster

debunk.en: to show that an idea, a belief, etc. is false; to show that something is not as good as people think it is

dedicated.zh: 献身的；专心致志的；一心一意的；专用的；专门用途的
dedicated.en: working hard at something because it is very important to you; designed to do only one particular type of work; used for one particular purpose only

dedication.zh: 献身；奉献；（建筑物等的）落成典礼；题献（作者在书、音乐作品、演出等开始前表示将其献给某人的一段话）
dedication.en: the hard work and effort that somebody puts into an activity or a purpose because they think it is important; a ceremony that is held to show that a building or an object has a special purpose or is special to the memory of a particular person; the words that are used at the beginning of a book, piece of music, a performance, etc., or when receiving an award, to offer it to somebody as a sign of thanks or respect

degradation.zh: 堕落；落魄，潦倒（的境况）；毁坏，恶化（过程）
degradation.en: a situation in which somebody has lost all self-respect and the respect of other people; the process of something being damaged or made worse
