deluge.zh: 暴雨；大雨；洪水；涌现的事物；蜂拥而至的事物；使涌来；使充满；泛滥；淹没
deluge.en: a severe flood; a sudden very heavy fall of rain; a large number of things that happen or arrive at the same time; to send or give somebody/something a large number of things at the same time; to flood a place with water

demotion.zh: 使降级，使降职，使降低地位（常作为惩罚）
demotion.en: a move to a lower position or rank, often as a punishment

dent.zh: 使凹陷；使产生凹痕；损害，伤害，挫伤（信心、名誉等）；凹痕；凹坑；凹部；减少，削减（尤指资金）
dent.en: to make a hollow place in a hard surface, usually by hitting it; to damage somebody’s confidence, reputation, etc.; a hollow place in a hard surface, usually caused by something hitting it; to reduce the amount of something, especially money

deportation.zh: 把（违法者或无居留权的人）驱逐出境；递解出境
deportation.en: the act of forcing somebody to leave a country, usually because they have broken the law or because they have no legal right to be there

deprivation.en: the fact of not having something that you need, like enough food, money or a home; the process that causes this

derail.en: to leave the track; to make a train do this; to stop a process from continuing in the way it was intended to

detached.zh: 单独的；独立的；不连接的；不带感情的；超然的；冷漠的；客观的；公正的；无偏见的
detached.en: not joined to another house on either side; showing a lack of feeling; not influenced by other people or by your own feelings

deterioration.zh: 恶化；她恶化成严重的抑郁症
deterioration.en: the fact or process of becoming worse

devolve.zh: 使(权力、职责等)下放；使移交；devolve
devolve.en: If you power, authority, or responsibility a less powerful person or group, or if it them, it is transferred to them.

differentiation.zh: 区分；区别；辨别；（尤指不公正地）差别对待，区别对待
differentiation.en: the act of recognizing or showing that two things are not the same; treatment of people or things in different ways, especially unfairly; the process of a cell becoming different during growth and development

dim.zh: 暗淡的；昏暗的；微弱的；不明亮的；光线暗淡的；昏暗的；不分明的；不清楚的；朦胧的；隐约的；看不清的；视力差的；模糊的；不清晰的；模糊的；迟钝的；愚笨的；愚蠢的；不明朗的；不乐观的；对…持不赞成（或怀疑）态度；对…没有好感；（使）变暗淡，变微弱，变昏暗；（使）减弱，变淡漠，失去光泽
dim.en: not bright; where you cannot see well because there is not much light; that you cannot see well because there is not much light; not able to see well; that you cannot remember or imagine clearly; not intelligent; not giving any reason to have hope; not good; to think somebody/something is bad; to not have a good opinion of somebody/something; if a light dims or if you dim it, it becomes or you make it less bright; if a feeling or quality dims, or if something dims it, it becomes less strong

discern.zh: 觉察出；识别；了解；（依稀）看出，分辨出，听出
discern.en: to know, recognize or understand something, especially something that is not obvious; to see or hear something, usually with difficulty

discerning.zh: 有识别力的；有眼力的；有洞察力的
discerning.en: able to show good judgement about the quality of somebody/something

disconnect.zh: 切断（燃气、水或电的供应）；切断（电话服务）；停止供应（水、电或燃气）；使分离；使脱离；使（电话线路）中断；（与互联网）断开
disconnect.en: to remove a piece of equipment from a supply of gas, water or electricity; to officially stop the supply of phone lines, water, electricity or gas to a building; to separate something from something; to break the contact between two people who are talking on the phone; to end a connection to the internet; to remove somebody's connection to a piece of equipment, especially a life support machine; a difference or lack of connection; a lack of connection with a network, a supply of electricity, the internet, etc.

disdain.zh: 鄙视；蔑视；鄙弃；不屑（做某事）
disdain.en: the feeling that somebody/something is not good enough to deserve your respect or attention; to think that somebody/something is not good enough to deserve your respect; to refuse to do something because you think that you are too important to do it

disgruntled.en: annoyed or disappointed because something has happened to upset you

disingenuous.zh: 不真诚；不诚实；假装不知道
disingenuous.en: not sincere, especially when you pretend to know less about something than you really do

dismantling.zh: 拆开，拆卸（机器或结构）；（逐渐）废除，取消
dismantling.en: the act of taking apart a machine or structure so that it is in separate pieces; the process of ending an organization or system gradually in an organized way

displacement.zh: 取代；替代；移位；免职；排水量
displacement.en: the act of forcing somebody/something away from their home or position; the amount of a liquid moved out of place by something floating or put in it, especially a ship floating in water

dissection.zh: 解剖（人或动植物）；仔细研究；详细评论；剖析
dissection.en: the act of cutting up a dead person, animal or plant in order to study it; the act of studying something closely and/or discussing it in great detail

dissonant.zh: 不和谐的；不和谐；不协调；不一致
dissonant.en: not sounding pleasant together; not in agreement

doctrine.zh: 教义；主义；学说；信条；（政府政策的）正式声明
doctrine.en: a belief or set of beliefs held and taught by a Church, a political party, etc.; a statement of government policy

dogged.en: showing determination; not giving up easily

domain.zh: （知识、活动的）领域，范围，范畴；域；论域；定义域；（尤指旧时个人、国家等所拥有或统治的）领土，领地，势力范围；区域；定义域
domain.en: an area of knowledge or activity; especially one that somebody is responsible for; a set of websites on the internet that end with the same group of letters, for example ‘.com’, ‘.org’; lands owned or ruled by a particular person, government, etc., especially in the past; the range of possible values of a particular variable

domicile.zh: （尤指正式或法律意义的）住处，住所，定居地
domicile.en: the country that a person treats as their permanent home, or lives in and has a strong connection with; a person's home; the place where a company is registered for tax purposes; to treat a particular country as your permanent home; to live or be based in a place

dominion.zh: 统治（权）；管辖；支配；领土；版图；（英联邦）自治领
dominion.en: authority to rule; control; an area controlled by one political leader; any of the countries of the British Commonwealth that had their own government

doomsday.zh: 最后审判日，世界末日（基督教认为在这一天世人都将接受上帝的审判）；直到世界末日；很长时间；永远
doomsday.en: the last day of the world when Christians believe that everyone will be judged by God; a very long time; forever

double take.zh: 愣了一会儿才恍然大悟的反应
double take.en: if you do a double take, you wait for a moment before you react to something that has happened, because it is very surprising

douse.zh: 浇灭（火）；熄（灯）；往…上泼水；把…浸在液体里
douse.en: to stop a fire from burning by pouring water over it; to put out a light; to pour a lot of liquid over somebody/something; to soak somebody/something in liquid

downbeat.zh: 沉闷的；令人沮丧的；悲观的；不强烈的；消沉的；无热情的
downbeat.en: depressing; not having much hope for the future; not showing strong feelings or enthusiasm

downstream.zh: 顺流而下；在下游方向；在下游的；引发的；导致的
downstream.en: in the direction in which a river flows; in a position along a river which is nearer the sea; happening as a consequence of something that has happened earlier

drastic.zh: 极端的；急剧的；严厉的；猛烈的
drastic.en: extreme in a way that has a sudden, serious or violent effect on something

drastically.zh: 极端的；急剧的；严厉的；猛烈的
drastically.en: in an extreme way that has a sudden, serious or violent effect on something

drawn-out.en: lasting a very long time, often too long

dumping ground.en: a place where something that is not wanted is dumped (= left)

dust off.en: to remove dust, dirt, etc. from somebody/something; to use something again after a long period of not using it

ebb.zh: 落潮；退潮；处于低潮；状况不佳；涨落；盛衰；起伏；消长；退；落；衰弱；衰退；减退
ebb.en: the period of time when the sea flows away from the land; in a poor state; worse than usual; the repeated, often regular, movement from one state to another; the repeated change in level, numbers or amount; to move away from the land; to become gradually weaker or less

eclipse.zh: 日食；月食；（重要性、权势等的）丧失，黯然失色，暗淡；遮住…的光；使失色；使相形见绌；使丧失重要性
eclipse.en: an occasion when the moon passes between the earth and the sun so that you cannot see all or part of the sun for a time; an occasion when the earth passes between the moon and the sun so that you cannot see all or part of the moon for a time; a loss of importance, power, etc. especially because somebody/something else has become more important, powerful, etc.; to cause an eclipse of the sun or the moon; to make somebody/something seem neither exciting nor important by comparison

edge out.en: to move somebody from their position or job gradually, especially when they are not fully aware of what is happening

effigy.zh: （名人、圣人或神的）雕像，塑像；（丑化人的）模拟像，画像
effigy.en: a statue of a famous person, a saint or a god; a model of a person that makes them look ugly

egg on.en: to encourage somebody to do something, especially something that they should not do

embed.zh: 把…牢牢地嵌入（或插入、埋入）；派遣（战地记者、摄影记者等）；嵌入（在 I'm aware that she knows 句中，she knows 为内嵌句）
embed.en: to fix something in a substance or solid object; to send a journalist, photographer, etc. to an area where there is fighting, so that he or she can travel with the army and report what is happening; to place a sentence inside another sentence. In the sentence ‘I’m aware that she knows’, she knows is an embedded sentence.

emblematic.zh: 标志的；象征（性）的；特有的；典型的；有代表性的
emblematic.en: that represents or is a symbol of something; that is considered typical of a situation, an area of work, etc.

emulation.en: the act of trying to do something as well as somebody else because you admire them; the act of a computer or computer program working in the same way as another computer or program and performing the same tasks

enclosure.zh: 圈占地；圈用地；围场；圈地；（信中）附件
enclosure.en: a piece of land that is surrounded by a fence or wall and is used for a particular purpose; the act of placing a fence or wall around a piece of land; something that is placed in an envelope with a letter

endemic.zh: 地方性的；（某地或某集体中）特有的，流行的，难摆脱的
endemic.en: regularly found in a particular place or among a particular group of people and difficult to get rid of

engender.zh: 产生，引起（某种感觉或情况）
engender.en: to make a feeling or situation exist

ephemera.zh: 只在短期内有用的事物
ephemera.en: things that are important or used for only a short period of time

ephemeral.en: lasting or used for only a short period of time

eradicate.en: to destroy or get rid of something completely, especially something bad

ethnic cleansing.en: (used especially in news reports) the policy of forcing the people of a particular race or religion to leave an area or a country

eureka moment.zh: 顿悟时刻；突发灵感的一刻
eureka moment.en: the moment when you suddenly understand something important, have a great idea, or find the answer to a problem

evade.zh: 逃脱；躲开；躲避；逃避，规避（尤指法律或道德责任）；回避，避开（处理或谈论某事）；使达不到；未发生在（某人）身上
evade.en: to escape from somebody/something or avoid meeting somebody; to find a way of not doing something, especially something that legally or morally you should do; to avoid dealing with or talking about something; to not come or happen to somebody

exacting.zh: 严谨细致的；要求小心仔细的；要求严格的
exacting.en: needing or demanding a lot of effort and care about details

exodus.en: a situation in which many people leave a place at the same time

expansive.zh: 广阔的；辽阔的；浩瀚的；广泛的；全面的；友善健谈的；开朗的；刺激经济扩展的
expansive.en: covering a large amount of space; covering a large subject area, rather than trying to be exact and use few words; friendly and willing to talk a lot; encouraging economic expansion

extraneous.zh: 没有直接联系的；无关的
extraneous.en: not directly connected with the particular situation you are in or the subject you are dealing with

falter.zh: 衰弱；衰退；衰落；（嗓音）颤抖；结巴地说；支吾其词；蹒跚；摇晃；犹豫；畏缩
falter.en: to become weaker or less effective; to speak in a way that shows that you are not confident; to walk or behave in a way that shows that you are not confident

fast-track.en: connected with or taking a quick way to achieve something, for example a high position in a job; to make somebody’s progress in achieving something, for example a high position in a job, quicker than usual

feat.zh: 技艺；武艺；功绩；英勇事迹
feat.en: an action or a piece of work that needs skill, strength or courage

fertile.zh: 肥沃的；富饶的；能生育的；可繁殖的；能结果的；能产生好结果的；促进的；点子多的；想象力丰富的
fertile.en: that plants grow well in; that can produce babies, young animals, fruit or new plants; that produces good results; that encourages activity; that produces a lot of new ideas

fervently.zh: 热情的；热忱的；热诚的；热烈的
fervently.en: in a way that shows very strong and sincere feelings about something

fiasco.zh: 惨败；可耻的失败；尴尬的结局
fiasco.en: something that does not succeed, often in a way that makes people feel embarrassed

fiddle.zh: （尤指厌烦或紧张地）不断摸弄，不停摆弄；篡改；伪造；对…做手脚；拉小提琴；修理；调整；摆弄；欺诈；骗钱行为；骗局；难事；搞骗钱勾当；非常健康；当二把手；当副手；居次要地位
fiddle.en: to keep touching or moving something with your hands, especially because you are bored or nervous; to change the details or figures of something in order to try to get money dishonestly or gain an advantage; to play music on the violin; a musical instrument with strings, that you hold under your chin and play with a bow; something that is done dishonestly to get money; something that is difficult to do; to be doing something dishonest to get money; in very good physical condition; to be treated as less important than somebody/something; to have a less important position than somebody/something else

filing.zh: 存档；归档；存档档案；归档记录；锉屑
filing.en: the act of putting documents, letters, etc. into a file; something that is placed in an official record; very small pieces of metal, made when a larger piece of metal is filed

fire drill.en: a practice of what people must do in order to escape safely from a fire in a building

fiscal year.en: a period of twelve months over which the accounts and taxes of a company or a person are calculated

fitness tracker.zh: 健身追踪器在认真的运动员中很受欢迎。
fitness tracker.en: a device that you can wear that records your daily physical activity, as well as other information about your health, such as your heart rate

fizzle out.zh: （顺利开始）结果失败，终成泡影；虎头蛇尾
fizzle out.en: to gradually become less successful and end in a disappointing way

flint.en: a type of very hard grey stone that can produce a spark when it is hit against steel; a piece of this stone; a piece of flint or hard metal that is used to produce a spark

flounder.zh: 不知所措；挠头；支吾；困难重重；艰苦挣扎；（在水、泥等中）挣扎；偏口鱼；比目鱼；鲽
flounder.en: to struggle to know what to say or do or how to continue with something; to have a lot of problems and to be in danger of failing completely; to struggle to move or get somewhere in water, mud, etc.; a small flat sea fish that is used for food

fly-by-night.zh: 无信用（或不可靠）而唯利是图的
fly-by-night.en: a person or business that is dishonest and only interested in making money quickly; dishonest and only interested in making money quickly

follow through.zh: （击球后球拍、球棒等）完成顺势动作；把…进行到底；完成（开了头的事）
follow through.en: to complete a single movement of the arm when hitting the ball by continuing to move the club, racket, etc. after hitting it; to finish something that you have started

food insecurity.zh: 粮食不安全：无法可靠地获得您可以负担得起的足够健康食品的状态；经历粮食不安全状况的家庭饮食质量下降或种类繁多。；估计有64％的人口已经遭受了长期粮食不安全的困扰。
food insecurity.en: the state of not having reliable access to enough healthy food that you can afford

foot soldier.zh: 步兵；（组织中从事乏味工作而不担责任，但又不可或缺的）群众员工
foot soldier.en: a soldier who fights on foot, not on a horse or in a vehicle; a person in an organization who does work that is important but boring, and who has no power or responsibility

footprint.zh: 脚印；足迹；（某物所占的）空间量，面积；（通信卫星）覆盖区
footprint.en: a mark left on a surface by a person’s foot or shoe or by an animal’s foot; a measure of the amount of the earth’s resources used by a person or a population that lives in a particular way; the amount of space that something fills; the area on the earth in which a signal from a communications satellite can be received

forage.zh: 觅（食）；（尤指用手）搜寻（东西）；（牛马的）饲料
forage.en: to search widely for food; to search for something, especially using the hands; food for horses and cows

foray.zh: （改变职业、活动的）尝试；突袭；闪电式袭击；短途（寻物）；短暂访问（新地方）
foray.en: an attempt to become involved in a different activity or profession; a short sudden attack made by a group of soldiers; a short journey to find a particular thing or to visit a new place

forefront.zh: 处于最前列；进入重要地位（或主要地位）
forefront.en: in or into an important or leading position in a particular group or activity

forgo.zh: 放弃，弃绝（想做的事或想得之物）
forgo.en: to decide not to have or do something that you would like to have or do

freak.zh: 狂热爱好者；（行为、外表、想法）怪异的人；怪人；（指人、动植物和东西）畸形；怪异的事；不寻常的事；不正常的；怪异的；（使）强烈反应，震惊，畏惧
freak.en: a person with a very strong interest in a particular subject; a person who is considered to be unusual because of the way they behave, look or think; a person, an animal, a plant or a thing that is not physically normal; a very unusual and unexpected event; very unusual and unexpected; if somebody freaks or if something freaks them, they react very strongly to something that makes them suddenly feel shocked, surprised, frightened, etc.

free pass.zh: 自由通行证；免费入场证
free pass.en: A is an official document that allows a person to travel or to enter a particular building without having to pay.

frenzy.en: a state of great activity and strong emotion that is often violent or frightening and not under control

fulfilling.zh: 让人感觉有意义的；令人满足的
fulfilling.en: causing somebody to feel satisfied and useful

fungus.zh: 真菌（如蘑菇和霉）；霉；霉菌
fungus.en: an organism (= a living thing) that is similar to a plant without leaves, flowers or green colouring, and that usually grows on plants or on decaying matter. mushrooms and mildew are both fungi.; a layer of mould or a similar fungus, for example on a plant or wall; an infection caused by a fungus

furnish.zh: 在（房屋等）处布置家具；向（某人或某事物）供应，提供
furnish.en: to put furniture in a house, room, etc.; to supply or provide somebody/something with something; to supply something to somebody

gatekeeper.zh: 看门人；守门人；门卫；看门人；把关系统
gatekeeper.en: a person whose job is to check and control who is allowed to go through a gate; a person, system, etc. that decides whether somebody/something will be allowed, or allowed to reach a particular place or person

generic.zh: 一般的；普通的；通用的；无厂家商标的；无商标的
generic.en: shared by, including or typical of a whole group of things; not specific; not using the name of the company that made it; lacking imagination and so not original; a version of an existing product that is not made by a well-known company

grace.zh: 优美；优雅；文雅；高雅；风度；体面；宽限期；延缓期；恩宠；恩典；（饭前的）谢恩祈祷；（对大主教、公爵、公爵夫人、女公爵的尊称）大人，阁下，夫人；摆架子；装腔作势；为某人所赞同（或喜爱）；得到某人的欢心；（尤指因做了错事或不道德之事而）失去信任，失去尊重，失去恩宠；（尤指因做了错事或不道德之事的）失信；（尤指犯错后）知趣地做某事，通情达理地做某事；（天主教指灵魂上没有大罪的状态）受天主眷爱，蒙受恩宠；若非天助，区区岂能幸免；勉强地；不情愿地；无礼地；心甘情愿地；乐意地；高高兴兴地；纪元某年；公元某年；为…增色；为…锦上添花；装饰；使荣耀；使生辉；承蒙光临
grace.en: an attractive quality of movement that is smooth and done with control; a simple and beautiful quality; a quality of behaviour that is polite and pleasant and deserves respect; ways of behaving that people think are polite and acceptable; extra time that is given to somebody to enable them to pay a bill, finish a piece of work, etc.; the love that God shows towards the human race; a short prayer that is usually said before a meal to thank God for the food; used as a title of respect when talking to or about an archbishop, a duke or a duchess; a way of behaving that shows that somebody thinks that they are more important, etc. than they really are; to have somebody’s approval and be liked by them; to lose the trust or respect that people have for you, especially by doing something bad or morally wrong; a situation in which somebody loses the trust or respect that people have for them, especially because they have done something that is bad or morally wrong; to be polite enough to do something, especially when you have done something wrong; (in the Roman Catholic Church) having been forgiven by God for the wrong or evil things you have done; used to say that you could easily have been in the same difficult or unpleasant situation that somebody else is in; in an unwilling and/or rude way; in a willing and pleasant way; any particular year after the birth of Christ; to make something more attractive; to decorate something; to bring honour to somebody/something; to be kind enough to attend or take part in something; a first name for girls

grail.zh: 圣杯（据信为耶稣离世前所用）；渴望但永远得不到的东西；努力追求但永远不可能实现的目标（或理想）
grail.en: the cup or bowl believed to have been used by Jesus Christ before he died, that became a holy thing that people wanted to find; a thing that you try very hard to find or achieve, but never will

graphic.zh: 绘画的；书画的；图样的；图案的；（尤指令人不快的事物）形象的，生动的，逼真的；（尤指电脑荧屏或报纸、书籍上的）图表，图形，图画
graphic.en: connected with drawings and design, especially in the production of books, magazines, websites, etc.; very clear and full of details, especially about something unpleasant; a diagram or picture, especially one that appears on a computer screen or in a newspaper or book

grassroots.zh: 基层民众；平民百姓；草根
grassroots.en: ordinary people in society or in an organization, rather than the leaders or people who make decisions

grave.zh: 坟墓；墓穴；坟头；死亡；去世；逝世；自掘坟墓；自取灭亡；自己害自己；一生；一世；从生到死；行将就木；命不久矣；大去之期不远；九泉之下不得安宁；严重的；重大的；严峻的；深切的；严肃的；庄严的；表情沉重的；钝重音符，沉音符，抑音符（标在元音上面表发音）
grave.en: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried; a way of referring to death or a person’s death; to do something that will have very harmful results for you; a way of referring to the whole of a person’s life, from birth until death; to be so old or ill that you are not likely to live much longer; likely to be very shocked or angry; very serious and important; giving you a reason to feel worried; serious in manner, as if something sad or important has just happened; a mark placed over a vowel in some languages to show how it should be pronounced, as over the e in the French word père

gridlock.zh: 市区交通大堵塞；僵局（因意见分歧而无法采取行动）
gridlock.en: a situation in which there are so many cars in the streets of a town that the traffic cannot move at all; a situation in which people with different opinions are not able to agree with each other and so no action can be taken

grievous bodily harm.en: the crime of causing somebody serious physical injury

grinding.zh: 没完没了的；无休止的；无改进的
grinding.en: that never ends or improves; rough and unpleasant to listen to

ground zero.zh: （核弹的）爆心投影点；归零地（2001 年 9 月 11 日炸毁的纽约双子大楼遗址）；开始；起点
ground zero.en: the point on the earth’s surface where a nuclear bomb explodes; the site of the Twin Towers in New York, destroyed on 11 September 2001; the beginning; a starting point for an activity

hacking.en: the activity of using computers to get access to data in somebody else's computer or phone system without permission

hail.zh: 赞扬（或称颂）…为（尤用于报章等）；招手叫（出租车或公共汽车）；跟…打招呼；向…喊；下雹；雹；冰雹；一阵像冰雹般袭来的事物；雹子般的一阵
hail.en: to describe somebody/something as being very good or special, especially in newspapers, etc.; to signal to a taxi or a bus, in order to get the driver to stop; to call to somebody in order to say hello to them or attract their attention; when it hails, small balls of ice fall like rain from the sky; small balls of ice that fall like rain; a large number or amount of something that is aimed at somebody in order to harm them

hallmark.zh: 特征；特点；金银纯度印记（打在金、银、铂制品上，表示纯度、生产日期及产地）；给…打金银纯度印记
hallmark.en: a feature or quality that is typical of somebody/something; a mark put on gold, silver and platinum objects that shows the quality of the metal and gives information about when and where the object was made; to put a hallmark on metal goods

hand-wringing.zh: 候选人和她的支持者在等待看到结果时经历了很多麻烦。；头条新闻称手机对我们的健康有害
hand-wringing.en: the behaviour that comes from being nervous or worried, especially when this seems excessive (= more than seems reasonable or appropriate)

handily.zh: 方便地；便利地；容易地；轻松地
handily.en: in a way that is handy (= convenient); easily

hard sell.en: a method of selling that puts a lot of pressure on the customer to buy

hardened.zh: 硬心肠的；冷酷无情的；麻木不仁的；hardened
hardened.en: If you describe someone as , you mean that they have had so much experience of something bad or unpleasant that they are no longer affected by it in the way that other people would be.

harness.zh: 马具；挽具；（用于人，起固定或保护作用的）背带，保护带；（尤指休息或假期结束后）做正常工作；（同某人）联手；密切合作；给（马等）上挽具；用挽具把…套到…上；控制，利用（以产生能量等）
harness.en: a set of narrow pieces of leather and metal pieces that is put around the head and body of an animal, especially a horse, so that the animal can be controlled and fastened to a carriage, etc.; a set of straps (= long narrow pieces of a strong material) for fastening something to a person’s body or to keep them from moving off or falling; doing your normal work, especially after a rest or a holiday; working closely with somebody in order to achieve something; to put a harness on a horse or other animal; to attach a horse or other animal to something with a harness; to control and use the force or strength of something to produce power or to achieve something

head-on.zh: 迎头相撞的；正面相撞的；正面反对的；迎头的
head-on.en: in which the front part of one vehicle hits the front part of another vehicle; in which people express strong views and deal with something in a direct way; in such a way that the front part of one vehicle hits the front part of another vehicle or thing; by expressing strong views and dealing with something in a direct way

heartland.zh: （国家或地区的）腹地，中心区域；（活动或政党的）重要场所，核心区域
heartland.en: the central part of a country or an area; an area that is important for a particular activity or political party

heed.zh: 留心，注意，听从（劝告或警告）；留心；注意；听从
heed.en: to pay careful attention to somebody’s advice or warning; to pay careful attention to somebody/something

hefty.zh: 大而重的；很大的；超出一般的；可观的；用力的；猛烈的
hefty.en: big and heavy; large; larger than usual or expected; using a lot of force

heir apparent.zh: 当然继承人；法定继承人；（职位的）确定接替者；确定接班者
heir apparent.en: an heir whose legal right to receive somebody’s property, money or title cannot be taken away because it is impossible for somebody with a stronger claim to be born; a person who is expected to take the job of somebody when that person leaves

hike.zh: 远足；徒步旅行；（价格、花费等的）大幅度提高，猛增；滚开；走开；去…远足；做徒步旅行；把（价格、税率等）大幅提高
hike.en: a long walk in the country; a large or sudden increase in prices, costs, etc.; a rude way of telling somebody to go away; to go for a long walk in the country, especially for pleasure; to spend time hiking for pleasure; to increase prices, taxes, etc. suddenly by large amounts

hollow.zh: 中空的；空心的；凹陷的；沉闷回荡的；空响的；无诚意的；虚伪的；无真正价值的；给人以真实（或空洞、虚假）的印象；凹陷处；坑洼处；洞；孔；围起来的空间；挖
hollow.en: having a hole or empty space inside; sinking deeply into the face; making a low sound like that made by an empty object when it is hit; not sincere; without real value; to give the impression of not being sincere or true; to give the impression of being sincere/true or not sincere/true; an area that is lower than the surface around it, especially on the ground; a hole or an empty space inside something; to make a flat surface go inward in a curve

homely.zh: 在家一样舒适的；犹如在自家一样的；简单且好的；家常的；热情友好并热衷家庭生活的；亲切喜家的；相貌平平的
homely.en: making you feel comfortable, as if you were in your own home; simple and good; warm and friendly and enjoying the pleasures of home and family; not attractive

hot flush.zh: 热潮红（皮肤的灼热阵感，尤见于更年期女性）
hot flush.en: a sudden hot and uncomfortable feeling in the skin, especially experienced by women during the menopause

hubris.en: the fact of being too proud. In literature, a character with this quality ignores warnings and laws and this usually results in their downfall and death.

hysterical.zh: 歇斯底里的；情绪狂暴不可抑止的；极其可笑的
hysterical.en: in a state of extreme excitement, and crying, laughing, etc. without any control; extremely funny

idiosyncratic.zh: 特质：不寻常，特别是对人或事物
idiosyncratic.en: unusual and particular to a person or thing

idyllic.zh: 平和美丽的；完美无瑕的
idyllic.en: peaceful and beautiful; perfect, without problems

impoverished.zh: 赤贫的；不名一文的；贫乏的；贫瘠的；枯竭的
impoverished.en: very poor; without money; poor in quality, because something is missing

improvisation.zh: 即兴创作（音乐、台词、演讲词等）
improvisation.en: the act of inventing music, the words in a play, a statement, etc. while you are playing or speaking, instead of planning it in advance; something that is invented in this way

in situ.zh: 在原位；在原地；在合适地方
in situ.en: in the original or correct place

incidental.zh: 附带发生的；次要的；非有意的；作为自然结果的；伴随而来的；免不了的；附带的次要事情
incidental.en: happening in connection with something else, but not as important as it, or not intended; happening as a natural result of something; something that happens in connection with something else, but is less important

incite.en: to encourage somebody to do something violent, illegal or unpleasant, especially by making them angry or excited

incursion.zh: 突然入侵；突然侵犯；袭击；（意外的）搅扰，介入
incursion.en: a sudden attack on a place by foreign armies, etc.; the sudden appearance of something in a particular area of activity that is either not expected or not wanted

indict.en: to officially charge somebody with a crime

indispensable.zh: 不可或缺的；必不可少的

indoctrination.en: the act or process of forcing somebody to accept a particular belief or set of beliefs and not allowing them to consider any others

inequity.zh: 不公正的事；不公正；不公平
inequity.en: something that is unfair; the state of being unfair

inextricably.zh: 不可分开地；密不可分地
inextricably.en: if two things are inextricably linked, etc., it is impossible to separate them

infuse.zh: 使具有，注入（某特性）；全面影响；泡制（草药等）；泡；沏；输注（药物等）
infuse.en: to make somebody/something have a particular quality; to have an effect on all parts of something; if you infuse herbs, etc. or they infuse, you put them in hot water until the taste has passed into the water; to slowly put a drug or other substance into a person’s vein

inhibition.zh: 拘谨；拘束感；阻止；抑制；禁止
inhibition.en: a shy or nervous feeling that stops you from expressing your real thoughts or feelings; the act of limiting or preventing a process or an action

innate.zh: 天生的；先天的；与生俱来的
innate.en: that you have when you are born

inner circle.en: the small group of people who have a lot of power in an organization, or who control it

inroads.en: If one thing another, the first thing starts affecting or destroying the second.

instrumental.zh: 起重要作用；用乐器演奏的；为乐器谱写的；工具格；工具词；器乐曲
instrumental.en: important in making something happen; made by or for musical instruments; in the form that a noun, pronoun or adjective has when it refers to a thing that is used to do something; a piece of music (usually popular music) in which only musical instruments are used with no singing; the form of a noun, pronoun or adjective when it refers to a thing that is used to do something

insurgent.en: fighting against the government or armed forces of their own country; a person fighting against the government or armed forces of their own country

interfere.en: to get involved in and try to influence a situation that should not really involve you, in a way that annoys other people

interplay.en: the way in which two or more things or people affect each other

intrinsically.en: in a way that belongs to or is part of the real nature of somebody/something

intuitive.zh: 凭直觉得到的；直觉的；有直觉力的；易懂的；使用简便的
intuitive.en: obtained by using your feelings rather than by considering the facts; able to understand something by using feelings rather than by considering the facts; easy to understand and to use

irrespective of.en: without considering something or being influenced by it

ivory tower.zh: 象牙塔（指远离问题、脱离现实的小天地）
ivory tower.en: a place or situation where you are separated from the problems and practical aspects of normal life and therefore do not have to worry about or understand them

jettison.zh: （为减轻重量而从行驶的飞机或船上）扔弃，丢弃，投弃；摆脱；除掉；处理掉；放弃，拒绝接受（想法、信念、计划等）
jettison.en: to throw something out of a moving plane or ship to make it lighter; to get rid of something/somebody that you no longer need or want; to reject an idea, a belief, a plan, etc. that you no longer think is useful or likely to be successful

kin.zh: （统称）家属，亲属，亲戚；亲戚朋友
kin.en: your family or your relatives; friends and relatives

knack.en: a special skill or ability that you have naturally or can learn; a habit of doing something

labyrinth.en: a complicated series of paths, which it is difficult to find your way through

lamented.zh: 令人悼念（或怀念）的；使人思念的

landslide.zh: （山坡或悬崖的）崩塌，塌方，滑坡，地滑；一方选票占压倒多数的选举；一方占绝对优势的选举
landslide.en: a mass of earth, rock, etc. that falls down the slope of a mountain or a cliff; an election in which one person or party gets very many more votes than the other people or parties

lap up.zh: （不加考虑地）乐于接受；开怀畅饮
lap up.en: to accept or receive something with great pleasure, without thinking about whether it is good, true or sincere; to drink all of something and to enjoy doing so

legion.zh: （尤指古罗马的）军团；大量，大批（某类型的人）；很多；极多
legion.en: a large group of soldiers that forms part of an army, especially the one that existed in ancient Rome; a large number of people of one particular type; very many

level at.zh: （尤指对犯罪或犯错的人）公开指责，谴责
level at.en: to say publicly that somebody is to blame for something, especially a crime or a mistake

lichen.en: a very small grey or yellow plant that spreads over the surface of rocks, walls and trees and does not have any flowers

line up.zh: 排成一行；站队；排队（等候）；使站成一队；使排列成一行；组织，安排（活动）；邀集（人做某事）；使…（与相关的另一物）排齐；使…对齐
line up.en: to stand in a line or row; to form a queue; to arrange people or things in a straight line or row; to arrange for an event or activity to happen, or arrange for somebody to be available to do something; to move one thing into a correct position in relation to another thing

living wage.zh: 基本生活工资；仅能维持生活的工资
living wage.en: a wage that is high enough for somebody to buy the things they need in order to live

lobbyist.en: a person whose job involves trying to influence politicians or the government and, for example, persuade them to support or oppose a change in the law

loom.zh: 赫然耸现；（尤指）令人惊恐地隐现；显得突出；逼近；令人忧虑，令人惊恐（并似乎难以避免）；织布机
loom.en: to appear as a large shape that is not clear, especially in a frightening way; to appear serious and and likely to happen soon; to be frightening and make you worried because something seems hard to avoid; a machine for making cloth by crossing threads over and under other threads that go in a different direction

lopsided.zh: 一侧比另一侧低（或小等）的；向一侧倾斜的；不平衡的
lopsided.en: having one side lower, smaller, etc. than the other; lacking balance; with a lot more attention, points, votes, etc. on one side than the other

maneuver.zh: 细致巧妙的移动；机动动作；策略；手段；花招；伎俩；军事演习；作战演习；改变事态的机会；回旋余地
maneuver.en: a movement performed with care and skill; a clever plan, action or movement that is used to give somebody an advantage; military exercises involving a large number of soldiers, ships, etc.; the chance to change the way that something happens and influence decisions that are made; to move or turn with skill or care; to move or turn something with skill or care; to control or influence a situation in a way that shows skill but is sometimes dishonest

manslaughter.en: the crime of killing somebody illegally but not deliberately

mantra.zh: 曼怛罗（某些宗教的念咒）；咒语
mantra.en: a word, phrase or sound that is repeated again and again, especially during prayer or meditation; a statement or slogan that is often repeated

manual.zh: 用手的；手工的；体力的；手动的；手控的；用手操作的；手工的；用手的；使用手册；说明书；指南；处于非自动状态；处于手动状态
manual.en: involving using the hands or physical strength; operated or controlled by hand rather than by machine or using electricity, etc.; connected with using the hands; a book that tells you how to do or operate something, especially one that comes with a machine, etc. when you buy it; a vehicle with a system of gears operated by the driver using a gear lever; not being operated by a machine, etc. but by hand

map onto.en: to link a group of qualities, items, etc. with their source, cause, position on a scale, etc.

mark up.zh: 提价；加价；涨价；审校；标注排版说明
mark up.en: to increase the price of something; to mark or correct a text, etc., for example for printing

markedly.zh: 明显地：以一种容易注意到的方式
markedly.en: in a way that is easy to notice

marriage bureau.en: an organization that introduces people who are looking for somebody to marry

marshal.zh: （英国）陆军元帅，空军元帅；司仪；典礼官；（美国法院的）执行官；（一些美国城市的）警察局长，消防局长；结集；收集；安排；控制人群；组织；维持秩序
marshal.en: an officer of the highest rank in the armed forces of some countries; a person responsible for making sure that public events, especially sports events, take place without any problems, and for controlling crowds; (in the US) an officer whose job is to put court orders into effect; (in some US cities) an officer of high rank in a police or fire department; to gather together and organize the people, things, ideas, etc. that you need for a particular purpose; to control or organize a large group of people, especially soldiers

materialistic.zh: 物质享乐主义的；贪图享乐的
materialistic.en: caring more about money and possessions than anything else

maverick.zh: 持不同意见者；独行其是者；言行与众不同者
maverick.en: independent, with unusual opinions; a person who does not behave or think like everyone else, but who has independent, unusual opinions

means test.zh: 收入调查，经济情况调查（以确定是否可领取政府补贴等）
means test.en: an official check of somebody’s wealth or income in order to decide if they are poor enough to receive money from the government, etc. for a particular purpose

mediocre.en: not very good; of only average standard

menial.zh: 不需技巧的；枯燥的；报酬低的；仆人；佣人
menial.en: not considered important; not needing special skills and often boring or badly paid; a person with a menial job

merit.zh: 优点；美德；价值；值得赞扬（或奖励、钦佩）的特点；功绩；长处；（学校考试或作业的）良好；（在校操行好而获得的）良好；应得；值得
merit.en: the quality of being good and of deserving praise or reward; a good feature that deserves praise or reward; a grade in an exam or for a piece of work at school or university that is very good; a special mark or award given as a reward for good behaviour at school; to deserve praise, attention, etc.

midwife.en: a person, especially a woman, who is trained to help women give birth to babies

militarization.en: the act of making something operate in a similar way to the armed forces; the act of sending armed forces to an area

minimalist.zh: 极简抽象派艺术家；简约主义者
minimalist.en: using very simple ideas or a very small number of simple elements; an artist, a musician or a designer who uses very simple ideas or a very small number of simple elements in their work

moan.zh: 呻吟；抱怨；呼啸；发出萧萧声；呻吟声；（尤指风的）呼啸声，萧萧声
moan.en: to make a long deep sound, usually because you are unhappy or suffering or are experiencing sexual pleasure; to complain about something in a way that other people find annoying; to make a long deep sound; a long deep sound, usually made because you are unhappy or suffering or are experiencing sexual pleasure; a complaint about something; a long deep sound, especially the sound that is made by the wind

monopoly.zh: 垄断；专营服务；被垄断的商品（或服务）；独占；专利；专利品；“大富翁”（棋类游戏，游戏者以玩具钞票买卖房地产）
monopoly.en: the complete control of trade in particular goods or the supply of a particular service; a type of goods or a service that is controlled in this way; the complete control, possession or use of something; a thing that belongs only to one person or group and that other people cannot share; a board game in which players have to pretend to buy and sell land and houses, using pieces of paper that look like money

mount.zh: 准备；安排；组织开展；逐步增加；骑上；乘上；跨上；登上；爬上；攀登；镶嵌；安置；爬上（雌性动物的背）交配；守卫；看守；保卫；山；山峰；坐骑；衬纸板；载片；裱褙；托架；支撑架
mount.en: to organize and begin something; to increase gradually; to get on a bicycle, horse, etc. in order to ride it; to go up something, or up on to something that is raised; to fix something into position on something, so that you can use it, look at it or study it; to get onto the back of a female animal in order to have sex; to watch or protect somebody/something; a mountain or a hill; a horse that you ride on; something such as a piece of card or glass that you put something on or attach something to, to display it; something that an object stands on or is attached to for support

mull.en: a large island of the Inner Hebrides in Scotland. It is known for its high cliffs and beautiful scenery, and is popular with tourists.

murky.zh: 浑浊的；污浊的；昏暗的；阴暗的；朦胧的；隐晦的；含糊的；暧昧可疑的
murky.en: not clear; dark or dirty with mud or another substance; dark and unpleasant because of smoke, fog, etc.; not clearly known and suspected of not being honest

mute.zh: 沉默的；不出声的；无声的；哑的；弱音器；哑巴；消音；减音；减弱（尤指乐器）的声音；减弱；缓解
mute.en: not speaking; not expressed in speech; unable to speak; the mute button on a phone, television, etc.; a device made of metal, rubber or plastic that you use to make the sound of a musical instrument softer; a person who is not able to speak; to turn off the sound on a phone, television, etc.; to make the sound of something, especially a musical instrument, quieter or softer, sometimes using a mute; to make something weaker or less severe

myth.zh: 神话；神话故事；虚构的东西；荒诞的说法；不真实的事
myth.en: a story from ancient times, especially one that was told to explain natural events or to describe the early history of a people; this type of story; something that many people believe but that does not exist or is false

narcissistic.zh: 自我陶醉，自赏，自恋（尤指对自己的容貌）
narcissistic.en: admiring yourself too much, especially your appearance

navigator.en: a person who navigates, for example on a ship or an aircraft

non-committal.zh: 态度不明朗的；不表态的；含糊的
non-committal.en: not giving an opinion; not showing which side of an argument you agree with

non-invasive.zh: 非侵入的；非创伤的；无创的
non-invasive.en: not involving cutting into the body

notch.zh: 等级；档次；位阶；（表面或边缘的）V 形刻痕，圆形切口；赢取；获得；（在表面或边缘）刻 V 形痕，刻下切口
notch.en: a level on a scale, often marking quality or achievement; a V-shape or a circle cut in an edge or a surface, sometimes used to keep a record of something; each of a series of holes, for example in a belt; to achieve something such as a win or a high score; to make a small cut in the shape of a V in an edge or a surface

notch up.en: If you something such as a score or total, you achieve it.

oblige.zh: （以法律、义务等）强迫，迫使；（根据要求或需要）帮忙，效劳
oblige.en: to force somebody to do something, by law, because it is a duty, etc.; to help somebody by doing what they ask or what you know they want

obsessed.zh: 对…着迷的；受…困扰的；为…心神不宁的；obsessed
obsessed.en: If someone is a person or thing, they keep thinking about them and find it difficult to think about anything else.

off-label.zh: （药物）有标签外作用的，未按标签说明使用的
off-label.en: relating to the use of a drug for something other than what it was originally created for; in a way that uses a drug for something other than what it was originally created for

omnibus.zh: （广播、电视）综合节目；（若干种作品的）汇编，选集；公共汽车；综合性的；选编的
omnibus.en: a television or radio programme that combines several recent programmes in a series; a large book that contains a number of books, for example novels by the same author; a bus; including many things or different types of thing; a British television programme about the arts. It was broadcast by the BBC from 1967 to 2003. Each programme was usually about one particular artist.; a US cultural television programme broadcast on CBS on Sunday afternoons from 1952 to 1961. It was presented by Alistair Cooke and offered a mixture of plays, music, talks with artistic people, and even comedy.

onerous.zh: 费力的；艰巨的；令人焦虑的
onerous.en: needing great effort; causing trouble or worry

op.en: a medical operation; the department in a company that manages the way it produces goods or delivers services and makes sure its business practices are efficient; military activity; military operations

orient.zh: 使朝向；使面对；确定方向；使适应；确定方位；认识方向；熟悉；适应；东方（尤指中国和日本）
orient.en: to direct somebody/something towards something; to make or adapt somebody/something for a particular purpose; to find your position in relation to everything that is around or near you; to make yourself familiar with a new situation; the eastern part of the world, especially China and Japan

overarching.zh: 非常重要的；首要的；概莫能外的
overarching.en: very important, because it includes or influences many things

overheated.zh: 太热的；过热的；过于热心的；过于兴奋的；痴迷的；过热的；增长过快的
overheated.en: too hot; too interested or excited; too active in a way that may cause problems

own goal.zh: 乌龙球；射进自家球门的球；帮倒忙的事；无意中让自己吃亏的事
own goal.en: a goal that is scored by mistake by a player against his or her own team; something that you do that achieves the opposite of what you wanted and that brings you a disadvantage

paper over.zh: 糊壁纸遮盖；暂时掩盖，权且掩饰（问题或分歧）
paper over.en: to cover a wall with wallpaper in order to hide something; to try to hide a problem in a way that is temporary and not likely to be successful

paramilitary.zh: 非法军事组织的；辅助军事的；准军事的；非法军事集团（或组织）的成员；辅助军事组织的成员；准军事组织的成员
paramilitary.en: a paramilitary organization is an illegal group that is organized like an army; helping the official army of a country; a member of an illegal paramilitary group or organization; a member of an organization that helps the official army of a country

paraplegic.zh: 截瘫病人；下身麻痹患者
paraplegic.en: a person who suffers from paraplegia; suffering from paraplegia; connected with paraplegia

parochial school.zh: （由某个基督教教派办的）教区学校
parochial school.en: a private school supported by a particular Christian church

parole.zh: 假释；有条件的释放；言语；假释；有条件地释放
parole.en: permission that is given to a prisoner to leave prison before the end of their sentence on condition that they behave well; language considered as the words individual people use, rather than as the communication system of a particular community; to give a prisoner permission to leave prison before the end of their sentence on condition that they behave well

pensioner.zh: 领养老金（或退休金、抚恤金）者
pensioner.en: a person who is receiving a pension, especially from the government

perennial.zh: 长久的；持续的；反复出现的；多年生的；多年生植物
perennial.en: continuing for a very long time; happening again and again; living for two years or more; any plant that lives for more than two years

peril.zh: 严重危险；祸害；险情；（警告对方）自冒风险
peril.en: serious danger; the fact of something being dangerous or harmful; used to warn somebody that if they do something, it may be dangerous or cause them problems

permeate.zh: 渗透；弥漫；扩散；感染；传播；扩散
permeate.en: to spread to every part of an object or a place; to affect every part of something

petition.zh: 请愿书；申诉书；申请书；祈祷；祈求；祈求；请求；请愿；（向法庭）请求，申请
petition.en: a written document signed by a large number of people that asks somebody in a position of authority to do or change something; an official document asking a court to take a particular course of action; a formal prayer to God or request to somebody in authority; to make a formal request to somebody in authority, especially by sending them a petition; to formally ask for something in court

petulant.zh: 闹脾气的；爱耍性子的；赌气的；任性的
petulant.en: behaving in an angry or sulky way, especially because you cannot do or have what you want

philanthropy.en: the practice of helping the poor and those in need, especially by giving money

pick on.zh: （跟某人）闹别扭；故意刁难挑剔；挑选；选中
pick on.en: to treat somebody unfairly, by blaming, criticizing or punishing them; to choose somebody/something

piecemeal.zh: 逐渐做成（或发生）的；零敲碎打的；零散的
piecemeal.en: done or happening gradually at different times and often in different ways, rather than carefully planned at the beginning; gradually at different times and often in different ways, rather than in a way that is carefully planned at the beginning

pinpoint.zh: 明确指出，确定（位置或时间）；准确解释（或说明）；准确的；精确的；极小的范围；光点
pinpoint.en: to find and show the exact position of somebody/something or the exact time that something happened; to be able to give the exact reason for something or to describe something exactly; if something is done with pinpoint accuracy, it is done exactly and in exactly the right position; a very small area of something, especially light

pious.zh: 虔诚的；虔敬的；道貌岸然的；伪善的；假正经的；可望而不可即的；难以实现的
pious.en: having or showing a deep respect for God and religion; pretending to be religious, moral or good in order to impress other people; something that you want to happen but is unlikely to be achieved

pit.zh: 深洞；深坑；矿井；麻子；痘瘢；果核；（赛车道旁的）维修站；乐池，乐队席（舞台前乐队演奏的地方）；（交易所中某一商品的）交易场所；是坏典型；是拙劣典型；最糟糕；无限度事物；无休止的状况；无底洞；心窝；心底；使…表面有斑点；在…上打洞；去掉…的果核
pit.en: a large deep hole in the ground; a deep hole in the ground from which minerals are dug out; a place underground where coal is dug; a small shallow hole in the surface of something, especially a mark left on the surface of the skin by some disease, such as chickenpox; a hard shell containing the nut or seed in the middle of some types of fruit; a place near the track where cars can stop for fuel, new tyres, etc. during a race; the place in a theatre just in front of the stage where the orchestra sits and plays for an opera, a ballet, etc.; an armpit (= the part of the body under the arm where it joins the shoulder); the area of a stock exchange where a particular product is traded; to be very bad or the worst example of something; a thing or situation which seems to have no limits or seems never to end; the bottom of the stomach where people say they feel strong feelings, especially fear; to make marks or holes on the surface of something; to remove the stone from the inside of a fruit

plague.zh: 死亡率高的传染病；瘟疫；（大批动物或昆虫肆虐造成的）灾害，祸患；像避瘟疫似的躲着某人（或某事物）；尽量避开某人（或某事物）；给…造成长时间的痛苦（或麻烦）；困扰；折磨；使受煎熬；纠缠；缠磨；缠扰
plague.en: a disease spread by rats that causes a high temperature, swellings (= areas that are larger and rounder than usual) on the body and usually death; any disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people; large numbers of an animal or insect that come into an area and cause great damage; to try very hard not to meet somebody, do something, etc.; to cause pain or trouble to somebody/something over a period of time; to annoy somebody or create problems, especially by asking for something, demanding attention, etc.

plasma.en: the clear liquid part of blood, in which the blood cells, etc. float; a gas that contains approximately equal numbers of positive and negative electric charges and is present in the sun and most stars

plateau.zh: 高原；（发展、增长后的）稳定期，停滞期；（在一段时期的发展后）保持稳定水平，处于停滞状态
plateau.en: an area of flat land that is higher than the land around it; a time of little or no change after a period of growth or progress; to stay at a steady level after a period of growth or progress

plight.zh: 苦难；困境；苦境；许婚；以身相许
plight.en: a difficult and sad situation; to make a promise to a person saying that you will marry them; to marry somebody

plumbing.zh: （建筑物的）管路系统，自来水管道；水暖工的工作
plumbing.en: the system of pipes, etc. that supply water to a building; the work of a plumber

point-blank.zh: 挨着的；近身的；近距离的；直截了当（缺乏礼貌）的
point-blank.en: fired with the gun touching or very close to the person or thing it is aimed at; very definite and direct and not very polite; with the gun touching or very close to the person or thing it is aimed at; in a very definite and direct way that is not very polite

pole position.zh: （汽车、自行车比赛的）杆位，首发位置
pole position.en: the leading position at the start of a race involving cars or bicycles; the leading position in a competition or contest

pore over.zh: 仔细打量；审视；认真研读；审阅
pore over.en: to look at or read something very carefully

predate.zh: 早于；先于…建成（或形成、发生等）
predate.en: to be built or formed, or to happen, at an earlier date than something else in the past

predecessor.zh: 前任；原先的东西；被替代的事物
predecessor.en: a person who did a job before somebody else; a thing, such as a machine, that has been followed or replaced by something else

press on.zh: 坚决继续进行；匆忙前进；加紧；勉强某人接受；强迫某人吃（或喝）
press on.en: to continue doing something in a determined way; to hurry forward; to try to make somebody accept something, especially food or drink, although they may not want it

press release.en: an official statement made to journalists by a large organization, a political party or a government department

presumptive.zh: 很可能的；假设的；推断的
presumptive.en: likely to be true, based on the facts that are available

primer.zh: 底漆；底层涂料；初级读本；入门书；识字课本；启蒙读本
primer.en: a type of paint that is put on wood, metal, etc. before it is painted to help the paint to stay on the surface; a book that contains basic instructions; a book for teaching children how to read, or containing basic facts about a school subject

procreation.en: the act or process of producing children or baby animals

proliferate.en: to increase rapidly in number or amount

prone.zh: 易于遭受；有做（坏事）的倾向；有做…倾向的；易于遭受…的；俯卧的
prone.en: likely to suffer from something or to do something bad; likely to suffer or do the thing mentioned; lying flat with the front of your body touching the ground

prophylactic.zh: 预防疾病的；预防性药物（或器具、措施）
prophylactic.en: done or used in order to prevent a disease; a medicine, device or course of action that prevents disease; a condom (= a thin rubber tube that a man wears over his penis during sex to stop a woman from becoming pregnant or to protect against disease)

proponent.en: a person who supports an idea or course of action

proportionality.zh: （行动、处罚等的）相称原则，恰当性
proportionality.en: the principle that an action, a punishment, etc. should not be more severe than is necessary

provisional.en: arranged for the present time only and likely to be changed in the future; arranged, but not yet definite

prowess.zh: 非凡的技能；高超的技艺；造诣

proximity.en: the state of being near somebody/something in distance or time

prune.zh: 干梅子；西梅干；李子干；修剪树枝；打杈；裁减；削减；精简
prune.en: a dried plum that is often eaten cooked; to cut off some of the branches from a tree, bush, etc. so that it will grow better and stronger; to make something smaller by removing parts; to cut out parts of something

pull off.zh: 驶向路边短暂停车；做成，完成（困难的事情）
pull off.en: to leave the road in order to stop for a short time; to succeed in doing something difficult

punter.zh: 顾客；主顾；客户；赌马的人
punter.en: a person who buys or uses a particular product or service; a person who bets money on the result of a horse race

purported.en: that has been stated to have happened or to be true, when this might not be the case

push through.en: to get a new law or plan officially accepted

quick fix.zh: 应急解决办法；权宜之计；quick fix
quick fix.en: If you refer to a to a problem, you mean a way of solving a problem that is easy but temporary or inadequate.

quintessential.zh: 典型：代表事物的完美典范
quintessential.en: representing the perfect example of something

ramp.zh: 斜坡；坡道；（进出高速公路等的）支路，引路，匝道；（装车或上下飞机的）活动梯，活动坡道；（时装模特走秀的）T 型台
ramp.en: a slope that joins two parts of a road, path, building, etc. when one is higher than the other; a road used for driving onto or off a major road such as a motorway or interstate; a slope or set of steps that can be moved, used for loading a vehicle or getting on or off a plane; the long stage that models walk on during a fashion show

ramp up.en: to make something increase in amount

rampant.en: existing or spreading everywhere in a way that cannot be controlled; growing thickly and very fast in a way that cannot be controlled

ratify.en: to make an agreement officially or legally valid by voting for or signing it

reactor.en: a large structure used to produce nuclear energy

rebound.zh: 弹回；反弹；报应；反作用于；回升；反弹；反弹球；回弹球；抢篮板球；复兴；振作；（尤指关系破裂之后）在伤心困惑之时
rebound.en: to bounce back after hitting something; if something that you do rebounds on you, it has an unpleasant effect on you, especially when the effect was intended for somebody else; to rise again after they have fallen; a ball that hits something and bounces back; the act of catching the ball after a player has thrown it at the basket and has not scored a point; a positive reaction that happens after something negative; while you are sad and confused, especially after a relationship has ended

rebuke.en: the act of speaking severely to somebody because they have done something wrong; to speak severely to somebody because they have done something wrong

recast.zh: 改动；重组；改写；重新安排（演员阵容）；改变（演员角色）
recast.en: to change something by organizing or presenting it in a different way; to change the actors or the role of a particular actor in a play, etc.

red alert.zh: 紧急戒备状态；紧急警报
red alert.en: a situation in which you are prepared for something dangerous to happen; a warning of this

red flag.zh: 示警红旗；（象征革命或共产主义的）红旗
red flag.en: a flag used to warn people of danger; a red flag as a symbol of revolution or communism

refurbishment.en: the act or process of cleaning and decorating a room, building, etc. in order to make it more attractive, more useful, etc.

refutation.zh: 反驳：证明或陈述某事不正确或错误
refutation.en: proof or a statement that something is not true or is wrong

reinstate.zh: 使恢复原职；使重返岗位；把…放回原处；使恢复原状
reinstate.en: to give back a job or position that had been taken away from somebody; to return something to its previous position or status

relic.zh: 遗物；遗迹；遗风；遗俗；圣髑；圣骨；圣人遗物
relic.en: an object, a tradition, a system, etc. that has survived from the past; a part of the body or clothing of a holy person, or something that they owned, that is kept after their death and respected as a religious object

remodel.en: to change the structure or shape of something

renaissance.zh: 文艺复兴（欧洲 14、15 和 16 世纪时，人们以古希腊罗马的思想文化来繁荣文学艺术）；（某一学科或艺术形式等衰落后的）复兴
renaissance.en: the period in Europe during the fourteenth, fifteenth and sixteenth centuries when people became interested in the ideas and culture of ancient Greece and Rome and used these influences in their own art, literature, etc.; a situation when there is new interest in a particular subject, form of art, etc. after a period when it was not very popular

reproduce.zh: 复制；再生产；再制造；使再次发生；再现；繁殖；生育
reproduce.en: to make a copy of a picture, piece of text, etc.; to produce something very similar to something else in a different medium or context; to make something happen again in the same way; if people, plants, animals, etc. reproduce or reproduce themselves, they produce young

respite.zh: 暂停；暂缓；短暂的延缓；喘息
respite.en: a short break or escape from something difficult or unpleasant; a short delay allowed before something difficult or unpleasant must be done

resurrect.zh: 重新应用；恢复使用；使复兴；起死回生；使复活
resurrect.en: to bring back into use something such as a belief, a practice, etc. that had disappeared or been forgotten; to bring a dead person back to life

ride out.zh: 安然渡过（难关）；经受得住
ride out.en: to manage to survive a difficult situation or time without having to make great changes

rip.zh: （突然或猛烈地）撕破，裂开；猛地扯开；突然拉开；（从网站或光盘）撷取（音频或视频文件）；将（文字或图像）光栅化；使栅格化；（使）全速前进；尽快做；使尽快发生；激动地说（或做）；忘乎所以地说（或做）；摧毁；毁坏；猛烈抨击；摧毁…的核心；猛烈攻击某人；（织物、纸张等）撕开的大口子；离岸流；裂流；安息（通常书于墓碑）
rip.en: to tear something or to become torn, often suddenly or violently; to remove something quickly or violently, often by pulling it; to copy sound or video files from a website or CD on to a computer; to change text or images into a form in which they can be displayed on a screen or printed; to go or allow something such as a car to go as fast as possible; to do something or to allow something to happen as fast as possible; to speak or do something with great force, enthusiasm, etc. and without control; to destroy something; to criticize somebody very strongly; to destroy the most important part or aspect of something; to attack somebody very violently; a long tear in cloth, paper, etc.; a strong current of water that flows away from the coast; rest in peace (often written on graves)

ritualistic.zh: 仪式的；老套的；例行公事的
ritualistic.en: connected with the rituals performed as part of a ceremony; always done or said in the same way, especially when this is not sincere

rocket science.en: used to emphasize that something is easy to do or understand

root for.zh: （体育比赛或遭遇困难时）给…助威，给…加油
root for.en: to support or encourage somebody in a sports competition or when they are in a difficult situation

round up.zh: 将…聚拢起来；使聚集；围捕；围剿
round up.en: to find and gather together people, animals or things; if police or soldiers round up a group of people, they find them and arrest or capture them

run-up.zh: （重要事情的）前期；准备阶段；准备；助跑；助跑距离
run-up.en: a period of time leading up to an important event; the preparation for this; the act of running or the distance you run, to gain speed before you jump a long distance, throw a ball, etc.

ruse.en: a way of doing something or of getting something by cheating somebody

ruthless.en: hard and cruel; determined to get what you want and not caring if you hurt other people

saline.en: containing salt; a mixture of salt in water

sanctuary.zh: 鸟兽保护区；禁猎区；庇护；保护；避难所；庇护所；圣所；圣殿
sanctuary.en: an area where wild birds or animals are protected and encouraged to produce young; safety and protection, especially for people who are in danger of being attacked or captured; a safe place, especially one where people who are in danger of being attacked or captured can stay and be protected; a holy building or the part of it that is considered the most holy

sap.zh: （植物体内运送养分的）液，汁；笨蛋；易上当的人；使虚弱；削弱；逐渐破坏
sap.en: the liquid in a plant or tree that carries food to all its parts; a stupid person that you can easily trick, or treat unfairly; to make something/somebody weaker; to destroy something gradually

scalable.zh: （计算机、网络、软件等）可扩展的，可升级的；可改变大小的；可缩放的
scalable.en: used to describe a computer, a network, software, etc. that can be adapted to meet greater needs in the future; designed to work on a large or small scale, according to needs; that can be climbed

scale.zh: （尤指与其他事物相比较时的）规模，范围，程度；等级；级别；等级体系；标度；刻度；秤；磅秤；天平；比例；比例尺；音阶；鳞；鳞片；水垢；水锈；牙垢；牙石；使天平倾斜；使结果倾向某方；起决定性作用；重量为；攀登；到达…顶点；去鳞；刮除牙石；缩放
scale.en: the size or extent of something, especially when compared with something else; a range of levels or numbers used for measuring something; the set of all the different levels of something, from the lowest to the highest; a series of marks at regular points on an instrument that is used for measuring; an instrument for weighing people or things; the relation between the actual size of something and its size on a map, diagram or model that represents it; a series of musical notes moving upwards or downwards, with fixed intervals between each note, especially a series of eight starting on a particular note; any of the thin plates of hard material that cover the skin of many fish and reptiles; a hard white substance that is sometimes left inside water pipes and containers for heating water; a hard substance that forms on teeth, especially when they are not cleaned regularly; to affect the result of something in one way rather than another; to weigh a particular amount; to climb to the top of something very high and steep; to remove the small flat hard pieces of skin from a fish; to remove tartar from the teeth by scraping; to change the size of something

scepticism.en: an attitude of doubting that claims or statements are true or that something will happen

scramble.zh: （迅速而吃力地）爬，攀登；争抢；抢占；争夺；艰难地（或仓促地）完成；炒（蛋）；扰码，倒频（改变电话或无线电信号，听众只有通过专门设备才能收听）；扰乱（思维）；命令（飞机等）紧急起飞；紧急起飞；（尤指需要手脚并用的）艰难行走，爬，攀登；摩托车越野赛
scramble.en: to move quickly, especially with difficulty, using your hands to help you; to push, fight or compete with others in order to get or to reach something; to manage to achieve something with difficulty, or in a hurry, without much control; to cook an egg by mixing the white and yellow parts together and heating them, sometimes with milk and butter; to change the way that a phone or radio message sounds so that only people with special equipment can understand it; to confuse somebody’s thoughts, ideas, etc. so that they have no order; to order that planes, etc. should take off immediately in an emergency; to take off immediately in an emergency; a difficult walk or climb over rough ground, especially one in which you have to use your hands; a situation in which people push, fight or compete with each other in order to get or do something; a race for motorcycles over rough ground

seamless.zh: 无（接）缝的；（两部分之间）无空隙的，不停顿的
seamless.en: without a seam; with no spaces or breaks between one part and the next

self-deception.en: the act of making yourself believe something that you know is not true

self-regulatory.zh: 自我管理的；自我调节的；self-regulatory
self-regulatory.en: systems, organizations, or activities are controlled by the people involved in them, rather than by outside organizations or rules.

self-sufficiency.en: the ability to do or produce everything that you need without the help of other people

semantics.zh: 语义学；（单词、短语或其他符号系统的）含义
semantics.en: the study of the meanings of words and phrases; the meaning of words, phrases or systems

set off.zh: 出发；动身；启程；使（炸弹等）爆炸；使（警报）响起；拉响（警报）；引发；激起；衬托；使显得更突出（或更漂亮）；使某人笑（或哭、说等）起来
set off.en: to begin a journey; to make a bomb, etc. explode; to make an alarm start ringing; to start a process or series of events; to make something more attractive or easy to notice by being placed near it; to make somebody start doing something such as laughing, crying or talking

shepherd.zh: 牧羊人；羊倌；带领；引；护送
shepherd.en: a person whose job is to take care of sheep; to guide somebody or a group of people somewhere, making sure they go where you want them to go

shoo-in.en: a person or team that will win easily

shore up.en: to support part of a building or other large structure by placing large pieces of wood or metal against or under it so that it does not fall down; to help to support something that is weak or going to fail

shove.zh: 猛推；乱挤；推撞；乱放；随便放；胡乱丢；随手扔；（粗鲁地表示不接受或不做某事）去他的，没门儿，去他妈的；猛推；别无选择时；须孤注一掷时
shove.en: to push somebody/something in a rough way; to put something somewhere roughly or carelessly; used to say rudely that you will not accept or do something; a strong push; when there is no other choice; when everything else has failed

shrewd.zh: 精明的；敏锐的；有眼光的；精于盘算的；判断得准的；高明的
shrewd.en: clever at understanding and making judgements about a situation; showing good judgement and likely to be right

shut out.zh: 使…不能进入；挡住；遮住；把某人排除在…外；不把…告诉某人；克制某种感情
shut out.en: to prevent somebody/something from entering a place; to not allow a person to share or be part of your thoughts; to stop yourself from having particular feelings

fund.zh: 基金；专款；资金；现款；（相当）数量；储备；为…提供资金；拨款给
fund.en: an amount of money that has been saved or has been made available for a particular purpose; money that is available to be spent; a company that manages money for people by investing it; the money managed by such a company; an amount or a supply of something; to provide money for something, usually something official

program.zh: 程序；编码指令；节目；计划；方案；活动安排；（演出或活动的）程序；节目单；演出介绍；（机器工作的）程序；（让人改变态度）按计划行事，做应该做的事；编写程序；计划；规划；安排；训练；培养
program.en: a set of instructions in code that control the operations or functions of a computer; something that people watch on television or listen to on the radio; a plan of things that will be done or included in the development of something; a course of study; an organized order of performances or events; a thin book or piece of paper that gives you information about a play, a concert, etc.; a series of actions done by a machine, such as a washing machine; used to tell somebody that they should change their attitude and do what they are supposed to be doing; to give a computer, etc. a set of instructions to make it perform a particular task; to plan for something to happen, especially as part of a series of planned events; to make a person, an animal, etc. behave in a particular way, so that they do it without thinking about it; to give a machine instructions to do a particular task

higher.zh: 高等级的；级别较高的；较重要的；（苏格兰）学生高级证书考试（旧时采用，应试年龄一般在 17 至 18 岁）
higher.en: at a more advanced level; greater in rank or importance than others; (in Scotland) an exam taken in a particular subject at a higher level than National 3, 4 and 5 qualifications. Highers are usually taken around the age of 17 to 18.

emission.zh: （光、热、气等的）发出，射出，排放；排放物；散发物
emission.en: the production or sending out of light, heat, gas, etc.; gas, etc. that is sent out into the air

fossil.zh: 化石；老人；（尤指）老顽固，老古董

humanity.zh: （统称）人；人类；人性；人道；仁慈；人文学科

moratorium.zh: 暂停，中止（尤指经官方同意的）

tak.zh: v. 携带，拿走；带去，引领；使达到，提升；拿，取；移走，拿开；偷走，误拿；取材于，收集；攻占，控制...

cultural.zh: 与文化有关的；文化的；与艺术、文学、音乐等有关的

gap.zh: 缺口；空白；漏洞；开口；豁口；缺口；裂口；间断；间隔；间隙；分歧；隔阂；差距

ritual.zh: 程序；仪规；礼节；（尤指）宗教仪式；习惯；老规矩；仪式上的；庆典的；习惯的；老套的；例行公事的

recovery.zh: 恢复；痊愈；改善；回升；复苏；取回；收回；复得；（供刚做完手术的病人使用的）监护室

individual.en: a person considered separately rather than as part of a group; a single member of a class of things; a person who is original and very different from others; a person of a particular type, especially a strange one; considered separately rather than as part of a group; connected with one person; designed for one person; typical of one particular person or thing in a way that is different from others
