neighborhood.zh: n. 附近；街坊；接近；街区
neighborhood.en: The quality of being a neighbor, of living nearby, next to each-other; proximity.

wilt.zh: （使）枯萎，凋谢，蔫；变得委靡不振；发蔫；变得又累又乏；失去自信；（同一个人谈话时用，即 you will）
wilt.en: to bend towards the ground because of the heat or a lack of water; to become weak or tired or less confident; used to mean ‘you will’, when talking to one person

opposition.zh: （强烈的）反对，反抗，对抗；（事业、竞赛、游戏等的）对手，敌手，竞争者；反对党；在野党；对立；对立的事物；反对党的；在野的；强烈反对（或抵制）某人／某事物；对比；对照
opposition.en: the act of strongly disagreeing with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening; the act of competing against somebody in a contest; the people you are competing against in business, a competition, a game, etc.; the main political party that is opposed to the government; the political parties that are in a parliament but are not part of the government; the state of being as different as possible; two things that are as different as possible; forming part of a parliament but not part of the government; disagreeing strongly with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening; contrasting two people or things that are very different

fac.zh: v. 使更容易，使便利；促进，推动

guilt.zh: 内疚；悔恨；犯罪；罪行；有罪；罪责；责任；罪过；使人内疚的责备
guilt.en: the unhappy feelings caused by knowing or thinking that you have done something wrong; the fact that somebody has done something illegal; blame or responsibility for doing something wrong or for something bad that has happened; things you say to somebody in order to make them feel guilty about something

charity.zh: 慈善机构（或组织）；慈善；赈济；施舍；仁爱；宽容；宽厚；博爱始于自家
charity.en: an organization for helping people in need; organizations for helping people in need, considered as a group; the money, food, help, etc. that they give; kind behaviour and sympathy towards other people, especially when you are judging them; you should help and care for your own family, etc. before you start helping other people

hybrid.zh: 杂种动物；杂交植物；杂种；（不同事物的）混合物，合成物；混合动力车（使用两种不同能源，尤指汽油或柴油与电混合使用）
hybrid.en: having parents of different species or varieties; that is the product of mixing two or more different things; using two different types of power, especially petrol or diesel and electricity; an animal or plant that has parents of different species or varieties; something that is the product of mixing two or more different things; a vehicle that uses two different types of power, especially petrol or diesel and electricity; a bicycle that has been designed for use on the road or on rough ground

install.zh: 安装；设置；安装（程序）；（常以正式仪式）使就职，任命；安顿；安置
install.en: to fix equipment or furniture into position so that it can be used; to put a new program onto a computer; to put somebody in a new position of authority, often with an official ceremony; to make somebody/yourself comfortable in a particular place or position

vision.zh: 视力；视野；想象；幻象；梦幻；幻象；神示；异象；想象力；眼力；远见卓识；俊男；天仙；有…气质的人；（电视或影院屏幕的）影像，画面
vision.en: the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position; an idea or a picture in your imagination; a dream or similar experience, especially of a religious kind; the ability to think about or plan the future with great imagination and intelligence; a person of great beauty or who shows the quality mentioned; the picture on a television or cinema screen

pledge.zh: 保证给予（或做）；正式承诺；使保证；使发誓；抵押；典当；宣誓参加美国大学生联谊会；保证；诺言；誓约；质钱；抵押品；发誓戒酒
pledge.en: to formally promise to give or do something; to make somebody or yourself formally promise to do something; to leave something with somebody as a pledge; to promise to become a junior member of a fraternity or sorority; a serious promise; a sum of money or something valuable that you leave with somebody to prove that you will do something or pay back money that you owe; to make a promise never to drink alcohol

bot.en: a computer program that runs automated tasks over the internet; a robot

creative.zh: 创造（性）的；创作的；有创造力的；（尤指艺术作品）创作的；表现创造力的；富于创造力的人；搞创作的人；创意；创作素材
creative.en: involving the use of skill and the imagination to produce something new or a work of art; having the skill and ability to produce something new, especially a work of art; showing this ability; a person whose job involves creative work; creative ideas or material

conditioner.zh: 护发剂；护发素；（洗衣后用的）柔顺剂
conditioner.en: a liquid or cream used to improve the condition of hair after washing; a liquid, used after washing clothes, that makes them softer

initiative.zh: 倡议；新方案；主动性；积极性；自发性；掌握有利条件的能力（或机会）；主动权；（美国某些州的）公民立法提案程序
initiative.en: a new plan for dealing with a particular problem or for achieving a particular purpose; the ability to decide and act on your own without waiting for somebody to tell you what to do; the power or opportunity to act and gain an advantage before other people do; (in some states of the US) a process by which ordinary people can suggest a new law by signing a petition

lowest.zh: adj. 最低的；最小的（low 的最高级）；最底下的
lowest.en: Situated close to, or even below, the ground or another normal reference plane; not high or lofty.

fake.zh: 假的；冒充的；伪造的；假货；赝品；冒充者；伪造；冒充；假装，佯装，装出（某种感情、有病等）
fake.en: not what somebody claims it is; appearing to be something it is not; made to look like something else; an object such as a work of art, a coin or a piece of jewellery that is not what somebody claims it is but has been made to look as if it is; a person who pretends to be what they are not in order to cheat people; to make something false appear to be real, especially in order to cheat somebody; to pretend to have a particular feeling, illness, etc.

influential.zh: 有很大影响的；有支配力的
influential.en: having a lot of influence on somebody/something

hunter-gatherer.en: a member of a group of people who do not live in one place but move around and live by hunting, fishing and gathering plants

automation.en: the use of machines and computers to do work that was previously done by people

barrel.zh: 桶；一桶（的量）；桶（石油计量单位，相当于 120 到 159 升）；枪管；很有趣；开心；快乐；易如反掌；探囊取物；手到擒来；全部；所有；（使某人）听从摆布，处于被动地位；（因别无选择）将就，凑合；（无法控制地）高速行进，飞驰
barrel.en: a large round container, usually made of wood or metal, with flat ends and, usually, curved sides; the contents of or the amount contained in a barrel; a unit of measurement in the oil industry equal to between 120 and 159 litres; the part of a gun like a tube through which the bullets are fired; a lot of fun; used to emphasize how easy it is to do something; including everything; (to put/have somebody) in a situation in which they must accept or do what you want; to have to use things or people that are not the best or most suitable because the ones that were the best or most suitable are no longer available; to move very fast in a particular direction, especially in a way that you cannot control

fungu.zh: n. 真菌，真菌类植物；霉菌；（尤指鱼的）真菌感染；迅速出现的令人讨厌的东西

elderly.zh: 年纪较大的，上了年纪的（婉辞，与 old 同义）；老人；上了年纪的人
elderly.en: used as a polite word for ‘old’; people who are old

formal.zh: 适合正式场合的；正规的；庄重的；正式的；合乎规矩的；正规的；方式上的；做法上的；形式上的；整齐的；布置井然的
formal.en: very correct and suitable for official or important occasions; official; following an agreed or official way of doing things; received in a school, college or university, with lessons, exams, etc., rather than gained just through practical experience; connected with the way something is done rather than what is done; arranged in a regular manner, according to a clear, exact plan

gam.zh: n. 鲸鱼群；（尤指海边，滩上的）社交，交谈；腿（尤指妇女漂亮的腿）; v. 社交，与……联欢；闲聊...
gam.en: A person's leg, especially an attractive woman's leg.

skye.zh: n. 匐犬（一种猎狐犬）；斯凯岛（苏格兰西部的岛）

diaspora.zh: （犹太人的）大流散；（任何民族或群体的）大移居
diaspora.en: the movement of the Jewish people away from their own country to live and work in other countries; Jewish people living and working in other countries; the movement of people from any nation or group away from their own country; people who have moved away from their own country

rhetoric.zh: 华而不实的言语；花言巧语；修辞技巧；修辞
rhetoric.en: speech or writing that is intended to influence people, but that is not completely honest or sincere; the art of using language in speech or writing in a special way that influences or entertains people

historic.zh: 历史上著名（或重要）的；可名垂青史的；有史时期的
historic.en: important in history; likely to be thought of as important at some time in the future; of a period during which history was recorded; that took place in the past but was not dealt with at the time

historical.zh: （有关）历史的；有关历史研究的；历史学的；历史题材的
historical.en: connected with the past; connected with the study of history; about people and events in the past

protest.zh: 抗议；抗议书（或行动）；反对；无奈地；不服气地；不甘心地；（公开）反对；抗议；坚决地表示；申辩
protest.en: the expression of strong dislike of or opposition to something; a statement or an action that shows this; unwillingly and after expressing disagreement; to say or do something to show that you disagree with something or think it is bad, especially publicly; to state clearly that something is true, especially when you have been accused of something or when other people do not believe you

leadership.zh: 领导；领导地位；领导才能；领导应有的品质；领导班子；领导层
leadership.en: the state or position of being a leader; the ability to be a leader or the qualities a good leader should have; a group of leaders of a particular organization, etc.

con.zh: 诡计；骗局；欺骗；事物的利与弊；支持与反对；（尤指为钱财或使人为自己做某事而）欺骗，哄骗，诈骗
con.en: a trick; an act of cheating somebody; a convict (= a person who has been found guilty of a crime and sent to prison); the advantages and disadvantages of something; to trick somebody, especially in order to get money from them or persuade them to do something for you

lobby.zh: （公共建筑物进口处的）门厅，前厅，大厅；（英国议会的）民众接待厅；（就某议题企图影响从政者的）游说团体；（就某议题企图影响从政者的）游说；游说（从政者或政府）
lobby.en: a large area inside the entrance of a public building where people can meet and wait; (in the British Parliament) a large hall that is open to the public and used for people to meet and talk to Members of Parliament; a group of people who try to influence politicians on a particular issue; an organized attempt by a group of people to influence politicians on a particular issue; to try to influence a politician or the government and, for example, persuade them to support or oppose a change in the law

demographic.zh: 人口统计数据；同类客户群体；人口的；人口学的
demographic.en: data relating to the population and different groups within it; a section of the population who are of a similar age, the same sex, etc.; relating to the population and different groups within it

bonuse.zh: n. 奖金（bonus 的复数形式）

campuse.zh: （大学）校园; 大学; 校园内的草地（campuse 的复数）

first-generation.en: having left your country to go and live in a new country; being the child of somebody who has left their country to go and live in a new country; being or connected with the earliest type of something to be developed, for example a machine or piece of software

migrant.zh: （为工作）移居者；移民；候鸟；迁徙动物；（为工作）迁移的；（随季节变化）迁徙的
migrant.en: a person who moves from one place to another in order to find work or better living conditions; a bird or an animal that moves from one place to another according to the season; moving from one place to another in order to find work or better living conditions; moving from one place to another according to the season

public-sector.zh: 公共部门，指由政府控制或拥有的经济部门
public-sector.en: Of or relating to a public sector.

handheld.en: a device, especially a computer, that is small enough to be held in the hand while being used; small enough to be held in the hand while being used

volcanic.zh: 火山的；火山引起的；火山产生的
volcanic.en: caused or produced by a volcano

waterway.en: a river, canal, etc. along which boats can travel

whiplash.zh: 鞭打；挥鞭伤，鞭打损伤（尤指车祸造成的颈部过度屈伸损伤）
whiplash.en: a hit with a whip; a neck injury caused when your head moves forward and back suddenly, especially in a car accident

contract.zh: 合同；合约；契约；（雇用杀人的）协议，合同；（使）收缩，缩小；感染（疾病）；得（病）；与…订立合同（或契约）；订立…的合同（或契约）；（与…）订立（婚约）；（与…）缔结（同盟）
contract.en: an official written agreement; an agreement to kill somebody for money; to become less or smaller; to make something become less or smaller; to get an illness; to make a legal agreement with somebody for them to work for you or provide you with a service; to make a legal agreement to work for somebody or provide them with a service; to formally agree to marry somebody/form an alliance with somebody

context.zh: （事情发生的）背景，环境，来龙去脉；上下文；语境
context.en: the situation in which something happens and that helps you to understand it; the words that come just before and after a word, phrase or statement and help you to understand its meaning

midlife.en: the middle part of your life when you are neither young nor old

congressional.zh: 立法机构的；代表大会的；（美国）国会的
congressional.en: related to or belonging to a congress or the Congress in the US

monarchy.zh: 君主制；君主政体；君主国；君主及其家庭成员
monarchy.en: a system of government by a king or a queen; a country that is ruled by a king or a queen; the king or queen of a country and their family

stay-at-home.zh: 全职照顾家庭的；不爱出门的人；恋家的人；死气沉沉的人
stay-at-home.en: a stay-at-home mother or father is one who stays at home to take care of their children instead of going out to work; a person who rarely goes out or does anything exciting

exoskeleton.en: a hard outer layer that protects the bodies of certain animals, such as insects; a machine attached to somebody's body to enable them to perform movements and actions more easily

liberal.zh: 宽宏大度的；心胸宽阔的；开明的；（政治经济上）自由的，开明的；支持（社会、政治或宗教）变革的；（旧时）英国自由党的；（英国以外国家）自由党的；慷慨的；大方的；大量给予的；通识（教育）的；不完全准确的；不精确的；不严格的；理解且尊重他人意见的人；宽容的人；开明的人；支持（社会、政治或宗教）变革的人；（旧时）英国自由党成员；（英国以外国家的）自由党成员
liberal.en: willing to understand and respect other people’s behaviour, opinions, etc., especially when they are different from your own; believing people should be able to choose how they behave; wanting or allowing a lot of political and economic freedom and supporting steady social, political or religious change; connected with the British Liberal Party in the past, or a Liberal Party in another country; generous; given in large amounts; a liberal education is about increasing somebody’s general knowledge and experience rather than particular skills; not completely accurate or exact; a person who understands and respects other people’s opinions and behaviour, especially when they are different from their own; a person who supports political, social and religious change; a member of the British Liberal Party in the past, or of a Liberal Party in another country

perspective.zh: 态度；观点；思考方法；客观判断力；权衡轻重的能力；透视法；景观；远景
perspective.en: a particular attitude towards something; a way of thinking about something; the ability to think about problems and decisions in a reasonable way without making them seem worse or more important than they really are; the art of creating an effect of depth and distance in a picture by representing people and things that are far away as being smaller than those that are nearer the front; a view, especially one in which you can see far into the distance

prudence.en: a sensible and careful attitude when you make judgements and decisions; behaviour that avoids unnecessary risks; a first name for girls

salon.zh: 美发厅；美容院；高级服装店；（大宅中的）客厅，会客室；沙龙（旧时作家、艺术家等在名流家中定期举行的聚会）
salon.en: a shop that gives customers hair or beauty treatment or that sells expensive clothes; a room in a large house used for entertaining guests; (in the past) a regular meeting of writers, artists and other guests at the house of a famous or important person

deployment.zh: 部署，调度（军队或武器）；有效地利用；调动
deployment.en: the act of moving soldiers or weapons into a position where they are ready for military action; the act of using something effectively

warfare.zh: 战；作战；战争；（群体、公司等之间的）斗争，竞争，冲突
warfare.en: the activity of fighting a war, especially using particular weapons or methods; the activity of competing in an aggressive way with another group, company, etc.

endors.zh: v. （公开）赞同，认可；（在广告中对某种产品）宣传，吹捧；（尤指在支票背面）签名，背书；(在驾驶执...

fiscal.zh: 财政的；国库的；国家岁入的
fiscal.en: connected with government or public money, especially taxes

loan.zh: 贷款；借款；借出；贷给；被借出；借出，贷与（尤指钱）；出借（贵重物品给博物馆等）
loan.en: money that an organization such as a bank lends and somebody borrows; the act of lending something; the state of being lent; to lend something to somebody, especially money; to lend a valuable object to a museum, etc.

sometime.zh: 在某时（不确切或尚未决定）；（指某人曾经是…）从前的，一度的；间或的；偶尔的
sometime.en: at a time that you do not know exactly or has not yet been decided; used to refer to what somebody used to be; used to refer to what somebody does occasionally

connie.zh: 康妮：女孩的名字，康斯坦斯的缩写
connie.en: a first name for girls, short for Constance

cosmo.zh: n. 科兹摩（男子名）；（美）都市性
cosmo.en: A cosmopolitan, a cocktail containing vodka, triple sec, lime juice and cranberry juice.

dialogue.zh: （书、戏剧或电影中的）对话，对白；（尤指集体或国家间为解决问题、结束争端等进行的）对话
dialogue.en: a conversation in a book, play or film or in language teaching materials; a formal discussion between two groups or countries, especially when they are trying to solve a problem, end a disagreement, etc.

forgiveness.en: the act of forgiving somebody; the quality of being willing to forgive somebody

gratitude.en: the feeling of being grateful and wanting to express your thanks

hottest.zh: adj. 热的；最热门的；热烈的
hottest.en: (of an object) Having a high temperature.

legislature.en: a group of people who have the power to make and change laws

logo.zh: （某公司或机构的）标识，标志，徽标
logo.en: a printed design or symbol that a company or an organization uses as its special sign

magicschool.zh: 魔法学校：指一所专门培养魔法师或魔法使用者的学校。

outdoor.en: used, happening or located outside rather than in a building

teen.zh: 十几岁，青少年时期(指从 13 岁到 19 岁)；teen；面向青少年的；由青少年完成的；青少年,十几岁的孩子(指从 13 岁到 19 岁)
teen.en: If you are in your , you are between thirteen and nineteen years old.; is used to describe things such as films, magazines, bands, or activities that are aimed at or are done by people who are in their teens.; A is someone aged between thirteen and nineteen years old.

eruption.zh: 突然发生；爆发；突然发出（尤指叫喊）；突然（在皮肤上）出现
eruption.en: an occasion when a volcano suddenly throws out burning rocks, smoke, etc.; an occasion when something starts happening, suddenly and violently; a sudden expression of very strong feelings, especially by shouting loudly; the sudden appearance of spots, etc. on your skin

illustration.zh: （书、杂志等中的）图表，插图；图解；图示；例释；（说明事实的）故事，实例，示例
illustration.en: a drawing or picture in a book, magazine, for decoration or to explain something; the process of illustrating something; a story, an event or an example that clearly shows the truth about something

plantation.zh: 种植园，种植场（尤指热带国家种植咖啡、甘蔗、橡胶等的大庄园）；木材林地；人造林
plantation.en: a large area of land, especially in a hot country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, etc. are grown; a large area of land that is planted with trees to produce wood

worst-case.en: involving the worst situation that could happen

ain.zh: adj. 自己的; n. （Ain）（马、美、英）艾因（人名）

deli.zh: （出售熟肉、干酪和进口风味食品的）熟食店，熟食柜台
deli.en: a shop or part of one that sells cooked meats and cheeses, and special or unusual foods that come from other countries

footage.en: part of a film showing a particular event; size or length measured in feet

hospitality.zh: 好客；殷勤；（款待客人、顾客等的）食物，饮料，服务；款待
hospitality.en: friendly and generous behaviour towards guests; food, drink or services that are provided by an organization for guests, customers, etc.

slang.en: very informal words and expressions that are more common in spoken language, especially used by a particular group of people, for example, children, criminals, soldiers, etc.

thai.zh: 泰国人；泰国的；泰国人的

accreditation.en: official approval given by an organization stating that somebody/something has achieved a required standard

discomfort.zh: 轻微的病痛；不舒服；不适；不安；不自在；尴尬；使人不舒服的事物；苦事；痛苦；使不舒服；使不安；使尴尬
discomfort.en: a feeling of slight pain or of being physically uncomfortable; a feeling of worry or being embarrassed; something that makes you feel uncomfortable or causes you a slight feeling of pain; to make somebody feel anxious or embarrassed

efficient.en: doing something in a good, careful and complete way with no waste of time, money or energy

faculty.zh: （高等院校的）系，院；（高等院校中院、系的）全体教师；（某高等院校的）全体教师；官能；天赋；才能；能力
faculty.en: a department or group of related departments in a college or university; all the teachers in a faculty of a college or university; all the teachers of a particular university or college; any of the physical or mental abilities that a person is born with; a particular ability for doing something

intuition.en: the ability to know something by using your feelings rather than considering the facts; an idea or a strong feeling that something is true although you cannot explain why

motivate.zh: 成为…的动机；是…的原因；推动…甘愿苦干；激励；激发；（就所说的话）给出理由；说明…的原因
motivate.en: to be the reason why somebody does something or behaves in a particular way; to make somebody want to do something, especially something that involves hard work and effort; to give reasons for something that you have stated

rating.zh: 等级；级别；收视率；收听率；表示电影分级的数字（或字母）；电影的等级；海军士兵；水手
rating.en: a measurement of how good, popular, important, etc. somebody/something is, especially in relation to other people or things; a set of figures that show how many people watch or listen to a particular television or radio programme, used to show how popular a programme is; a number or letter that shows which groups of people a particular film is suitable for; a sailor in the navy who is not an officer

recruiter.en: a person whose job is to find new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.

regional.en: of or relating to a region

shad.zh: n. 河鲱；西鲱属及黑海鲱属，鲱科; n. （Shad）（美、英、巴基斯坦）沙德（人名）
shad.en: Any one of several species of food fishes that make up the genus Alosa in the family Clupeidae, to which the herrings also belong; river herring.

ventilation.zh: 使（房间、建筑物等）通风；使通气
ventilation.en: the fact of allowing fresh air to enter and move around a room, building, etc.

blog.zh: 博客；网志；写博客；写网志
blog.en: a website where an individual person, or people representing an organization, write regularly about recent events or topics that interest them, usually with photos and links to other websites that they find interesting; to keep a blog; to write something in a blog

drainage.en: the process by which water or liquid waste is drained from an area; a system of drains

hydropower.zh: n. 水力发出的电力；水力发电

insurer.en: a person or company that provides people with insurance

lawn.zh: 草坪；草地；上等细棉布（或麻布）
lawn.en: an area of ground covered in short grass in a garden or park, or used for playing a game on; a type of fine cotton or linen cloth used for making clothes

navigable.en: wide and deep enough for ships and boats to sail on; on which it is easy to find the information, section, etc. that you want

regenerative.zh: 再生的：具有使某事物重新发展或变得强大的作用
regenerative.en: having the effect of making something develop or grow strong again

scrapp.zh: adj. 报废的；已经销毁的; v. 废弃（scrap 的过去式）

timber.zh: （用于建筑或制作物品的）树木，林木；用材林；（建筑等用的）木材，木料；（建造房屋用的）大木料，栋木；（造船用的）肋材；（砍伐树木时喊）放树啦！
timber.en: trees that are grown to be used in building or for making things; wood that is prepared for use in building, etc.; a long heavy piece of wood used in building a house or ship; used to warn people that a tree that has been cut is about to fall

tropical.zh: 热带的；来自热带的；产于热带的
tropical.en: coming from, found in or typical of the tropics

typically.zh: 通常；一般；典型地；具有代表性地；不出所料；果然
typically.en: used to say that something usually happens in the way that you are stating; in a way that shows the usual qualities or features of a particular type of person, thing or group; in the way that you expect somebody/something to behave

unlock.zh: （用钥匙）开…的锁；发现；揭示；揭开；解除（手机）的网络锁定
unlock.en: to open the lock of a door, window, etc., usually using a key; to discover something and let it be known; to enable a mobile phone to use any network rather than only one particular one; to use a code or password to get access to more data or features on a computer or phone, or in a computer game

episodic.zh: 偶尔发生的；不定期的；由松散片段组成的；有许多片段的
episodic.en: happening occasionally and not at regular intervals; containing or consisting of many separate and different events

epidemic.zh: 流行病；（坏事迅速的）泛滥，蔓延
epidemic.en: a large number of cases of a particular disease or medical condition happening at the same time in a particular community; a sudden rapid increase in how often something bad happens; occurring more and more frequently in a particular place; with large numbers of cases occurring at the same time in a particular community

fertility.zh: 富饶；丰产；能生育性；可繁殖性；想象力丰富；能生育的；可繁殖的；能结果的
fertility.en: the quality in land or soil of making plants grow well; the ability to produce babies, young animals, fruit or new plants

follower.zh: 拥护者；追随者；信徒；爱好者；仿效者；追随者；（微博客上某人的）关注者
follower.en: a person who supports and admires a particular person or set of ideas; a person who is very interested in a particular activity and follows all the recent news about it; a person who does things after somebody else has done them first; a person who chooses to regularly receive somebody’s messages using a social media service

grin.zh: 露齿而笑；咧着嘴笑；粲然而笑；默默忍受；苦笑着忍受；眉开眼笑；笑得合不拢嘴；露齿的笑；咧着嘴笑
grin.en: to smile widely; to accept pain or bad luck without complaining; to be smiling, etc. a lot because you are very pleased about something; a wide smile; to stop smiling, especially because somebody else is annoyed and does not think the situation is funny

healthcare.en: the service of providing medical care

largely.zh: 在很大程度上；多半；主要地
largely.en: to a great extent; mostly or mainly

multicultural.zh: 多元文化的；多种文化融合的
multicultural.en: for or including people of several different races, religions, languages and traditions

selection.zh: 选择；挑选；选拔；被挑选的人（或物）；被选中者；入选者；可供选择的事物
selection.en: the process of choosing somebody/something from a group of people or things, usually according to a system; a number of people or things that have been chosen from a larger group; a collection of things from which something can be chosen

social-media.zh: 社交媒体：通过社交网络和微博等电子通讯方式，用户可以创建在线社区，分享信息、想法、个人信息和其他内容...

transfer.zh: （使）转移，搬迁；（使）调动；转职；转学；改变（环境）；（使在旅途中）转乘，换乘，倒车；转存，转录（资料、音乐等）；改编；转移（感情）；传染（疾病）；让与，转让（权力等）；转让；让与；转会，使转会（尤指职业足球队）；搬迁；转移；调动；变换；（旅途中的）中转，换乘，改变路线；转车票；换乘票；（运动员）转会；转印图画，转印图案（利用挤压或加热，可从纸上转印到物体的表面）；迁移（将已习得的行为在新的情况下应用）
transfer.en: to move from one place to another; to move something/somebody from one place to another; to move from one job, school, situation, etc. to another; to arrange for somebody to move; to change to a different vehicle during a journey; to arrange for somebody to change to a different vehicle during a journey; to copy information, music, an idea, etc. from one method of recording or presenting it to another; to be recorded or presented in a different way; if you transfer a feeling, a disease, or power, etc. from one person to another, the second person has it, often instead of the first; to officially arrange for something to belong to somebody else or for somebody else to control something; to move, or to move somebody, to a different sports team, especially a professional football (soccer) team; to send a phone call that you have received to another phone number; the act of moving somebody/something from one place, group or job to another; an occasion when this happens; an act of changing to a different place, vehicle or route when you are travelling; a ticket that allows a passenger to continue their journey on another bus or train; the act of moving a sports player from one club or team to another; a picture or design that can be removed from a piece of paper and stuck onto a surface, for example by being pressed or heated; the process of using behaviour that has already been learnt in one situation in a new situation

unclear.zh: 不清楚的；不确定的；难以掌握的；不完全明白；不理解
unclear.en: not clear or definite; difficult to understand or be sure about; not fully understanding something

dearth.en: a lack of something; the fact of there not being enough of something

increasingly.zh: 越来越多地；不断增加地
increasingly.en: more and more all the time

threaten.zh: 扬言要；威胁；恐吓；预示凶兆；有…危险；危及；对…构成威胁
threaten.en: to say that you will cause trouble, hurt somebody, etc. if you do not get what you want; to seem likely to happen or cause something unpleasant; to be a danger to something

robotic.zh: 机器人的；像机器人的；呆板机械的
robotic.en: connected with robots; like a robot, making stiff movements, speaking without feeling or expression, etc.

undergraduate.en: a university or college student who is studying for their first degree

earlier.zh: [early的比较级]；早些时候；先前；之前；earlier
earlier.en: is the comparative of .; is used to refer to a point or period in time before the present or before the one you are talking about.

trillion.zh: 万亿；兆；大量；无数；百万兆
trillion.en: 1 000 000 000 000; one million million; a very large amount; one million million million; 1 000 000 000 000 000 000

extraction.zh: 提取；提炼；拔出；开采；（有…）血统；族裔；拔牙
extraction.en: the act or process of removing or obtaining something from something else; having a particular family origin; the process of removing a tooth

assign.zh: 分配（某物）；分派，布置（工作、任务等）；指定；指派；委派；派遣；确定（价值、功能、时间、地点）；转让，让与（财产、权利）
assign.en: to give somebody something that they can use, or some work or responsibility; to provide a person for a particular task or position; to send a person to work under the authority of somebody or in a particular group; to say that something has a particular value or function, or happens at a particular time or place; to say that your property or rights now belong to somebody else

clip.zh: 电影片段；（金属或塑料的）夹子，回形针；首饰别针；剪短；修剪；（用手）猛击，抽打；子弹夹；弹匣；迅速；很快地；夹住；别住；被夹住；剪（掉）；修剪；碰撞（某物的边缘或侧面）；从…剪下；限制某人的自由（或权力）
clip.en: a short part of a film that is shown separately; a small metal or plastic object used for holding things together or in place; a piece of jewellery that fastens to your clothes; the act of cutting something to make it shorter; a quick hit with your hand; a set of bullets in a metal container that is placed in or attached to a gun for firing; quickly; to fasten something to something else with a clip; to be fastened with a clip; to cut something with scissors or shears, in order to make it shorter or neater; to remove something from somewhere by cutting it off; to hit the edge or side of something; to cut something out of something else using scissors; to limit a person’s freedom or power

electrician.en: a person whose job is to connect, repair, etc. electrical equipment

graduat.zh: n. 大学毕业生，学士学位获得者；毕业生; v. 获得学位（尤指学士），大学毕业；毕业（尤指中学）；...

mainstream.zh: 主流思想；主流群体；使为大多数人所接受；让（身心有缺陷的儿童）融入主流教育
mainstream.en: the ideas and opinions that are thought to be normal because they are shared by most people; the people whose ideas and opinions are most accepted; considered normal because it reflects what is done or accepted by most people; mainstream education is for children who do not have any special needs or difficulties; to make a particular idea or opinion accepted by most people; to include children with mental or physical problems in ordinary school classes

modernization.en: the process of making a system, methods, etc. more modern and more suitable for use at the present time

overheat.zh: 变得过热；使过热；发展过热，过于活跃（以致物价高涨）
overheat.en: to become or to make something become too hot; to be too active, with rising prices

philosophy.zh: 哲学；哲学体系；思想体系；人生哲学；生活的信条（或态度）
philosophy.en: the study of the nature and meaning of the universe and of human life; a particular set or system of beliefs resulting from the search for knowledge about life and the universe; a set of beliefs or an attitude to life that guides somebody’s behaviour

retake.zh: 收复（失地）；恢复控制；重考；（通常指）补考；重拍（电影镜头）
retake.en: to take control of something such as a town again; to take an exam or a test again, usually after failing it the first time; the act of filming a scene in a film again, because it was not right before; the act of taking an exam or a test again, usually after failing it the first time

shortcut.zh: 近路；捷径；（做某事的）快捷办法，捷径
shortcut.en: a quicker or shorter way of getting to a place; a way of doing something that is quicker than the usual way; a record of the address of a file, website, or other data that is made so you can access the file, etc. quickly

simultaneously.zh: 同时发生（或进行）的；同步的
simultaneously.en: at the same time as something else

bel.zh: 贝尔，贝（声音计量单位，等于 10 分贝）
bel.en: a measurement of sound equal to 10 decibels

biomass.zh: 生物量（单位面积或体积中所含的生物个体总量或其总质量）；生物质（活着的或刚死去的动植物的天然腐化物质，用于燃料或工业生产，尤其是发电）
biomass.en: the total quantity or mass (= weight) of plants and animals in a particular area or volume; natural materials from living or recently dead plants, trees and animals, used as fuel and in industrial production, especially in the generation of electricity

cannot.en: the negative of can; can not

cop.zh: 警察；（当场被抓获时说）这是罪有应得，抓得有理；不太好；不怎么样；遭受；忍受；注意到；抓住，握住（某物）；被罚；受罚；被杀；避重就轻地认罪（以求轻判）
cop.en: a police officer; used by somebody who is caught doing something wrong, to say that they admit that they are wrong; not very good; to receive or suffer something unpleasant; to notice something; to take hold of something; to be punished; to be killed; to admit in court to being guilty of a small crime in the hope of receiving less severe punishment for a more serious crime

exploration.zh: 勘探；勘查；探索；探究；研究；探测
exploration.en: the act of travelling through a place in order to find out about it or look for something in it; an examination of something in order to find out about it

foam.zh: 泡沫橡胶；海绵橡胶；泡沫；泡沫剂（用于洗涤、剃须、灭火等）；有泡沫；起泡沫；口吐白沫（尤指因发病或暴怒）；大发雷霆
foam.en: a soft light rubber material, full of small holes, that is used for seats, mattresses, etc.; a mass of very small air bubbles on the surface of a liquid; a chemical substance that forms or produces a soft mass of very small bubbles, used for washing, shaving (= cutting hair from the skin), or putting out fires, for example; to have or produce a mass of small bubbles; to have a mass of small bubbles in and around its mouth, especially because it is sick or angry; to be very angry

largest.zh: adj. 多量的，最大的（large 的最高级）
largest.en: Of considerable or relatively great size or extent.

mismanagement.zh: 管理不善：对问题或情况的不良管理；政府对经济的管理不善
mismanagement.en: bad management of a problem or situation

monetary.zh: 货币的，钱的（尤指一国的货币）
monetary.en: connected with money, especially all the money in a country

nagpur.zh: n. 那格浦尔（印度中部城市）

transformation.zh: （彻底的）变化，改观，转变，改革；（用于南非）民主改革
transformation.en: a complete change in somebody/something; the process of making institutions and organizations more democratic

turbine.en: a machine or part of a machine that produces continuous turning power from a fast-moving flow of a liquid or gas, using a set of vanes attached to a wheel or rotor

classical-music.zh: 古典音乐：包括莫扎特、海顿等古典时期的音乐，以及欧美地区更为严谨、正式的音乐形式，与民间音乐或流行音...

encod.zh: v. 把……译成密码（或电码）；给（计算机程序）编码；用外语表达；（基因）对生成（某种物质或行为）负...

engagement.zh: 订婚；订婚期间；（尤指正式的或与工作有关的）约定，约会，预约；（与…的）密切关系；（对…的）了解；战斗；交战；雇用；聘用
engagement.en: an agreement to marry somebody; the period during which two people are engaged; an arrangement to do something at a particular time, especially something official or something connected with your job; being involved with somebody/something in an attempt to understand them/it; fighting between two armies, etc.; an arrangement to employ somebody; the process of employing somebody

orchestra.zh: 管弦乐队；（剧场的）正厅前排座位
orchestra.en: a large group of people who play various musical instruments together, led by a conductor; the seats that are nearest to the stage in a theatre

recording.zh: 录制的音像；录音；视频；录像；录制；（正式的）记录，记载
recording.en: sound or pictures that have been recorded on computer files or on CD, DVD, video, etc.; the process of making a record, film, radio or television show, etc.; the process or act of writing down and storing information for official purposes

accru.zh: v. （利益、好处等）产生，形成；（钱不断地）积累，增加；准备累算偿付

credibility.en: the quality that somebody/something has that makes people believe or trust them

decay.zh: 腐烂；腐朽；（社会、机构、制度等的）衰败，衰退，衰落；（使）腐烂，腐朽；（建筑、地方等）破败，衰落，衰败；（力量、影响等）衰弱，衰退，衰减
decay.en: the process or result of being destroyed by natural causes or by not being cared for (= of decaying); the process of a society, an institution, a system, etc. being gradually destroyed; the process by which a radioactive substance changes to a different form by sending out radiation; to be destroyed gradually by natural processes; to destroy something in this way; if a building or an area decays, its condition slowly becomes worse; to become less powerful and lose influence over people, society, etc.

distribution.zh: 分配；分布；分发；分送；（商品）运销，经销，分销
distribution.en: the way that something is spread or exists over a particular area or among a particular group of people; the act of giving or sharing something out among a number of people; the system of transporting and delivering a product

evolutionary.zh: 进化的；演变的；逐渐发展的
evolutionary.en: connected with evolution; connected with slow steady development and change

exposure.zh: 面临，遭受（危险或不快）；揭露；（在电视、报纸等上的）亮相，被报道；挨冻；受寒；曝光时间；（照一张照片的）软片，底片，胶片；暴露；显露
exposure.en: the state of being in a place or situation where there is no protection from something harmful or unpleasant; the fact of having the true facts about somebody/something told after they have been hidden because they are bad, dishonest or illegal; the fact of being discussed or mentioned on television, in newspapers, etc.; the fact of experiencing something new or different; a medical condition caused by being out in very cold weather for too long without protection; the length of time for which light is allowed into the camera when taking a photograph; a length of film in a camera that is used to take a photograph; the act of showing something that is usually hidden

goalkeeper.en: a player whose job is to stop the ball from going into his or her own team’s goal

highlight.zh: 突出；强调；将（文本的某部分）用彩笔做标记；将（计算机屏幕的某区域）增强亮度；使醒目；挑染（将部分头发染成浅色）；最好（或最精彩、最激动人心）的部分；挑染的头发；（图画或照片的）强光部分
highlight.en: to emphasize something, especially so that people give it more attention; to mark part of a text with a special coloured pen, or to mark an area on a computer screen, to emphasize it or make it easier to see; to make some parts of your hair a lighter colour than the rest by using a chemical substance on them; the best, most interesting or most exciting part of something; areas of hair that are lighter than the rest, usually because a chemical substance has been put on them; the light or bright part of a picture or photograph

infant.zh: 婴儿；幼儿；四岁到七岁之间的学童；供婴幼儿用的；初期的；初创期的
infant.en: a baby or very young child; a child at school between the ages of four and seven; designed to be used by infants; new and not yet developed

influenc.zh: n. 影响，作用；势力，影响力；有影响的人（或事物）; v. 影响，对……起作用

lender.en: a person or an organization that lends money

multiculturalism.zh: 多元文化主义（重视社会中各种文化）
multiculturalism.en: the practice of giving importance to all cultures in a society

objective.zh: 目标；目的；（望远镜或显微镜的）物镜；客观的；就事论事的；不带个人感情的；客观存在的；基于事实的；宾格的
objective.en: something that you are trying to achieve; the lens in a telescope or microscope that is nearest to the object being looked at; not influenced by personal feelings or opinions; considering only facts; existing outside the mind; based on facts that can be proved; the objective case is the one which is used for the object of a sentence

poorest.zh: adj. 可怜的; adj. 低劣的; adj. 贫困的（poor的最高级 ）
poorest.en: With no or few possessions or money, particularly in relation to contemporaries who do have them.

prosperity.en: the state of being successful, especially in making money

reader.zh: 读者；读书…的人；阅读量大的人；（报刊等的）读者；简易读物；读本；准教授（英国大学教师，仅次于教授）；电子阅读器；电子识读机；缩微软片阅读机
reader.en: a person who reads, especially one who reads a lot or in a particular way; a person who reads a particular newspaper, magazine, etc.; an easy book that is intended to help people learn to read their own or a foreign language; a senior teacher at a British university just below the rank of a professor; an electronic device that reads data stored in one form and changes it into another form so that a computer can perform operations on it; a machine that produces on a screen a large image of a text stored on a microfiche or microfilm

reshape.zh: 改变…的形状（或结构）；重塑；改组
reshape.en: to change the shape or structure of something

richest.zh: 深的; 富裕的; 强烈的（rich 的最高级）
richest.en: Wealthy: having a lot of money and possessions.

tolerant.zh: 忍受的；容忍的；宽容的；能在困难条件下生存（或操作）的；能耐…的
tolerant.en: able to accept what other people say or do even if you do not agree with it; able to survive or operate in difficult conditions

wheelchair.en: a special chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, an accident, etc.

millennial.zh: 千禧年：与一千年有关；地球自转速度的减速度在千禧年的时间尺度上将不是恒定的。；千禧年：与一千年的周年纪念有关；纽约时代广场的千禧庆典；千禧一代：与21世纪初成年的一代人相关；千禧一代现在正在政治上留下印记，并塑造未来。；千禧世代：持有或表明相信，当基督重返地球时，将有一个幸福与和平的未来时代。；金提出了关于平等和民族康复的千禧年愿景。；千禧一代：属于21世纪初成人的一代人；千禧一代愿意冒险，并认为职业转变是正常的。
millennial.en: connected with a period of a thousand years; connected with the anniversary of a thousand years; connected with the generation of people who became adults in the early 21st century; holding or showing the belief that there will come a future age of happiness and peace when Christ will return to Earth; a person who belongs to the generation who became adults in the early 21st century

younger.zh: adj. 更年轻的，年纪更小的；更未成熟的，更没经验的；更年轻人似的，更朝气的；小……（用于称呼与父...
younger.en: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

monarch.en: a person who rules a country, for example a king or a queen

to the tune of.zh: 使用……的曲调：指使用某首特定歌曲的曲调。; 以……的金额：用于强调某事物（如金钱）的数量或程度相当...

purports.zh: v．声称，表明：表示某事物的意图、目的或含义。
purports.en: To convey, imply, or profess outwardly (often falsely).

spawned.zh: v. 引起（spawn 的过去分词）；孵出
spawned.en: To produce or deposit (eggs) in water.

stakes.zh: n. 赌注；风险（stake 的复数）；利益; v. 用桩支撑；以……打赌（stake 的第三人称单...
stakes.en: A piece of wood or other material, usually long and slender, pointed at one end so as to be easily driven into the ground as a marker or a support or stay.

state of emergency.zh: 紧急状态：一种非常困难或危险的情况，政府为了重新掌控局面而给予自己特殊权力或暂停正常的法律程序。
state of emergency.en: An unusually difficult or dangerous situation in which a government gives itself special powers or suspends normal legal procedures so as to regain control.

decimated.zh: vt. 摧毁；大幅度下降（decimate 的过去式及过去分词）
decimated.en: To kill one-tenth of a group, (specifically) as a military punishment in the Roman army selected by lot, usually carried out by the surviving soldiers.

eat one's words.zh: 收回自己的话：后悔或撤回之前所说的话。
eat one's words.en: To regret or retract what one has said.

humanities.zh: n. 人文学科（humanity 的复数）
humanities.en: The study of Ancient Greek and Latin, their literature, history, etc., sometimes inclusive of the study of the ancient Mediterranean generally.

implications.zh: n. 暗指，暗示；蕴含，含义；（可能带来的）影响（implication 的复数）

incentives.zh: n. 激励；奖励；诱因；奖励措施（incentive 的复数）
incentives.en: Something that motivates, rouses, or encourages.

iucn.zh: abbr. 国际自然保护联盟 (International Union for Conservati...

make ends meet.en: To have enough money to cover expenses; to get by financially; to get through the pay period (sufficient to meet the next payday).

prospects.zh: n. （发生好事情的）可能性，机会；成功的机会；前景，前途；有前途的候选人；景色（prospect ...

refrain from.zh: 避免，克制：不做某事或不说某话，通常是因为它可能会有负面影响或后果。

relegated.zh: vt. 使贬职；使降级（relegate 的过去式和过去分词）
relegated.en: Exile, banish, remove, or send away.

laid off.zh: 裁员：指企业或雇主基于业务上的考量，暂时或永久中止雇用个人或集体雇员的行为。

sovereign wealth fund.zh: 主权财富基金：一种由国家拥有的投资基金，投资于股票、债券、房地产、贵金属等实体和金融资产。
sovereign wealth fund.en: A state-owned investment fund investing in real and financial assets such as stocks, bonds, real estate, precious metals, etc.

political appointee.zh: 出于政治考虑而任命的人员; 政务官

action level.zh: 行动水平：有害或有毒物质或污染物（如铅、石棉、苯或辐射）的浓度水平，超过该水平被认为足以需要采取监管...

acute crisis.zh: 急性危机：指突然发生的、紧急的、严重的危机事件。

alzheimer's disease.zh: 阿尔茨海默病；早老性痴呆病
alzheimer's disease.en: is a condition in which a person's brain gradually stops working properly.

jim crow.zh: （美国社会过去对黑人的）种族歧视，种族隔离
jim crow.en: the former practice in the US of using laws that allowed black people to be treated unfairly and kept separate from white people, for example in schools

opec.zh: 石油输出国组织；欧佩克
opec.en: Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (an organization of countries that produce and sell oil)

wall street.zh: 华尔街（美国纽约金融中心和证券交易所所在地）
wall street.en: the US financial centre and stock exchange in New York City (used to refer to the business that is done there)

whitehall.zh: 怀特霍尔(伦敦一街名，许多政府机关所在地)；白厅(指英国政府)；Whitehall
whitehall.en: is the name of a street in London in which there are many government offices. You can also use to mean the British Government itself.

nsfw.zh: 工作时不宜，不适合上班时观看（全写为 not safe/suitable for work，用于电邮、互联网论坛等，表示链接的网站或网页中包含可能令人反感的图文或视频）
nsfw.en: not safe (or suitable) for work (used in emails, on internet forums, etc. to show a link to a website or web page that contains images, text or video that people may find offensive)

goliath.en: a person or thing that is very large or powerful

capitol hill.en: used to refer to the US Capitol and the activities that take place there

gcse.zh: 英国面向15至16岁学生的普通中等教育证书；GCSE
gcse.en: are British educational qualifications which schoolchildren take when they are fifteen or sixteen years old. is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'General Certificate of Secondary Education'.

shutter.zh: 活动护窗；百叶窗；（照相机的）快门；掩藏自己的思想感情；锁上心扉；不再想某件事
shutter.en: one of a pair of wooden or metal covers that can be closed over the outside of a window to keep out light or protect the windows from damage; the part of a camera that opens to allow light to pass through the lens when you take a photograph; to stop letting somebody know what your thoughts or feelings are; to stop letting yourself think about something

sift.zh: 筛（面粉或颗粒较细的物质）；细查；详审；区分；挑选；精选
sift.en: to put flour or some other fine substance through a sieve / sifter; to examine something very carefully in order to decide what is important or useful or to find something important; to separate something from a group of things

silo.zh: 筒仓；（核武器的）发射井；（危险物品的）地下贮藏库；青贮窖；独立运行的系统（或流程、部门等）
silo.en: a tall tower on a farm used for storing grain, etc.; an underground place where nuclear weapons or dangerous substances are kept; an underground place where silage is made and stored; a system, process, department, etc. that operates separately or is thought of as separate from others

single market.zh: 单一市场（由若干国家构成，成员国之间对于相互间的商品交易、货币流通及人员往来限制极少或没有限制）
single market.en: a group of countries that have few or no controls or limits on the movement of goods, money and people between the members of the group

sit for.en: to be a model for an artist or a photographer

sixth form.zh: 第六学级（英国中等学校的最后两年，学生年龄在 16 至 18 岁之间，准备参加高级证书考试）
sixth form.en: the two final years at school for students between the ages of 16 and 18 who are preparing to take A levels (= advanced level exams)

skin-deep.zh: 不深刻；肤浅；美貌不过一张皮；貌美不如心灵美
skin-deep.en: not as important or strongly felt as it appears to be; how a person looks is less important than their character

skirmish.zh: 小规模战斗；小冲突；（尤指）遭遇战；（尤指政治上对立双方的）小争执，小争论；发生小规模战斗（或冲突、争执）
skirmish.en: a short fight between small groups of soldiers, etc., especially one that is not planned; a short argument, especially between political opponents; to take part in a short fight or argument

slack-jawed.zh: 放松的下巴：因为震惊或困惑而张开嘴；她只是呆呆地坐在那里，无话可说。；一堆下巴的白痴
slack-jawed.en: having your mouth open because you are shocked or confused

slant.zh: （使）倾斜，歪斜；有倾向性地陈述；有偏向地报道；倾斜；歪斜；斜线；斜面；（有倾向性的）观点，态度
slant.en: to slope or to make something slope in a particular direction or at a particular angle; to present information based on a particular way of thinking, especially in an unfair way; a sloping position; a way of thinking about something, especially one that shows support for a particular opinion or point of view

slanted.zh: 倾斜的；歪斜的；有倾向性的；有偏向性的
slanted.en: sloping in one direction; tending to be in favour of one person or thing in a way that may be unfair to others

slot in.zh: 为…安排时间（或提供机会）；安置
slot in.en: to manage to find a position, a time or an opportunity for somebody/something

smear.zh: （用油性或稀软物质）胡乱涂抹；弄脏；弄上油污；诽谤；诋毁；把（字迹、图画等）蹭得模糊不清；变得模糊不清；污迹；污渍；污点；（尤指政治上的）抹黑，丑化；涂片试验（从妇女子宫颈取少许组织，以检查是否有癌细胞）
smear.en: to spread an oily or soft substance over a surface in a rough or careless way; to make something dirty or greasy; to damage somebody’s reputation by saying unpleasant things about them that are not true; to rub writing, a drawing, etc. so that it is no longer clear; to become not clear in this way; an oily or dirty mark; a story that is not true about somebody that is intended to damage their reputation, especially in politics; a medical test in which a very small amount of tissue from a woman’s cervix is removed and examined for cancer cells

sober.zh: 未醉；持重的；冷静的；素净的；淡素的；滴酒未沾；完全清醒；（使）变得持重，变得冷静
sober.en: not drunk (= not affected by alcohol); serious and sensible; plain and not bright; having drunk no alcohol at all; to make somebody behave or think in a more serious and sensible way; to become more serious and sensible

sobering.zh: 令人警醒的；使人冷静的
sobering.en: making you feel serious and think carefully

sojourn.en: to stay for a short time in a place away from your home; a temporary stay in a place away from your home

sophistication.zh: 见多识广的；老练的；见过世面的；世故；复杂巧妙；高水平
sophistication.en: experience of the world and knowledge of fashion, culture and other things that people think are socially important; the quality in a machine or system of being clever and complicated in the way that it works or is presented; the ability to understand difficult or complicated ideas

sought-after.zh: (因稀有或质优而)受欢迎的，吃香的；sought-after
sought-after.en: Something that is is in great demand, usually because it is rare or of very good quality.

sparingly.en: in a way that is careful to use or give only a little of something

specimen.zh: 样品；样本；标本；（尤指动植物的）单一实例；（化验的）抽样，血样，尿样
specimen.en: a small amount of something that shows what the rest of it is like; a single example of something, especially an animal or a plant; a small quantity of blood, urine, etc. that is taken from somebody and tested by a doctor

spin-off.zh: （意外但有用的）副产品，派生物；（根据成功的书、电影或电视剧制作的）派生作品，搭车产品
spin-off.en: an unexpected but useful result of an activity that is designed to produce something else; a book, a film, a television programme, or an object that is based on a book, film or television series that has been very successful

spiral.zh: 螺旋形；螺旋式；逐渐加速上升（或下降）；螺旋形的；螺旋式的；螺旋式上升（或下降）；盘旋上升（或下降）；急剧增长
spiral.en: a shape or design, consisting of a continuous curved line that winds around a central point, with each curve further away from the centre; a continuous harmful increase or decrease in something, that gradually gets faster and faster; moving in a continuous curve that winds around a central point; to move in continuous circles, going upwards or downwards; to increase rapidly

splash out.en: to spend a lot of money on something

sprawl.zh: 伸开四肢坐（或躺）；蔓延；杂乱无序地拓展；（城市）杂乱无序拓展的地区
sprawl.en: to sit, lie or fall with your arms and legs spread out in a relaxed or careless way; to spread in an untidy way; to cover a large area; a large area covered with buildings that spreads from the city into the countryside in an ugly way

stagnant.zh: （水或空气）不流动而污浊的；停滞的；不发展的；无变化的
stagnant.en: stagnant water or air is not moving and therefore smells unpleasant; not developing, growing or changing

stakeholder.zh: （某组织、工程、体系等的）参与人，参与方；有权益关系者；赌金保管人
stakeholder.en: a person or company that is involved in a particular organization, project, system, etc., especially because they have invested money in it; a person who holds all the bets placed on a game or race and who pays the money to the winner

standard bearer.zh: (具有共同目标或利益的一群人的)领袖，旗手，代表
standard bearer.en: If you describe someone as the of a group, you mean that they act as the leader or public representative of a group of people who have the same aims or interests.

starkly.zh: 严酷的；赤裸裸的；真实而无法回避的；毫无修饰的；荒凉的；粗陋的
starkly.en: in a way that is unpleasant, real and impossible to avoid; completely; in a way that is easy to see because it is very different; in a way that looks severe because it has no colour or decoration

state-of-the-art.zh: 使用最先进技术的；体现最高水平的；state-of-the-art
state-of-the-art.en: If you describe something as , you mean that it is the best available because it has been made using the most modern techniques and technology.

sticking point.en: something that people do not agree on and that prevents progress in a discussion

stigma.en: negative feelings that people have about particular circumstances or characteristics that somebody may have; the part in the middle of a flower where pollen is received

stringent.zh: 严格的；严厉的；紧缩的；短缺的；银根紧的
stringent.en: very strict and that must be obeyed; difficult and with very strict controls because there is not much money

strongman.zh: 铁腕人物；独裁者；（尤指马戏团里的）大力士
strongman.en: a leader who uses threats or violence to rule a country; a physically very strong man, especially somebody who performs in a circus

stunned.zh: 惊呆了：非常惊讶或震惊；显示这个
stunned.en: very surprised or shocked; showing this

subsidiary.zh: 辅助的；附带的；次要的；附属的；隶属的；附属公司；子公司
subsidiary.en: connected with something but less important than it; owned or controlled by another company; a business company that is owned or controlled by another larger company

superpower.en: one of the countries in the world that has very great military or economic power and a lot of influence, for example the US; a special power or ability that somebody has, especially a superhero

supply-side.zh: 供应学派的（主张减税以刺激经济）
supply-side.en: connected with the policy of reducing taxes in order to encourage economic growth

sure-fire.zh: 必定成功的；肯定会发生的
sure-fire.en: certain to be successful or to happen as you expect

surreptitiously.zh: 暗中：以快速或秘密的方式，使其他人不会注意到；马丁暗中瞥了他一眼。
surreptitiously.en: in a quick or secret way so that other people do not notice

swamp.zh: 沼泽（地）；使不堪承受；使疲于应对；使应接不暇；淹；淹没
swamp.en: an area of ground that is very wet or covered with water and in which plants, trees, etc. are growing; to make somebody have more of something than they can deal with; to fill or cover something with a lot of water

swear off.zh: 保证不再做某事（或用某物）；发誓放弃…
swear off.en: to promise that you will not do or use something again

syndicate.zh: 辛迪加；企业联合组织；财团；私人联合会；把（文章、图片、电视节目等）出售给多个媒体
syndicate.en: a group of people or companies who work together and help each other in order to achieve a particular aim; to sell an article, a photograph, a television programme, etc. to several different newspapers, etc.

taboo.zh: （文化或宗教习俗方面的）禁忌，忌讳，戒律；禁止；避讳
taboo.en: considered so offensive or embarrassing that people must not mention it; a cultural or religious custom that does not allow people to do, use or talk about a particular thing as people find it offensive or embarrassing; a general agreement not to do something or talk about something

tack.zh: 方针；方法；思路；（帆船的）戗风调向，戗风行驶；（尤指把地毯钉在地板上的）平头钉，大头钉；粗线脚缝；假缝；鞍辔；马具；（开始考虑）基本事实，具体问题；（用平头钉）钉住；绷；用粗线脚缝；戗风行驶；换戗；作之字形航行
tack.en: the way in which you deal with a particular situation; the direction of your words or thoughts; the direction that a boat with sails takes as it sails at an angle to the wind in order to fill its sails; a small nail with a sharp point and a flat head, used especially for fixing a carpet to the floor; a short pin with a large round, flat head, used especially for fastening paper to a board or wall; a long, loose stitch used for holding pieces of cloth together temporarily, before you sew them finally; the equipment that you need for riding a horse, such as a saddle and bridle; (to start to consider) the basic facts or practical details of something; to fasten something in place with a tack or tacks; to fasten pieces of cloth together temporarily with long, loose stitches before sewing them finally; to change the direction of a sailing boat by turning the front of the boat into and through the wind, so that the wind blows onto the sails from the opposite side; to do this several times in order to travel in the direction that the wind is coming from

tackle.zh: 应付，处理，解决（难题或局面）；与某人交涉；向某人提起（问题或困难情况）；抢球；抢断；抢截；铲断；擒抱摔倒；阻截；抓获；擒获；给以颜色；（足球等）抢断球，阻截铲球；（橄榄球或美式足球）擒抱摔倒，阻截；阻截队员；用具；体育器材；（尤指）渔具；鸡巴；阳具
tackle.en: to make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem or situation; to speak to somebody about a problem or difficult situation; to try and take the ball from an opponent; to make an opponent fall to the ground in order to stop them running; to deal with somebody who is violent or threatening you; an act of trying to take the ball from an opponent in football (soccer), hockey, etc.; an act of knocking somebody to the ground, for example in rugby or American football; a player whose job is to stop opponents by knocking them to the ground; the equipment used to do a particular sport or activity, especially fishing; a man’s sexual organs

takeaway.zh: 外卖餐馆；外卖的饭菜；外卖食物
takeaway.en: a restaurant that cooks and sells food that you take away and eat somewhere else; a meal that you buy at this type of restaurant; an important fact, point or idea to be remembered from a talk, meeting or event

talking point.zh: 话题；论题；（常为支持某一论点的）论据
talking point.en: a subject that is talked about or discussed by many people; an item that somebody will speak about at a meeting, often one that supports a particular argument

tangible.zh: 有形的；实际的；真实的；可触摸的；可触知的；可感知的
tangible.en: that can be clearly seen to exist; that you can touch or feel

tanked.en: If someone is or , they are drunk.

task force.zh: 特遣部队；（为解决某问题而成立的）特别工作组
task force.en: a military force that is brought together and sent to a particular place; a group of people who are brought together to deal with a particular problem

tea party.zh: （午后的）茶会，茶话会；茶党（美国一个右翼政治运动，始于 2009 年抗议政府的行动，诉求缩减联邦政府开支和减税）
tea party.en: a social event at which people eat cake, drink tea, etc. in the afternoon; a conservative political movement in the US, begun in 2009 in protest against the government. In particular they want to reduce the amount of money that the national government spends and to cut taxes.

tease out.zh: 梳理，梳通（毛发等）；探讨；深入研究；梳理清楚
tease out.en: to remove knots from hair, wool, etc. by gently pulling or brushing it; to spend time trying to find out information or the meaning of something, especially when this is complicated or difficult

testimonial.zh: 证明信；介绍信；推荐信；感谢信；纪念品；奖品；奖状
testimonial.en: a formal written statement, often by a former employer, about somebody’s abilities, qualities and character; a formal written statement about the quality of something; a thing that you give or do to show that you admire and appreciate somebody

the national trust.zh: 全国托管协会（负责管理并保护英格兰、威尔士及北爱尔兰的历史遗迹和自然景观）
the national trust.en: an organization that owns and takes care of places of historical interest or natural beauty in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, so that people can go and visit them

third party.zh: 第三人；第三方；第三当事人；第三者
third party.en: a person who is involved in a situation in addition to the two main people involved

tight-fisted.en: not willing to spend or give much money

tilt.zh: （使）倾斜，倾侧；使倾向于；使向…倾斜；偏向；攻击假想敌；庸人自扰；倾斜；倾侧；（意欲赢得某物或战胜某人的）企图，尝试；全速；尽快
tilt.en: to move, or make something move, into a position with one side or end higher than the other; to make something/somebody change slightly so that one particular opinion, person, etc. is preferred or more likely to succeed than another; to change in this way; to waste your energy attacking imaginary enemies; a position in which one end or side of something is higher than the other; an act of tilting something to one side; an attempt to win something or defeat somebody; as fast as possible

tip off.zh: 暗中警告，私下告诫，密报（尤指非法的事情）
tip off.en: to warn somebody about something that is going to happen or has happened, especially something illegal

toothless.zh: 无牙的；无齿的；人微言轻的；没有权威的；不起作用的
toothless.en: having no teeth; having no power or authority

train wreck.zh: 列车撞车事故；列车脱轨事故；混乱失序的局面，灾难式的人生（因太过混乱、糟糕或倒霉而使人们觉得有趣）
train wreck.en: an accident in which a train crashes into something else or comes off the track; a situation, a person’s life, etc. that people find extremely interesting because it lacks order, is very bad or is unsuccessful

transgression.zh: 越轨；违背（道德）；违犯（法律）
transgression.en: an act that goes beyond the limits of what is morally or legally acceptable

trawl.zh: 查阅（资料）；搜集，搜罗，网罗（人或物）；用拖网捕鱼；（对资料、文件等的）查阅；（海上捕鱼用的）拖网
trawl.en: to search through a large amount of information or a large number of people, places, etc. looking for a particular thing or person; to fish for something by pulling a large net with a wide opening through the water; a search through a large amount of information, documents, etc.; a large net with a wide opening, that is dragged along the bottom of the sea by a boat in order to catch fish

trope.zh: 转义词语；比喻词语；（文学、电影等中的）重要主题，一再重复的主题
trope.en: a word or phrase that is used in a way that is different from its usual meaning in order to create a particular mental image or effect. Metaphors and similes are tropes.; a theme that is important or repeated in literature, films, etc.

tumultuous.zh: 嘈杂的；喧嚣的；热烈的；欢腾的；动荡的；动乱的；狂暴的
tumultuous.en: very loud; involving strong feelings, especially feelings of approval; involving many difficulties and a lot of change and often violence

turbulent.zh: 动荡的；动乱的；骚动的；混乱的；汹涌的；猛烈的；湍动的；骚动的；混乱而难以控制的
turbulent.en: in which there is a lot of sudden change, trouble, argument and sometimes violence; changing direction suddenly and violently; noisy and/or difficult to control

turn around.zh: （使）翻身，转身，翻转；（使企业、经济等）好转，扭转，有起色
turn around.en: to change position or direction so as to face the other way; to make somebody/something do this; if a business, economy, etc. turns around or somebody turns it around, it starts being successful after it has been unsuccessful for a time

u-turn.zh: U型转弯；180度转弯；掉头；U-turn；政治家在政策、计划、行动方面的180度大转弯，彻底转变
u-turn.en: If you make a when you are driving or cycling, you turn in a half circle in one movement, so that you are then going in the opposite direction.; If you describe a change in a politician's policy, plans, or actions as a , you mean that it is a complete change and that they made the change because they were weak or were wrong.

unanimity.en: complete agreement about something among a group of people

undermine.zh: 逐渐削弱（信心、权威等）；使逐步减少效力；从根基处破坏；挖…的墙脚
undermine.en: to make something, especially somebody’s confidence or authority, gradually weaker or less effective; to make something weaker at the base, for example by digging under it

underwhelming.en: not impressing or exciting you at all

unequivocally.zh: 明确地：非常清楚和强烈地；我们无疑支持这些变化。；他明确地说他对那份文件一无所知。

unfathomable.zh: 难以理解的；莫测高深的；（表情）难以琢磨的，微妙的
unfathomable.en: too strange or difficult to be understood; if somebody has an unfathomable expression, it is impossible to know what they are thinking

unilaterally.en: by one person, group or country involved in a situation without the agreement of the others

unplug.en: to remove the plug of a piece of electrical equipment from the electricity supply

unpretentious.zh: 谦虚谨慎的；不事张扬的；不爱炫耀的
unpretentious.en: not trying to appear more special, intelligent, important, etc. than you really are/it really is

unseat.zh: 罢免；解除职务；赶下台；使摔下马（或自行车）
unseat.en: to remove somebody from a position of power; to make somebody fall off a horse or bicycle

unsettled.zh: 多变的；不安定的；不平稳的；动荡不安的；不镇静的；心绪不宁的；不安的；无休止的；未解决的；未支付的；未付清的
unsettled.en: that may change; making people uncertain about what might happen; not calm or relaxed; that continues without any agreement being reached; not yet paid

unsolicited.zh: 未经要求的；自发的；自我推荐的
unsolicited.en: not asked for and sometimes not wanted

unwittingly.zh: 糊里糊涂地；茫然；无意地
unwittingly.en: without being aware of what you are doing or the situation that you are involved in

upmarket.en: in a way that involves buying or selling goods and services that are expensive and of high quality; designed for or used by people who belong to a high social class or have a lot of money

utilitarian.zh: 实用的；功利的；实惠的；功利主义的
utilitarian.en: designed to be useful and practical rather than attractive; based on or supporting the ideas of utilitarianism

venture capital.zh: 风险资本（投入新公司的资金，风险很大）
venture capital.en: money that is invested in a new company to help it develop, which may involve a lot of risk

vested interest.en: a personal reason for wanting something to happen, especially because you get some advantage from it

veteran.zh: 经验丰富的人；老手；退伍军人；老兵；老战士；老水兵
veteran.en: a person who has a lot of experience in a particular area or activity; a person who has been a soldier, sailor, etc. in a war

vexed.zh: （问题等）棘手的，伤脑筋的；（人）恼火，烦恼，伤脑筋
vexed.en: a problem that is difficult to deal with; upset or annoyed

vigilante.zh: （尤指认为警方不力而自发组织的）治安会会员
vigilante.en: a member of a group of people who try to prevent crime or punish criminals in their community, especially because they think the police are not doing this

vindicate.zh: 证实；证明有理；澄清（责难或嫌疑）；证明（某人）无罪（责）
vindicate.en: to prove that something is true or that you were right to do something, especially when other people had a different opinion; to prove that somebody is not guilty when they have been accused of doing something wrong or illegal; to prove that somebody is right about something

vis-à-vis.zh: 关于；对于；和…相比；与…相较
vis-à-vis.en: in relation to; in comparison with

visionary.zh: 有眼力的；有创见的；有远见卓识的；梦幻的；耽于幻想的；（尤指）宗教异象的；神示的；有眼力的人；有远见卓识的人
visionary.en: original and showing the ability to think about or plan the future with great imagination and intelligence; relating to dreams or strange experiences, especially of a religious kind; a person who has the ability to think about or plan the future in a way that is intelligent and shows imagination

vocational.zh: 职业的；职业技术的；业务知识的
vocational.en: connected with the skills, knowledge, etc. that you need to have in order to do a particular job

volatility.zh: 易变的；无定性的；无常性的
volatility.en: the quality in a person of changing easily from one mood to another; the quality in a situation of being likely to change suddenly; the quality in a substance of changing easily into a gas

vulnerable.zh: （身体上或感情上）脆弱的，易受…伤害的
vulnerable.en: weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally

wade into.zh: 强行加入，介入，插手（打架、讨论、争论等）；抨击
wade into.en: to enter a fight, a discussion or an argument in an aggressive or not very sensitive way; to attack somebody with words in an angry aggressive way

waffle.zh: 华夫饼，蛋奶烘饼（两面有方块图案，常涂以糖浆、奶油等）；胡扯；废话连篇；胡扯；耍贫嘴；絮叨；胡写；拿不定主意；三心二意
waffle.en: a dry, flat cake with a pattern of squares on both sides, often eaten with sweet sauce, cream, etc. on top; language that uses a lot of words but does not say anything important or interesting; to talk or write using a lot of words but without saying anything interesting or important; to be unable to decide what to do about something or what you think about something

waged.zh: 领工资的；有定期付酬工作的；支取工资的；带薪的；工薪族；（统称）拿工资的人
waged.en: having regular paid work; for which you are paid; people who have regular paid work

wager.zh: 打赌；打赌；押（赌注）；打赌；打包票
wager.en: an arrangement to risk money on the result of a particular event; to bet money; used to say that you are so confident that something is true or will happen that you would be willing to bet money on it

war chest.en: an amount of money that a government or an organization has available to spend on a particular plan, project, etc.

wary.zh: （对待人或事物时）小心的，谨慎的，留神的，小心翼翼的
wary.en: careful when dealing with somebody/something because you think that there may be a danger or problem

wear down.zh: （因重复使用或磨擦而）变小，变光滑；磨短；（尤指通过不断攻击或施加压力）使衰弱，使意志薄弱
wear down.en: to become, or make something become, gradually smaller or smoother through continuous use or rubbing; to make somebody/something weaker or less determined, especially by continuously attacking or putting pressure on them or it over a period of time

wedge.zh: 楔子；三角木；楔形物；用作楔子的东西；坡跟鞋；（高尔夫球）楔形铁头球杆，挖起杆；（不好的事物的）端倪，冰山一角；将…挤入（或塞进、插入）；把…楔牢（或楔住）
wedge.en: a piece of wood, rubber, metal, etc. with one thick end and one thin, pointed end that you use to keep a door open, to keep two things apart, or to split wood or rock; something that is like a wedge in shape or that is used like a wedge; a shoe with a wedge heel (= one that forms a solid block with the bottom part of the shoe); a type of golf club that has its face (= the part that you hit the ball with) at a greater angle than other types of golf club; to make two people start disliking each other; an event or action that is the beginning of something more serious and/or unpleasant; to put or force something tightly into a narrow space, so that it cannot move easily; to make something stay in a particular position, especially open or shut, by placing something against it

weekend warrior.zh: 周末战士（仅在周末外出参加剧烈惊险体育活动的人，尤指室内工作者）
weekend warrior.en: a person who works all week, especially in an office or other indoor job, and uses the weekends to go out and do more active and/or dangerous physical activities

weighting.zh: （发放给在生活费用高的地区工作的人的）额外津贴，生活补贴；加权值
weighting.en: extra money that you get paid for working in a particular area because it is expensive to live there; a value that you give to each of a number of things to show how important it is compared with the others

white noise.zh: 白噪声（整个频道范围内的噪声）
white noise.en: noise that contains many different sound frequencies that are equally strong, for example the noise that comes from a television or radio that is turned on but not tuned in

withdrawal.zh: （从银行账户中）提款，取款；撤走；收回；取回；不再参加；退出（组织）；戒毒过程；脱瘾期；（对说过的话的）收回，撤回；退缩；孤僻
withdrawal.en: the act of taking an amount of money out of your bank account; the act of moving or taking something away or back; the act of no longer taking part in something or being a member of an organization; the period of time when somebody is getting used to not taking a drug that they have become addicted to, and the unpleasant effects of doing this; the act of saying that you no longer believe that something you have previously said is true; the behaviour of somebody who wants to be alone and does not want to communicate with other people

work ethic.zh: 职业道德：一个人的工作态度，特别是认为勤奋是一种好习惯，应该得到回报的观念；他们有着很强的崇尚勤劳工作的价值观。；她的职业道德差。
work ethic.en: a person's attitude to work, especially the idea that hard work is a good habit and should be rewarded

write off.zh: 致函（某机构）（索取资料等）；注销，销记（账项、资产等）；把（车辆等）毁坏，报废；认定…失败（或没有价值、不可救药等）
write off.en: to write to an organization or a company, usually in order to ask them to send you something; to cancel a debt; to recognize that something is a failure, has no value, etc.; to damage something, especially a vehicle, so badly that it cannot be repaired or would cost more to repair than to replace; to decide that somebody/something is a failure or not worth paying any attention to

harbinger.en: a sign that shows that something is going to happen soon, often something bad

unhinged.en: If you describe someone's behaviour or performance as , you are critical of it because it seems wild and uncontrollable.

virulent.zh: 致命的；恶性的；剧毒的；狠毒的；恶毒的；不共戴天的
virulent.en: extremely dangerous or harmful and quick to have an effect; showing strong negative and bitter feelings

budding.zh: 开始发展的；崭露头角的
budding.en: beginning to develop or become successful

comptroller.en: a person who is in charge of the financial accounts of a business company

panache.en: the quality of being able to do things in a lively and confident way that other people find attractive

upstart.zh: 自命不凡的新上任者；狂妄自大的新手
upstart.en: a person who has just started in a new position or job but who behaves as if they are more important than other people, in a way that is annoying

ward off.zh: 防止，避免，抵御（危险、疾病、攻击等）
ward off.en: to protect or defend yourself against danger, illness, attack, etc.
